copy.en: For angled exits, clocking is frozen on the drawing so the cable clears nearby walls, covers and moving parts after installation.
copy.zh: 弯出线方向需要在图纸中冻结，确保装机后避开邻近外壳、盖板和运动部件。

title.en: Metal shells do not create shielding by themselves
title.zh: 金属外壳不会自动形成有效屏蔽

copy.en: Shield performance depends on the continuous path from cable braid through rear hardware and shell to the panel and system ground.
copy.zh: 屏蔽表现取决于从线缆编织层、尾部附件、壳体到面板与系统地的连续路径。

title.zh: 端接几何需要匹配频率

copy.en: A 360-degree clamp, drain wire or another method is selected from signal frequency, cable design and grounding architecture, not appearance.
copy.zh: 360度夹环、排流线或其他方式应依据信号频率、线缆设计与接地架构选择，而不是看外观。

title.zh: 导通只是其中一项检查

copy.en: Low-frequency continuity cannot by itself demonstrate high-frequency shielding, impedance control or EMC performance.
copy.zh: 低频导通本身不能证明高频屏蔽、阻抗控制或电磁兼容表现。

title.en: Ingress protection belongs to the complete mated assembly
title.zh: 防护能力属于完整对插系统

copy.en: Interface seals, cable seals, cavity plugs, cable diameter, backshell and mounting orientation work together only in the defined mated state.
copy.zh: 接口密封圈、单线密封、堵孔件、线缆外径、尾壳与安装方向，只有在规定插合状态下才能共同工作。

copy.en: Incomplete thread engagement, an unlocked bayonet or a displaced seal changes compression and can invalidate the intended protection.
copy.zh: 螺纹未完全旋合、卡口未锁定或密封件移位都会改变压缩，从而破坏预期防护。

copy.en: Any ingress statement is tied to a defined specimen, mating part, cable, mounting direction, method and acceptance limit.
copy.zh: 任何防护结论都必须绑定明确试样、对插件、线缆、安装方向、方法与验收限值。

title.en: Shell, insert, contacts and seals age together
title.zh: 壳体、绝缘体、触点与密封件共同老化

copy.en: Plastic, aluminium, stainless steel, plating, insulators and elastomers are selected against weight, corrosion, temperature, chemicals, wear and electrical duty.
copy.zh: 塑料、铝合金、不锈钢、镀层、绝缘体和弹性体，需要结合重量、腐蚀、温度、化学、磨损与电气工况选择。

copy.en: Signal level, current, mating cycles and environment govern the contact system. Plating cannot be identified reliably from colour alone.
copy.zh: 信号电平、电流、插拔次数与环境共同决定触点系统，不能只凭颜色判断镀层。

copy.en: PVC, PUR, TPE, rubber, braid and conduit solve different flexibility, abrasion and environmental problems and are reviewed per project.
copy.zh: PVC、PUR、TPE、橡胶、编织与波纹管分别解决不同柔性、磨损和环境问题，需要按项目审核。

copy.en: Round locking connectors can support balanced audio, lighting control and equipment links where frequent mating, cable handling and clear channel identification matter.
copy.zh: 圆形锁紧接口可用于平衡音频、灯光控制与设备互连，重点在于频繁插拔、线缆操作和清晰通道识别。

copy.en: A familiar connector shape may carry different signals. Pin assignment, shielding and equipment responsibility are confirmed before production.
copy.zh: 熟悉的接口外形也可能承载不同信号，生产前必须确认针脚、屏蔽与设备端责任。

copy.en: Circular data interfaces remain common in installed equipment, controllers and instruments, where exact pin maps matter more than connector familiarity.
copy.zh: 圆形数据接口仍广泛存在于既有设备、控制器和仪器中，准确针脚定义比接口是否常见更重要。

copy.en: A sample can establish dimensions and visible wiring, but hidden circuitry, ratings and proprietary responsibility still require customer confirmation.
copy.zh: 样品可用于整理尺寸和可见接线，但隐藏电路、额定与专有责任仍需客户确认。

title.zh: 紧凑电源与仪器连接线

copy.en: Small circular interfaces fit constrained panels and portable equipment but leave less tolerance for keying errors, bend stress and cable-exit interference.
copy.zh: 小型圆形接口适合紧凑面板与便携设备，但对键位错误、弯曲应力和出线干涉的容忍度更低。

copy.en: Mating length, finger access, minimum bend region and nearby controls are checked using the final equipment layout.
copy.zh: 需要结合最终设备布局审核插合长度、手指操作空间、最小弯曲区域与邻近控制件。

title.en: What we need to build the correct assembly
title.zh: 正确开发组件需要哪些资料

copy.en: A precise interface package shortens sample cycles and prevents similar-looking but incompatible connector selections.
copy.zh: 准确接口资料可以缩短样品周期，并防止选择外观相似但无法互配的连接器。

copy.en: Provide connector family, mating part, keying, contact layout, pin map, voltage, current, signal type and shielding expectation.
copy.zh: 请提供连接器系列、对插件、键位、孔位、针脚、电压、电流、信号类型与屏蔽预期。

copy.en: Provide cable length and construction, panel details, exit direction, fixation points, temperature, vibration, moisture, chemicals, quantities and validation method.
copy.zh: 请提供线长与结构、面板资料、出线方向、固定点、温度、振动、湿气、化学品、数量和验证方法。

title.en: From pin map to repeat production

copy.en: The approved interface, cable, assembly sequence and inspection plan become one controlled manufacturing reference.
copy.zh: 已批准的接口、线缆、装配顺序和检验计划将形成一个受控制造基准。

copy.en: Prepare conductors, crimp or solder, inspect the termination, insert contacts, fit seals, terminate shielding and assemble the backshell in the specified order.
copy.zh: 按规定顺序完成备线、压接或焊接、端接检查、插针、密封、屏蔽端接与尾壳装配。

copy.en: Check continuity, polarity, cavities, shorts, mating, locking, dimensions and appearance, then perform agreed pull, resistance, insulation, shielding, ingress, vibration or flex tests.
copy.zh: 检查导通、极性、孔位、短路、插合、锁紧、尺寸与外观，再执行约定拉力、电阻、绝缘、屏蔽、防护、振动或弯折测试。

q.en: Can circular connectors with the same diameter be interchanged?
q.zh: 圆形连接器外径相同就可以互换吗？

a.en: No. Family, keying, contact arrangement, shell fit, coupling, contacts and seals can differ. Compatibility requires complete interface data and mating verification.
a.zh: 不可以。系列、键位、针芯排列、壳体配合、锁紧结构、触点和密封都可能不同，必须依据完整接口资料与对插验证确认。

q.en: Does a metal circular connector automatically provide shielding?
q.zh: 金属圆形连接器一定有屏蔽吗？

a.en: No. Shielding depends on cable shield termination, backshell, shell continuity, panel connection and system grounding. A metal appearance alone proves nothing.
a.zh: 不一定。有效屏蔽取决于电缆屏蔽端接、尾壳、壳体连续、面板连接与系统接地，金属外观本身不能证明屏蔽性能。

q.en: Are all circular connector assemblies waterproof?
q.zh: 圆形连接器组件都能防水吗？

a.en: No. Protection depends on the complete mated interface, seals, cavity plugs, backshell, cable diameter, mounting orientation and the defined test configuration.
a.zh: 不能。防护取决于完整插合接口、密封圈、堵孔件、尾壳、线缆外径、安装方向与规定测试配置。

q.en: Can you develop from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support dimensional and circuit mapping, but hidden ratings, material, mating-part data, shielding strategy and intellectual-property responsibility still require customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可以用于尺寸与回路整理，但隐藏额定、材料、对插件资料、屏蔽策略和知识产权责任仍需客户确认。

q.en: How do you choose between crimp and solder contacts?
q.zh: 压接端子与焊接端子怎样选择？

a.en: The connector series, conductor range, production volume, service method, vibration and process requirements govern the choice. Both methods need defined tools, controls and inspection.
a.zh: 选择需要服从连接器系列、线径范围、产量、维修方式、振动与工艺要求，两种方式都必须规定工装、过程控制与检验。

q.en: What is checked before shipment?
q.zh: 出货前检查哪些项目？

a.en: Finished assemblies receive continuity and appearance inspection plus agreed checks for polarity, cavities, shorts, mating, locking, dimensions, labels, terminal retention, seals and shield treatment. Other tests follow the approved plan.
a.zh: 成品进行导通与外观检查，并按项目核对极性、孔位、短路、插合、锁紧、尺寸、标签、端子保持、密封与屏蔽处理，其他测试依据批准计划执行。

intro.en: D-Sub cable assemblies extend far beyond a single nine-contact serial lead. Standard-density, high-density, mixed power and signal, panel-mount, inline, shielded, breakout and application-specific configurations are developed around the exact equipment interface, pin map, cable structure and installation limits.
intro.zh: D-Sub 电缆组件远不止常见的九针串口线。标准密度、高密度、混合电源与信号、面板安装、线对线、屏蔽、一分多及专用配置，都需要围绕准确设备接口、针脚定义、线缆结构和安装限制开发。

knowledge.en: Shell size, contact pattern, contact sex, viewing direction, jackscrews, hood, termination and shielding path all matter. A similar D-shaped interface or equal contact count does not prove interchangeability.
knowledge.zh: 外壳尺寸、触点排列、接触件性别、视图方向、固定螺钉、尾罩、端接方式与屏蔽路径都需要确认。D 形外观相似或针数相同并不能证明可以互换。

notes.en: Provide clear mating-face and wire-side photographs, the mating equipment, exact pin map, voltage and current, signal type, cable length and construction, hood and exit direction, fixing hardware, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供插合面与接线面清晰照片、对插设备、准确针脚、电压电流、信号类型、线长与结构、尾罩与出线方向、固定硬件、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the connector, pin orientation, circuits, cable, hood and hardware before the first build. Termination and shield treatment are inspected before continuity, shorts, polarity, mating, locking, dimensions and project-specific signal or environmental validation.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结连接器、针脚方向、回路、线缆、尾罩和固定硬件。端接与屏蔽处理完成检查后，再进行导通、短路、极性、插合、锁紧、尺寸以及项目专项信号或环境验证。

subtitle.en: One D-shaped shell family, many contact maps and cable architectures
subtitle.zh: 一个 D 形外壳家族，覆盖多种孔位与线缆架构

lead.en: D-Sub describes a connector family, not a universal cable. We develop complete assemblies from standard and high-density signal interfaces to hybrid power, coaxial, shielded, breakout and molded constructions. The job begins by freezing the mechanical interface and viewing direction, then continues through contacts, conductors, shielding, hardware, strain relief and verification.
lead.zh: D-Sub 描述的是连接器家族，不是通用电缆。我们可围绕标准密度、高密度信号接口、混合电源、同轴、屏蔽、一分多与包胶结构开发完整组件。项目先冻结机械接口与视图方向，再延伸到触点、导体、屏蔽、固定件、应力消除与验证。

introduction.zh: D-Sub 电缆组件接口档案

faq.zh: D-Sub 电缆组件常见问题

title.zh: 标准密度 D-Sub 组件

copy.en: Standard-density interfaces remain common in serial communication, parallel I/O, instruments, industrial controls and installed equipment. Shell size and contact count must be identified from the complete family, not a casual nickname.
copy.zh: 标准密度接口仍常见于串行通信、并行 I/O、仪器、工业控制和既有设备。外壳尺寸与触点数量必须按完整家族识别，不能依赖口语简称。

copy.en: The letters identify shell size while the number identifies contacts. Drawings and orders should freeze the exact shell, arrangement and mating part.
copy.zh: 字母对应外壳尺寸，数字对应触点数量。图纸与订单应冻结准确外壳、孔位和对插件。

title.en: Application does not define the pin map
title.zh: 应用名称不能代替针脚

copy.en: Two serial or control cables can use the same shell but different pin assignments, grounds, shields or internal links.
copy.zh: 两条串口或控制线可以使用同一外壳，却采用不同针脚、地线、屏蔽或内部短接。

copy.en: High-density versions place more contacts into a comparable shell envelope for compact equipment and multi-channel connections. Pitch, cavity pattern, terminal size, conductor range and tooling usually differ from standard-density parts.
copy.zh: 高密度版本在相近外壳空间内布置更多触点，适合紧凑设备与多通道连接。其节距、孔位、端子尺寸、线径范围和工装通常不同于标准密度产品。

copy.en: Row count and cavity position must be checked from a clear mating-face view. Similar overall width does not establish compatibility.
copy.zh: 必须从清晰插合面核对排数与孔位，整体宽度相似不能证明兼容。

title.en: Smaller contacts need tighter process control
title.zh: 小型触点需要更严过程控制

copy.en: Strip length, conductor size, insertion and adjacent-short inspection become more sensitive as contact spacing decreases.
copy.zh: 触点间距减小时，剥线长度、导体尺寸、插针与相邻短路检查会更加敏感。

title.en: Mixed power, signal and coaxial contacts
title.zh: 混合电源、信号与同轴触点

copy.en: Combo D-Sub arrangements can place large power contacts, fine signal contacts or coaxial modules in one shell. Each contact type requires its own electrical, thermal, shielding, wire and termination review.
copy.zh: 组合型 D-Sub 可以在同一外壳内配置大电流触点、小信号触点或同轴模块。每类触点都需要单独审核电气、温升、屏蔽、线材与端接。

copy.en: A single total-current statement cannot describe a hybrid assembly. Current, voltage drop, temperature rise and fault protection are assigned per circuit group.
copy.zh: 一个总电流无法描述混合组件，应按回路组分别定义电流、压降、温升与故障保护。

copy.en: Large conductors, coaxial terminations and mixed bend radii can control hood size, exit direction and assembly sequence.
copy.zh: 粗导体、同轴端接与不同弯曲半径可能决定尾罩尺寸、出线方向和装配顺序。

copy.en: Panel D-Sub receptacles may use flanges, studs, rivet nuts or board-mounted structures. Mating depth, panel thickness, rear clearance and cable-side hardware are reviewed as one mechanical system.
copy.zh: 面板 D-Sub 插座可采用法兰、螺柱、铆接螺母或板端结构。插合深度、面板厚度、后部空间和电缆端固定件需要作为同一机械系统审核。

copy.en: Thread, length and access must match the equipment-side hardware. A connector that touches the panel may still be unable to lock.
copy.zh: 螺纹、长度和操作空间必须匹配设备端硬件，接口接触面板也可能仍然无法锁紧。

copy.en: Adjacent ports, covers and cabinet walls must leave room to operate both screws and remove the hood without pulling the cable.
copy.zh: 邻近接口、盖板和柜壁需要留出操作两侧螺钉与握持尾罩的空间，不能靠拉线拆卸。

title.zh: 线对线转接与中间接口

copy.en: Inline D-Sub connections have no panel to support mass or pull load. Hood weight, screw access, cable fixation and the risk of unintended pin crossing become part of the harness design.
copy.zh: 线对线 D-Sub 连接没有面板支撑重量与拉力，尾罩重量、螺钉操作、线缆固定以及意外交叉针脚风险都必须纳入线束设计。

copy.en: A straight coupler, gender changer and null-modem adapter can look similar while performing different electrical functions.
copy.zh: 直通转接、性别转换和空调制解调器转接外形可能相似，但电气功能完全不同。

copy.en: Fixation points and service loops keep connector mass and handling force away from contacts and solder joints.
copy.zh: 固定点与检修余量可以避免接口重量和操作力直接作用于触点与焊点。

copy.en: Shell gender and contact sex must be stated rather than inferred from equipment convention. Both mating-face and wire-side views are required because the same cavity pattern becomes mirrored when viewed from the rear.
copy.zh: 外壳性别与触点针孔必须明确，不能根据设备习惯推断。需要同时给出插合面与接线面视图，因为从后部观察时孔位会左右镜像。

copy.en: Every pin table and work instruction should state mating face or wire side to prevent a complete mirrored wiring error.
copy.zh: 每份针脚表与作业文件都应注明插合面或接线面，避免整组回路镜像。

title.zh: 参考照片需要四个有效角度

copy.en: Capture the mating face, rear structure, side profile and equipment port in focus, including markings and locking hardware.
copy.zh: 应清晰拍摄插合面、后部结构、侧面和设备端接口，并包含标识与锁紧件。

copy.en: Contact numbering is the bridge between connector geometry and the circuit definition. Each cavity is assigned a start point, end point, conductor, signal role, shield relationship and inspection method.
copy.zh: 触点编号连接了接口几何与回路定义。每个孔位都应对应起点、终点、导体、信号功能、屏蔽关系和检验方法。

copy.en: The same connector pair may be wired one-to-one, crossed, partially populated, commoned or entirely application-specific.
copy.zh: 同一对连接器可能采用一对一、交叉、部分孔位、公共回路或完全专用接线。

copy.en: Unused contacts, reserved positions, optional circuits and deliberate no-connects are recorded so future revisions stay traceable.
copy.zh: 未用触点、预留孔位、选配回路和明确不连接位置都应记录，保证后续版本可追溯。

title.zh: 压接、焊杯与 IDC 结构

copy.en: The connector series defines the permitted contact and termination system. Conductor size, strand construction, strip length, tool or solder heat and inspection criteria are matched as one controlled process.
copy.zh: 连接器系列规定允许的触点与端接系统，导体线径、绞线结构、剥线长度、工装或焊接热输入以及检验标准需要作为一个受控工艺匹配。

copy.en: Terminal range, applicator, conductor brush, insulation support and pull or section criteria are fixed before repeat production.
copy.zh: 端子范围、压接工装、导体刷、绝缘支撑与拉力或截面标准应在重复生产前冻结。

copy.en: Solder quantity, dwell, insulation recession and wicking are controlled so flexible conductors and contact alignment are not damaged.
copy.zh: 需要控制焊料量、停留时间、绝缘回缩和爬锡，避免损伤柔性导体与触点对准。

copy.en: The hood protects terminations, carries the cable clamp and supports screw operation. Plastic, metallized and metal constructions differ in weight, shielding path, robustness, internal space and field service.
copy.zh: 尾罩保护端接、承载线夹并支撑螺钉操作。塑料、金属化与金属结构在重量、屏蔽路径、强度、内部空间和现场维护方面不同。

title.en: Metal appearance is not a shield claim
title.zh: 金属外观不等于屏蔽结论

copy.en: Shielding requires deliberate electrical contact from cable braid through clamp and hood to shell, panel and system ground.
copy.zh: 有效屏蔽需要从电缆编织层经夹持、尾罩、外壳、面板到系统地形成有意设计的电气连接。

copy.en: A correct clamp transfers pull and bending into the hood rather than the contacts. Excess force can crush the jacket; too little leaves terminations loaded.
copy.zh: 正确夹持把拉力与弯曲传递到尾罩而不是触点，过紧可能压伤护套，过松则使端接受力。

title.zh: 固定螺钉、出线方向与空间

copy.en: Straight, 45-degree and 90-degree exits change the equipment envelope, cable bend path and assembly order. Jackscrew thread, reach and grip must match the real panel hardware.
copy.zh: 直出、45 度与 90 度出线会改变设备空间、线缆弯曲路径和装配顺序。固定螺钉的螺纹、伸出长度与操作头必须匹配真实面板硬件。

copy.en: For side exits, the drawing should define orientation relative to pin 1 or the panel so the cable clears nearby walls and ports.
copy.zh: 侧出线应在图纸中相对 1 号孔或面板定义方向，确保线缆避开邻近墙体与接口。

title.en: False engagement is a real risk

copy.en: Similar but different screw threads may begin to engage and then jam or fail to provide retention.
copy.zh: 相似但不同的螺纹可能先旋入少量，随后卡死或无法提供可靠保持。

copy.en: Serial links, differential signals, analog channels, video and sensitive measurement circuits may require twisted pairs, controlled impedance, individual shields, an overall shield or separation from power conductors.
copy.zh: 串行链路、差分信号、模拟通道、视频和敏感测量回路可能需要双绞、阻抗控制、单独屏蔽、总屏蔽或与电源导体隔离。

title.zh: 屏蔽路径服从系统架构

copy.en: A drain wire can solve some low-frequency grounding needs but is not automatically equivalent to a 360-degree high-frequency termination.
copy.zh: 排流线可以解决部分低频接地需求，但不能自动等同于 360 度高频端接。

title.zh: 导通不等于信号完整性

copy.en: A cable can pass point-to-point continuity while failing impedance, crosstalk, shielding or installed-system performance.
copy.zh: 电缆可以通过点对点导通，却不满足阻抗、串扰、屏蔽或装机系统表现。

copy.en: A molded rear transition can fix the exit, distribute handling loads and protect hidden terminations. Material compatibility, screw access, interface protection and process validation remain project-specific.
copy.zh: 包胶尾部过渡可以固定出线、分散操作载荷并保护隐藏端接。材料兼容、螺钉操作、插合区保护与过程验证仍需按项目定义。

title.en: Molding does not create waterproofing by itself
title.zh: 包胶不会自动形成防水

copy.en: Ingress protection depends on the complete mated connector, panel seal, rear seal, cable jacket and tested configuration.
copy.zh: 防护能力取决于完整插合接口、面板密封、尾部密封、线缆护套与验证配置。

copy.en: The transition should guide bending into the cable over a controlled length rather than create a hard hinge at the hood exit.
copy.zh: 过渡结构应在受控长度内把弯曲引入线缆，而不是在尾罩出口形成硬折点。

title.en: Developing from drawings, pin maps or samples
title.zh: 依据图纸、针脚或样品开发

copy.en: A complete drawing can define the assembly directly. A physical sample can establish dimensions and visible wiring, but hidden components, ratings, shield strategy, equipment function and proprietary responsibility still require confirmation.
copy.zh: 完整图纸可以直接定义组件。实物样品可用于整理尺寸与可见接线，但隐藏元件、额定、屏蔽策略、设备功能和专有责任仍需确认。

copy.en: We document every start and end point instead of inferring circuits from names such as serial cable, extension or adapter.
copy.zh: 我们会记录每个起点与终点，不根据“串口线”“延长线”或“转接线”等名称推断回路。

copy.en: Shell, contacts, ratings, jackscrews, hood space, cable and mating fit are reviewed together before an alternative is released.
copy.zh: 替代方案放行前需要共同审核外壳、触点、额定、固定螺钉、尾罩空间、线缆和插合配合。

copy.en: D-Sub can transition to terminal blocks, multiple serial ports, circular connectors, board headers or customer-specific interfaces. Shared circuits, fan-out, backfeed, shielding and mechanical support must be reviewed at every branch.
copy.zh: D-Sub 可以转接到端子排、多个串行接口、圆形接口、板端插头或客户指定接口。每个分支都需要审核公共回路、扇出、回灌、屏蔽和机械支撑。

copy.en: A fan-out is not only a mechanical split. Loading, termination, signal reflection and power distribution can change with branch count and length.
copy.zh: 一分多不仅是机械分支，分支数量与长度会改变负载、终端、信号反射与电源分配。

copy.en: Leg identification, equipment position and connector orientation reduce maintenance errors in dense cabinets and test systems.
copy.zh: 分支标识、设备位置与接口方向可以减少密集机柜和测试系统中的维护错误。

title.zh: 串行通信与多通道控制

copy.en: RS-232, RS-422, RS-485 and proprietary control links can share D-Sub shells while using different pin maps, reference grounds, terminations and shielding. The protocol name never replaces equipment documentation.
copy.zh: RS-232、RS-422、RS-485 与专用控制链路可以使用相同 D-Sub 外壳，却采用不同针脚、参考地、终端与屏蔽。协议名称不能替代设备资料。

title.zh: 功能测试建立在电气检查之后

copy.en: Continuity, shorts and polarity confirm wiring; communication or analog tests confirm behaviour under the approved system conditions.
copy.zh: 导通、短路与极性用于确认接线，通信或模拟测试则在批准系统条件下确认功能表现。

title.en: Test adapters need controlled pin maps
title.zh: 测试转接同样需要受控针脚

copy.en: Breakout boxes and fixtures are released with their own revision, cavity map and verification record so test equipment does not introduce ambiguity.
copy.zh: 测试盒与工装应拥有独立版本、孔位表和验证记录，避免测试设备自身引入歧义。

title.en: From circuit definition to controlled assembly
title.zh: 从回路定义到受控装配

copy.en: The build sequence is planned around the connector rear space, conductor preparation, shielding and hood assembly so no later operation damages completed terminations.
copy.zh: 制作顺序需要围绕连接器后部空间、导体准备、屏蔽与尾罩装配规划，避免后续工序损伤已经完成的端接。

copy.en: Cut, mark, strip, twist and shield conductors as defined, then crimp, solder or IDC terminate with the specified tools and checks.
copy.zh: 按定义完成裁线、标识、剥线、绞对与屏蔽处理，再使用规定工装完成压接、焊接或 IDC 端接与检查。

copy.en: Contacts, insulators, shield clamps, strain relief, hood halves and jackscrews are fitted in an order that preserves access and orientation.
copy.zh: 触点、绝缘体、屏蔽夹、应力消除、尾罩和固定螺钉需要按保留操作空间与方向的顺序装配。

title.zh: 重复生产前的孔位级验证

copy.en: Every finished assembly receives continuity and appearance inspection. The approved project plan adds shorts, polarity, shell ground, dimensions, labels, mating, screw engagement, terminal retention and signal, mechanical or environmental checks where required.
copy.zh: 每条成品都进行导通与外观检查。批准计划还可按项目加入短路、极性、外壳接地、尺寸、标签、插合、螺钉旋合、端子保持以及信号、机械或环境检查。

title.zh: 首件形成重复生产基准

copy.en: Approved samples, drawing, BOM, process settings and inspection records are released together to control future batches.
copy.zh: 批准样品、图纸、BOM、工艺设定与检验记录共同放行，用于控制后续批次。

copy.en: Continuity proves point-to-point wiring, not protocol margin, shielding, ingress or lifetime unless those items are separately defined and tested.
copy.zh: 导通证明点对点接线，但不能证明协议裕量、屏蔽、防护或寿命，除非这些项目另行定义并验证。

q.en: Are DB9 and DE-9 the same connector?
q.zh: DB9 和 DE-9 是同一种接口吗？

a.en: DB9 is a common market name for the nine-contact connector, while DE-9 is the more accurate shell designation. Always confirm the mating face, contact sex, hardware and equipment interface rather than relying on the name alone.
a.zh: 市场常把九针接口称为 DB9，而 DE-9 是更准确的外壳称呼。应核对插合面、触点性别、固定硬件和设备端接口，不能只依赖名称。

q.en: Can D-Sub cables with the same contact count be interchanged?
q.zh: 针数相同的 D-Sub 电缆可以互换吗？

a.en: No automatic interchangeability exists. Pin map, contact sex, shell, screw hardware, shielding, cable and hidden components can differ even when the contact count is equal.
a.zh: 不能直接互换。即使针数相同，针脚、触点性别、外壳、螺钉、屏蔽、线缆和隐藏元件也可能不同。

q.en: What is different about high-density D-Sub?
q.zh: 高密度 D-Sub 有什么不同？

a.en: It places more contacts into a comparable shell size. Cavity pattern, pitch, terminals, wire range and tooling generally differ from standard-density versions.
a.zh: 高密度结构在相近壳体尺寸内布置更多触点，其孔位、节距、端子、线径范围与工装通常不同于标准密度版本。

q.en: Does every D-Sub cable support RS-232?
q.zh: 所有 D-Sub 电缆都支持 RS-232 吗？

a.en: No. D-Sub describes the mechanical connector family, not a communication protocol. The same shell may carry RS-232, RS-422, RS-485, CAN, analog I/O, video, power or proprietary circuits.
a.zh: 不能。D-Sub 描述机械接口家族，不代表通信协议。同一外壳可以承载 RS-232、RS-422、RS-485、CAN、模拟 I/O、视频、电源或专用回路。

q.en: Can a metal hood guarantee shielding?
q.zh: 金属尾罩可以保证屏蔽吗？

a.en: No. Effective shielding requires a defined connection from cable shield through the clamp and hood to the connector shell, panel and system ground, followed by project-appropriate validation.
a.zh: 不能。有效屏蔽需要从电缆屏蔽层经夹持、尾罩连接到连接器外壳、面板和系统地，并执行适合项目的验证。

q.en: Can you develop from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support dimensional and visible-circuit mapping. Hidden components, ratings, materials, shielding strategy, equipment function and intellectual-property responsibility still require customer confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可以辅助整理尺寸与可见回路，但隐藏元件、额定、材料、屏蔽策略、设备功能和知识产权责任仍需客户确认。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide connector views, mating equipment, part numbers if known, contact sex and viewing direction, complete pin map, circuit ratings, cable construction and length, hood, hardware, exit direction, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供接口照片、对插设备、已知料号、触点性别和视图方向、完整针脚、回路额定、线缆结构与长度、尾罩、硬件、出线方向、环境、数量和验证要求。

intro.en: USB cable assemblies cover legacy Type-A and Type-B interfaces, Mini and Micro formats, reversible Type-C, panel-mounted extensions, molded leads, charging-only constructions, high-speed data paths and USB-to-equipment interfaces. The connector shape is only the starting point; function, pin map, power duty, cable architecture, shielding, electronics, installation and validation define the finished assembly.
intro.zh: USB 电缆组件覆盖传统 Type-A 与 Type-B、Mini 与 Micro、可翻转 Type-C、面板延长、包胶线、仅供电结构、高速数据通道以及 USB 到设备专用接口。接口外形只是起点，功能、针脚、供电负载、线缆架构、屏蔽、内部器件、安装与验证共同定义成品。

knowledge.en: A Type-C plug does not by itself establish data rate, power or video capability. Legacy USB shapes can also conceal charging-only, proprietary or converter circuits. Interface, generation, device role, internal components and test boundary must be frozen together.
knowledge.zh: Type-C 插头本身不能证明数据速率、功率或视频能力；传统 USB 外形也可能隐藏仅供电、专用针脚或转换电路。接口、代际、设备角色、内部器件和测试边界需要一起冻结。

notes.en: Provide both endpoints, mating equipment, required USB function and generation, device role, data and power duty, pin map, cable length, panel and exit direction, shielding, jacket, molding, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端接口、对插设备、所需 USB 功能与代际、设备角色、数据与供电要求、针脚、线长、面板与出线方向、屏蔽、护套、包胶、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface, circuits, conductor and differential-pair structure, shield path, internal components, mechanics and labels before the first build. Continuity is followed by project-specific voltage-drop, temperature, negotiation, data-link, mechanical or environmental validation where required.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结接口、回路、导体与差分对结构、屏蔽路径、内部器件、机械结构和标识。导通之后，再按项目执行压降、温升、协商、数据链路、机械或环境验证。

subtitle.en: One familiar interface family, many electrical and mechanical configurations
subtitle.zh: 熟悉的接口家族，背后是多种电气与机械配置

lead.en: USB assemblies are developed from the complete signal and power path rather than from the two visible plugs. We define the connector family, USB function, device roles, conductors, differential pairs, shielding, Configuration Channel, electronics, panel geometry, overmolding and verification as one controlled product.
lead.zh: USB 组件不能只看两端插头，而要从完整信号与供电路径开发。我们把接口家族、USB 功能、设备角色、导体、差分对、屏蔽、Configuration Channel、内部器件、面板结构、包胶与验证作为一个受控产品整体定义。

introduction.en: USB Cable Assembly Signal & Power Map
introduction.zh: USB 电缆组件信号与供电图谱

faq.zh: USB 电缆组件常见问题

copy.en: USB 2.0 remains common in printers, instruments, embedded controllers, service ports and low-speed control. Type-A, Type-B, Mini and Micro formats may carry data and power, power only or an application-specific circuit.
copy.zh: USB 2.0 仍常见于打印机、仪器、嵌入式控制器、维护接口和低速控制。Type-A、Type-B、Mini 与 Micro 可能承载数据加供电、仅供电或设备专用回路。

copy.en: Plug or receptacle, mating face, equipment port and available clearance are recorded before the cable is defined.
copy.zh: 应在定义线缆前记录插头或插座、插合面、设备接口与可用空间。

title.en: Shape does not prove the wiring

copy.en: A familiar connector does not confirm that every data, power or identification contact is populated in the expected way.
copy.zh: 熟悉的接口并不能证明所有数据、供电或识别触点都按常规方式连接。

copy.en: Type-C describes a reversible connector system, not a fixed performance level. USB 2.0 Type-C, full-featured data cables, charging-only leads and electronically marked assemblies use different internal constructions.
copy.zh: Type-C 描述可翻转接口系统，不代表固定性能等级。USB 2.0 Type-C、全功能数据线、仅供电线与带电子标记组件采用不同内部结构。

copy.en: Source, sink, host, device and dual-role behavior affect the required connection and validation plan.
copy.zh: 供电端、受电端、主机、设备与双角色行为都会影响连接与验证计划。

title.en: Do not infer speed or power
title.zh: 不能按外形推断速率或功率

copy.en: Capability is established by the complete cable, internal components, equipment and applicable specification.
copy.zh: 能力取决于完整线缆、内部器件、双方设备与适用规范。

copy.en: High-speed USB can add shielded differential lanes beyond the basic USB 2.0 pair. Conductor geometry, dielectric, pair balance, length, shield structure, connector transition and bending all influence channel margin.
copy.zh: 高速 USB 可在基础 USB 2.0 差分对之外增加屏蔽高速通道。导体几何、绝缘介质、对内平衡、长度、屏蔽结构、连接器过渡与弯曲都会影响链路裕量。

title.en: Continuity is not a data test

copy.en: Point-to-point continuity cannot reveal insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk or marginal terminations.
copy.zh: 点对点导通不能发现插入损耗、回损、串扰或处于边界状态的端接。

copy.en: Excessive untwist, flattening, sharp bends and uncontrolled molding near the connector can disturb the channel.
copy.zh: 连接器附近过度解绞、压扁、急弯与失控包胶可能扰动高速通道。

copy.en: Panel extensions and compact equipment leads are defined around the opening, flange or fixing hardware, internal connector, cable route and service access. Straight and angled exits change the mechanical envelope and assembly order.
copy.zh: 面板延长与紧凑设备线需要围绕开孔、法兰或固定件、内部接口、线缆路径与维护空间定义。直出与弯式出线会改变机械包络与装配顺序。

copy.en: Left, right, up and down bends are stated relative to a visible mating-face reference, not a loose verbal description.
copy.zh: 左弯、右弯、上弯和下弯应相对清晰插合面基准定义，不能只靠口头描述。

copy.en: Panel thickness, screw access, adjacent ports, rear clearance and bend radius form one installation system.
copy.zh: 面板厚度、螺钉操作、邻近接口、后部空间和弯曲半径共同构成安装系统。

copy.en: Orders should name the connector family, plug or receptacle, orientation and mating part. Similar Mini, Micro or proprietary camera interfaces can appear close in size while remaining mechanically and electrically incompatible.
copy.zh: 订单应明确接口家族、插头或插座、方向与对插件。相似 Mini、Micro 或相机专用接口可能尺寸接近，却在机械与电气上不兼容。

copy.en: A focused mating face, side profile, equipment port and cable exit reveal more than one distant product photograph.
copy.zh: 清晰插合面、侧面、设备端口与出线方向，比一张远距离产品图更有价值。

copy.en: Samples and part numbers help prevent a visually similar but non-mating selection.
copy.zh: 样品与料号有助于避免选择外观相似却无法插合的接口。

copy.en: A USB lead may terminate in a board connector, circular connector, loose wires or a proprietary service plug. If protocol conversion, identification resistors or active electronics are present, the assembly becomes an electrical product rather than a passive wire map.
copy.zh: USB 线可连接板端、圆形接口、散线或专用维护插头。若含协议转换、识别电阻或有源电子器件，组件就不再只是被动针脚映射，而是完整电气产品。

copy.en: Circuit, firmware, driver, logic levels and operating-system responsibility are defined when conversion electronics are involved.
copy.zh: 涉及转换电子器件时，需要明确电路、固件、驱动、逻辑电平与操作系统责任。

copy.en: Equipment model, socket, pin map and function are confirmed instead of copying connector color or cable appearance.
copy.zh: 应确认设备型号、插座、针脚与功能，不能照着接口颜色或线缆外观仿制。

title.zh: 批准的标准与固定线配置

copy.en: Type-A to Type-B, Type-A to Micro, Type-A to Type-C and Type-C to Type-C are only mechanical descriptions. A complete configuration states generation, data lanes, power, device roles, directionality and any captive or proprietary constraint.
copy.zh: Type-A 到 Type-B、Type-A 到 Micro、Type-A 到 Type-C 与 Type-C 到 Type-C 只是机械描述。完整配置还要说明代际、数据通道、供电、设备角色、方向性以及固定线或专用限制。

copy.en: A cable that physically mates is not automatically a standards-compliant or safe extension for another product.
copy.zh: 能够物理插合的线缆，不自动意味着它是另一产品合规且安全的延长方案。

copy.en: Labels, color, molded marks and packaging distinguish products that share an appearance but not capability.
copy.zh: 标签、颜色、模压标识与包装可区分外形相同但能力不同的产品。

title.zh: 电源导体、差分对与屏蔽

copy.en: VBUS and ground are selected for current, length, allowable voltage drop, temperature and terminal range. Data pairs require controlled geometry, while foil, braid and drain arrangements need a deliberate connection to the connector shell or specified ground.
copy.zh: VBUS 与地线要结合电流、长度、允许压降、温度和端子范围选择；数据差分对需要受控几何，而箔、编织与排流线还要有意连接到连接器外壳或规定接地点。

title.zh: 粗导体会改变机械性能

copy.en: Lower resistance can increase cable diameter, bend stiffness, termination space and molding pressure.
copy.zh: 降低电阻可能增加线缆外径、弯曲刚度、端接空间与包胶压力。

title.en: Shield presence is not shield continuity
title.zh: 有屏蔽材料不等于屏蔽连续

copy.en: The electrical path across braid, foil, drain, shell and equipment ground must be defined and inspected.
copy.zh: 编织、箔、排流线、外壳与设备地之间的电气路径需要定义并检查。

title.zh: 端子、焊接与连接器小板

copy.en: Compact USB connectors may use stamped terminals, solder joints, flex circuits or small printed boards. Strip length, heat input, solder quantity, pair untwist, shield preparation, board support and insulation clearance are controlled together.
copy.zh: 紧凑 USB 接头可采用冲压端子、焊点、柔性电路或小型 PCB。剥线长度、热输入、焊料量、差分对解绞、屏蔽准备、板件支撑与绝缘距离需要一起控制。

copy.en: Excess heat or solder wicking can create a rigid transition that fails under repeated cable movement.
copy.zh: 热量过大或爬锡会形成刚性过渡，在反复摆动下更易失效。

copy.en: Pin map, polarity, soldering, shield path and component orientation are verified before the assembly becomes inaccessible.
copy.zh: 在结构被包胶遮蔽前，需要检查针脚、极性、焊接、屏蔽路径与器件方向。

title.en: CC, electronic marking and internal electronics
title.zh: CC、电子标记与内部电子器件

copy.en: Some Type-C and conversion assemblies include Configuration Channel components, electronic markers, controllers or protection devices. Component identity, programming, orientation, thermal path and functional checks become part of the released BOM and process.
copy.zh: 部分 Type-C 与转换组件包含 Configuration Channel 元件、电子标记、控制器或保护器件。器件身份、程序、方向、散热路径与功能检查都要纳入受控 BOM 与工艺。

title.en: An e-marker is not a label
title.zh: 电子标记不是普通标签

copy.en: It is an internal electronic function whose declared capability must agree with the real cable construction.
copy.zh: 它是内部电子功能，所声明能力必须与真实线缆结构一致。

copy.en: Chip, firmware, passive network and test fixture revisions require traceable change control.
copy.zh: 芯片、固件、无源网络与测试工装的版本变化都需要可追溯变更控制。

title.zh: 外壳、绝缘体与触点结构

copy.en: Connector shells guide mating and can support shielding; inserts position contacts; contacts carry power and signals. Plating, retention, terminal range, coplanarity and mating wear affect a cable far beyond its visible exterior.
copy.zh: 连接器外壳负责导向并可承载屏蔽，绝缘体定位触点，触点传输电源与信号。镀层、保持、端子线径范围、共面度与插拔磨损都会影响成品，而这些并不完全体现在外观。

copy.en: Housing, contact, conductor and tool are selected as one qualified termination system.
copy.zh: 壳体、触点、导体与工装需要作为一个兼容端接系统选择。

copy.en: Molding, adhesive and handling must not contaminate, distort or preload the connector interface.
copy.zh: 包胶、胶粘与操作不能污染、扭曲或预加载接口插合区域。

copy.en: Overmolding can create grip, bend transition, orientation and protection, but it must match jacket adhesion, connector support, internal components, pressure, temperature and the intended cable route. The transition should bend progressively rather than at one sharp point.
copy.zh: 包胶可形成握持、弯曲过渡、方向识别与防护，但要匹配护套粘接、接头支撑、内部器件、压力、温度与预期走线路径。过渡区域应逐渐弯曲，而不是集中在一个尖锐点。

copy.en: A short, stiff boot may look robust yet transfer bending directly into the first unsupported conductor section.
copy.zh: 短而硬的尾套外观看似坚固，却可能把弯曲直接传到第一段无支撑导体。

title.en: Molding is not an ingress rating

copy.en: Ingress performance belongs to the complete connector, enclosure, cable and test configuration.
copy.zh: 防护性能属于完整接口、机壳、线缆与测试配置，不能只凭包胶判断。

copy.en: Every released assembly is checked against the approved circuit map. Test coverage can include continuity, shorts, polarity, shield and shell connection, component state, resistance or voltage drop, dimensions, labels and mating.
copy.zh: 每条放行组件都应对照批准回路检查。测试可覆盖导通、短路、极性、屏蔽与外壳连接、器件状态、电阻或压降、尺寸、标签与插合。

copy.en: A dedicated mating fixture protects connectors and checks every populated, reserved and linked circuit consistently.
copy.zh: 专用对插工装可保护接口，并一致检查所有已用、预留与内部短接回路。

copy.en: Pass limits follow conductor length, current duty, components and measurement method rather than a generic cable-test setting.
copy.zh: 合格限值应依据导体长度、电流负载、内部器件与测量方法，而不是套用通用线测参数。

title.zh: 数据、协商与系统级验证

copy.en: When project risk requires it, validation extends beyond wiring to real data transfer, negotiation behavior, protocol or electrical measurements and operation with representative equipment. The method and acceptance boundary are agreed before production release.
copy.zh: 当项目风险需要时，验证会从接线延伸到真实数据传输、协商行为、协议或电气测量以及代表性设备运行。方法与验收边界应在量产放行前约定。

copy.en: Cable, source, sink or host, adapters, length and operating mode should represent the actual installation.
copy.zh: 线缆、供电端、受电端或主机、转接件、长度与运行模式应代表真实安装。

copy.en: A functional transfer check does not automatically establish compliance, full channel margin or every supported alternate mode.
copy.zh: 一次功能传输检查不能自动证明合规、完整链路裕量或所有替代模式能力。

copy.en: Rain, spray, condensation, dust and cleaning chemistry act on the complete installed interface. A sealed cover, panel gasket, connector, cable jacket, molding and mounting orientation must work together; a molded plug alone does not establish an IP rating.
copy.zh: 暴雨、喷淋、冷凝、粉尘与清洁化学品作用于完整安装接口。密封盖、面板密封、连接器、线缆护套、包胶与安装方向需要共同工作；单个包胶插头不能证明 IP 等级。

title.zh: 定义插合与未插合状态

copy.en: Protection may differ while connected, capped, open for service or mounted in another orientation.
copy.zh: 接口在插合、盖帽、维护打开或改变安装方向时，防护状态可能不同。

copy.en: Test method, exposure, duration, mounting and post-test electrical checks are specified for the actual product claim.
copy.zh: 应针对实际产品声明规定测试方法、暴露条件、持续时间、安装状态与试后电气检查。

title.en: From approved sample to controlled batches
title.zh: 从批准样品到受控批次

copy.en: The first article freezes the interface, pin map, cable, components, molding, dimensions, markings, packaging and test plan. Approved drawings, BOM, process settings and inspection records then control later production rather than appearance alone.
copy.zh: 首件冻结接口、针脚、线缆、器件、包胶、尺寸、标识、包装与测试计划。批准图纸、BOM、工艺设定和检验记录随后用于控制批次，而不是只按外观复制。

copy.en: Part number and label must distinguish cables with different speed, power, direction or internal electronics.
copy.zh: 料号与标签必须区分速率、功率、方向或内部电子器件不同的线缆。

copy.en: Connector, cable, component, resin, tool or process substitutions are assessed against the original electrical and mechanical requirements.
copy.zh: 连接器、线缆、器件、树脂、工装或工艺替代都应对照原始电气与机械要求审核。

q.en: Does every Type-C cable support high-speed data and high power?
q.zh: 所有 Type-C 电缆都支持高速数据和大功率吗？

a.en: No. Type-C identifies the connector system. Data lanes, power duty, Configuration Channel wiring, electronic marking, directionality and equipment capability determine the usable functions.
a.zh: 不能。Type-C 只识别接口系统，实际功能取决于数据通道、供电负载、Configuration Channel 接线、电子标记、方向性与双方设备能力。

q.en: Does passing continuity prove a high-speed USB cable is good?
q.zh: 导通合格能证明高速 USB 电缆性能吗？

a.en: No. Continuity proves point-to-point connection. High-speed performance also depends on impedance, loss, crosstalk, termination, length, bending and the complete channel.
a.zh: 不能。导通只证明点对点连接，高速性能还取决于阻抗、损耗、串扰、端接、长度、弯曲与完整链路。

q.en: Can you build a charging-only cable?
q.zh: 可以制作仅供电 USB 线吗？

a.en: Yes, when the required identification, CC or other circuits, current, voltage drop, temperature rise and misuse controls are explicitly defined and approved.
a.zh: 可以，但必须明确并批准所需识别、CC 或其他回路、电流、压降、温升以及防误用措施。

q.en: Can overmolding make a USB cable waterproof?
q.zh: 包胶能让 USB 电缆防水吗？

a.en: Not by itself. Ingress protection depends on the complete mated connector, enclosure, panel seal, cable, molding, mounting direction and defined test method.
a.zh: 不能单独判断。防护取决于完整插合接口、机壳、面板密封、线缆、包胶、安装方向与规定测试方法。

q.en: Can a sample be copied without drawings?
q.zh: 没有图纸可以按样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support dimensional and visible-circuit mapping, but hidden electronics, USB capability, ratings, materials, intellectual-property responsibility and equipment behavior still require confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可以帮助整理尺寸与可见回路，但隐藏电子器件、USB 能力、额定、材料、知识产权责任与设备行为仍需确认。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both endpoints, mating devices, required USB generation and functions, data and power duty, pin map, length, panel and bend direction, shielding, jacket, molding, environment, quantity, labels and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供两端接口、对插设备、所需 USB 代际与功能、数据与供电要求、针脚、长度、面板与弯式方向、屏蔽、护套、包胶、环境、数量、标签和验证要求。

intro.en: Audio cable assemblies connect microphones, instruments, mixers, amplifiers, loudspeakers, broadcast equipment and installed AV systems. XLR, TRS, TS, RCA, 3.5 mm, multipin and equipment-specific ends can carry balanced or unbalanced analog audio, digital audio, control or combined circuits; the finished cable is defined by the complete signal path, not the connector name alone.
intro.zh: 音频电缆组件用于连接麦克风、乐器、调音台、功放、扬声器、广播设备与固定式音视频系统。XLR、TRS、TS、RCA、3.5 mm、多芯及设备专用接口可承载平衡或非平衡模拟音频、数字音频、控制或复合回路；真正定义成品的是完整信号路径，而不只是接口名称。

knowledge.en: Microphone, line, instrument and speaker circuits operate at different levels and impedances. Pair geometry, conductor resistance, capacitance, shield coverage, ground strategy, connector wiring, cable length and installation environment therefore need to be reviewed together.
knowledge.zh: 麦克风、线路、乐器与扬声器回路具有不同的信号电平和阻抗。双绞结构、导体电阻、电容、屏蔽覆盖、接地策略、接口接线、线长与安装环境需要共同审核。

notes.en: Provide both equipment endpoints, connector sex and orientation, signal type and level, balanced or unbalanced wiring, pin map, channel count, length, flexibility, shield and grounding requirements, installation method, quantity and validation boundary.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口公母与方向、信号类型和电平、平衡或非平衡接线、针脚、通道数、长度、柔软性、屏蔽与接地要求、安装方式、数量和验证边界。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the circuit map, cable construction, shield termination, connector hardware, branch lengths, labels and strain relief before the first build. Released production is checked for continuity, shorts, polarity, shield path, dimensions, identification and workmanship, with channel or equipment-level tests added where specified.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结回路、线缆结构、屏蔽端接、接口硬件、分支长度、标识与应力消除。量产按要求检查导通、短路、极性、屏蔽路径、尺寸、标识和工艺，并在项目指定时增加通道或设备级测试。

subtitle.en: Interfaces, signal levels, cable construction and production control
subtitle.zh: 接口、信号电平、线缆结构与生产控制

lead.en: An audio lead can look simple while carrying a low-level microphone signal, a high-impedance instrument output, balanced line audio, loudspeaker power, digital audio or several channels in one trunk. We develop the interface, circuit, cable, shielding, mechanics and inspection plan as one documented assembly so the result fits the real equipment and working environment.
lead.zh: 一条音频线外观看似简单，内部可能承载低电平麦克风信号、高阻抗乐器输出、平衡线路信号、扬声器功率、数字音频，或在一条主干中集合多个通道。我们把接口、回路、线缆、屏蔽、机械结构与检验计划作为一个有文件控制的完整组件开发，使成品真正匹配设备与使用环境。

introduction.zh: 音频电缆组件信号路径

faq.zh: 音频电缆组件常见问题

title.en: From simple patch leads to equipment harnesses
title.zh: 从单路线到设备专用线束

copy.en: The category includes single-channel patch leads, stereo breakouts, microphone and instrument cables, insert cables, panel extensions, multicore snakes, fan-outs and mixed-interface equipment harnesses. Length, channel identity, connector orientation and service access are developed around the installation.
copy.zh: 这一小类覆盖单通道跳线、立体声分线、麦克风线、乐器线、插入线、面板延长线、多通道主缆、一分多及混合接口设备线束。长度、通道标识、接口方向和维护空间都围绕实际安装开发。

copy.en: Straight, angled, panel, locking, molded, braided, coiled and breakout constructions can share the same audio function but require different mechanics.
copy.zh: 直式、弯式、面板式、锁紧式、包胶、编织、弹簧线与分支结构可能承担相同音频功能，却需要不同机械设计。

copy.en: Connector photos, mating equipment and pin documents prevent a familiar shell from being wired for the wrong convention.
copy.zh: 接口照片、对插设备和针脚资料可以避免把熟悉外壳按错误规范接线。

title.en: XLR and TRS balanced signal paths
title.zh: XLR 与 TRS 平衡信号路径

copy.en: Balanced audio uses two signal conductors referenced as a pair, normally with a separate shield or screen. Cable pair symmetry and the receiving input's common-mode rejection help reduce coupled interference; connector type alone does not create a balanced circuit.
copy.zh: 平衡音频以一对信号导体传输，通常另配独立屏蔽层。线对对称性与接收端共模抑制共同降低耦合干扰；仅使用某种接口并不会自动形成平衡回路。

copy.en: Hot, cold, shield, shell and any chassis bond are stated in the approved circuit map rather than inferred from cable color.
copy.zh: 热端、冷端、屏蔽、外壳及机壳连接应写入批准回路，不能按线色推断。

copy.en: Untwist, conductor separation and shield removal are kept short near the termination to preserve balance and noise performance.
copy.zh: 端接附近的解绞、导体分离和屏蔽剥离长度应尽量受控，以保持平衡与抗噪表现。

copy.en: Unbalanced circuits commonly use one signal conductor and a return or shield. They are practical for short consumer, instrument and equipment interconnects, but shared returns, long runs and noisy environments can expose hum, interference or crosstalk.
copy.zh: 非平衡回路通常使用一根信号导体和回线或屏蔽层，适合较短的消费电子、乐器和设备连接；但公共回线、长距离或强干扰环境更容易暴露嗡声、干扰与串扰问题。

title.en: Stereo is not the same as balanced

copy.en: A three-contact TRS connector may carry stereo unbalanced audio, mono balanced audio, an insert send/return or another proprietary circuit.
copy.zh: 三触点 TRS 接口可能承载非平衡立体声、平衡单声道、插入发送/返回或其他专用回路。

copy.en: XLR-to-RCA or TRS-to-TS cannot be released from names alone; source and destination topology determine how unused and shield contacts are handled.
copy.zh: XLR 转 RCA 或 TRS 转 TS 不能仅凭名称制作，源端与目标端电路结构决定未用触点和屏蔽如何处理。

title.en: Microphone, instrument, line and speaker circuits
title.zh: 麦克风、乐器、线路与扬声器回路

copy.en: These signal classes place very different demands on noise, capacitance, conductor resistance, current capacity and connector choice. A cable suitable for a line-level interconnect is not automatically suitable for a passive guitar pickup, a low-level microphone or a power amplifier output.
copy.zh: 这些信号类型对噪声、电容、导体电阻、电流能力与接口选择提出完全不同的要求。适合线路级连接的线缆，并不自动适合被动吉他拾音器、低电平麦克风或功放输出。

copy.en: Shielding, pair construction, handling noise, routing and connector contact condition become critical as signal level falls.
copy.zh: 信号电平越低，屏蔽、线对结构、摩擦噪声、走线与触点状态越关键。

copy.en: Conductor size, length, resistance, temperature and termination are selected for the amplifier and load; a microphone lead is not a speaker cable.
copy.zh: 导体线径、长度、电阻、温度与端接应匹配功放和负载；麦克风线不能代替扬声器线。

title.en: Multicore trunks, snakes and breakout looms
title.zh: 多芯主缆、舞台盒与分支线束

copy.en: Multichannel assemblies reduce installation time by grouping many individually identified circuits into one trunk. Pair count, channel order, breakout length, fan-out protection, shared shield policy and connector panel geometry are defined before production.
copy.zh: 多通道组件把多个独立标识回路集合进一条主干，可减少现场安装时间。对数、通道顺序、分支长度、扇出保护、公共屏蔽策略与接口面板几何都需要在生产前定义。

copy.en: Sleeving, boots, heat-shrink, clamps and staggered exits distribute bending and pull away from delicate terminations.
copy.zh: 套管、尾套、热缩、夹持与错位出线把弯曲和拉力从脆弱端接处分散开。

copy.en: Permanent labels at both ends, leg length references and a pin-to-channel schedule reduce installation and troubleshooting errors.
copy.zh: 两端永久标识、分支长度基准和针脚到通道表可减少安装与排障错误。

copy.en: Copper conductor construction is selected for electrical resistance and flexing. Insulation and jacket materials are reviewed for diameter, flexibility, abrasion, temperature, oils and installation method. Foil, braid, spiral and drain-wire shields offer different coverage, flexibility and termination behavior.
copy.zh: 铜导体结构根据电阻与弯曲工况选择；绝缘和护套则结合外径、柔软性、耐磨、温度、油污与安装方式审核。铝箔、编织、缠绕与排流线屏蔽在覆盖率、柔软性和端接方式上各不相同。

title.en: Shield path is a system decision

copy.en: One-end, both-end, shell or chassis connections follow the approved equipment grounding architecture, not a universal recipe.
copy.zh: 单端、双端、外壳或机壳连接应服从批准的设备接地架构，不存在适用于所有系统的固定做法。

copy.en: Strand count, conductor lay, fillers, shields and jacket hardness all influence handling, coil memory and repeated flex life.
copy.zh: 股数、绞距、填充、屏蔽与护套硬度共同影响手感、盘绕记忆和反复弯曲寿命。

title.en: Contacts, plating, soldering and strain relief
title.zh: 触点、镀层、焊接与应力消除

copy.en: Connector shell, contact material and finish, cable clamp, boot and exit direction are selected as one mechanical system. Gold finish can support corrosion resistance and low-level contact reliability, but it does not replace correct contact force, clean mating surfaces or suitable base materials.
copy.zh: 连接器外壳、触点材料与镀层、线夹、尾套和出线方向应作为一个机械系统选择。金表面有助于耐腐蚀和低电平触点可靠性，但不能替代正确接触力、清洁插合面和合适基材。

copy.en: Strip length, solder quantity and dwell are controlled so insulation is not damaged and a long rigid section is not created behind the contact.
copy.zh: 剥线长度、焊料量与停留时间需要受控，避免损伤绝缘或在触点后形成过长刚性段。

title.en: Clamp the jacket, not the cores

copy.en: A correct strain relief transfers pull and bending into the connector body while preserving the conductors and shield termination.
copy.zh: 正确应力消除把拉力与弯曲传递到接头主体，同时保护导体和屏蔽端接。

title.en: Flexing, coiling and installed cable management

copy.en: Touring leads, studio patch cables and equipment harnesses fail in different ways. Bend radius, torsion, stepping, repeated coiling, clamp spacing and storage method are considered with the conductor lay and jacket so the cable survives its real duty cycle.
copy.zh: 巡演线、录音室跳线与设备线束具有不同失效模式。弯曲半径、扭转、踩踏、反复盘绕、夹持间距与存放方式应结合导体绞合和护套一起考虑，使线缆适应真实工况。

copy.en: Boot length and stiffness should create a progressive transition instead of concentrating motion immediately behind the connector.
copy.zh: 尾套长度与硬度应形成渐进过渡，避免把全部运动集中在接口后方一点。

copy.en: Physical separation from power wiring, transformers, motors and switching equipment can be as important as the cable shield itself.
copy.zh: 与电源线、变压器、电机和开关设备保持物理距离，可能与线缆屏蔽本身同样重要。

title.en: Home studios, broadcast rooms and AV systems
title.zh: 家庭录音室、广播机房与音视频系统

copy.en: Compact studios need short, low-noise and clearly identified interconnects; broadcast and installed systems may add patch panels, equipment racks, long routes and controlled channel documentation. Panel openings, service loops and replacement access become part of the assembly definition.
copy.zh: 紧凑录音空间需要短、低噪且标识清晰的互连；广播与固定安装系统还可能加入跳线盘、设备机柜、长距离布线与受控通道文件。面板开孔、检修余量和更换空间都应成为组件定义的一部分。

title.zh: 区分固定布线与维护跳线

copy.en: Installed trunks emphasize routing and documentation, while frequently handled patch leads emphasize flexibility and connector strain relief.
copy.zh: 固定主干更重视走线和文件，频繁操作的跳线则更重视柔软性与接头应力消除。

copy.en: Channel, source, destination, length group and revision markings make dense systems easier to install and maintain.
copy.zh: 通道、源端、目标端、长度组与版本标识让密集系统更易安装和维护。

copy.en: Live sound assemblies face rapid setup, dark working areas, repeated coiling, foot traffic and uncertain routing. Robust connectors, visible channel identification, flexible low-memory jackets and repairable or replaceable breakouts can matter more than cosmetic finish.
copy.zh: 现场扩声组件面对快速搭建、昏暗环境、反复盘绕、人员踩踏与不确定走线。坚固接口、醒目通道标识、低记忆柔性护套，以及可维修或可更换分支，往往比表面装饰更重要。

copy.en: Color rings, readable leg labels, keyed connectors and practical breakout lengths reduce errors under time pressure.
copy.zh: 色环、清晰分支标签、防误插接口与实用分支长度可减少时间压力下的错误。

copy.en: Pull, bend, crush, abrasion and mating-cycle expectations are documented so protection and validation match actual use.
copy.zh: 拉力、弯曲、挤压、磨损与插拔次数预期应形成文件，使防护和验证匹配真实使用。

title.en: AES3, S/PDIF and hybrid signal integration

copy.en: Digital audio may use familiar XLR or coaxial connectors while requiring a defined transmission line and equipment-specific impedance. Analog, digital, control and power can coexist in a larger harness only when pair assignment, shielding, separation and grounding are deliberately engineered.
copy.zh: 数字音频可能使用熟悉的 XLR 或同轴接口，却要求明确的传输线结构与设备阻抗。模拟、数字、控制和电源可共存于更大的线束中，但必须有意设计线对分配、屏蔽、隔离与接地。

title.en: A matching connector is not enough

copy.en: Cable impedance, length, connector transition and termination affect reflections and link margin even when continuity passes.
copy.zh: 即使导通合格，线缆阻抗、长度、接口过渡与终端仍会影响反射和链路裕量。

copy.en: Signal class, pair, return, shield and reference are scheduled so future service does not convert a controlled harness into guesswork.
copy.zh: 应记录信号类型、线对、回线、屏蔽与参考，使后续维护不会把受控线束变成猜测。

title.zh: 样品、检验与可重复生产

copy.en: A prototype confirms fit, wiring, channel order, handling and equipment behavior before batch release. The approved drawing, BOM, cut lengths, process settings, visual samples, labels and test plan then become the production reference instead of relying on one physical sample alone.
copy.zh: 样品在批量放行前确认装配、接线、通道顺序、操作手感与设备表现。随后由批准图纸、BOM、裁线长度、工艺参数、外观样、标签和测试计划共同形成生产基准，而不是只依赖一条实物样品。

copy.en: Continuity, shorts, polarity, shield and component checks confirm construction; audio or system tests are added when they are part of the agreed acceptance boundary.
copy.zh: 导通、短路、极性、屏蔽与器件检查用于确认结构；若属于约定验收边界，再增加音频或系统测试。

copy.en: Cable, connector, plating, material, tool or process substitutions are reviewed against the released electrical and mechanical requirements.
copy.zh: 线缆、接口、镀层、材料、工装或工艺替代都应对照已放行的电气与机械要求审核。

q.en: Does an XLR connector always mean balanced audio?
q.zh: 使用 XLR 接口就一定是平衡音频吗？

a.en: No. XLR describes a connector family. The equipment circuits, pin assignment, cable pair and shield termination determine whether the path is balanced.
a.zh: 不一定。XLR 描述的是接口家族，是否平衡取决于设备电路、针脚定义、线对与屏蔽端接。

q.en: Is a TRS cable always stereo?
q.zh: TRS 线一定是立体声吗？

a.en: No. TRS can carry stereo unbalanced audio, mono balanced audio, insert send/return or a proprietary circuit. Confirm both equipment endpoints and the pin map.
a.zh: 不一定。TRS 可以承载非平衡立体声、平衡单声道、插入发送/返回或专用回路，必须确认两端设备和针脚。

q.en: Can microphone cable be used for loudspeakers?
q.zh: 麦克风线可以用作扬声器线吗？

a.en: It should not be assumed. Loudspeaker circuits can require much larger conductors and different current, temperature and connector considerations than low-level microphone paths.
a.zh: 不能直接假设可以。扬声器回路通常需要更大的导体，并具有不同的电流、温度与接口要求。

q.en: Does gold plating improve sound quality?
q.zh: 镀金会直接提升音质吗？

a.en: Gold finish can improve corrosion resistance and contact stability in suitable contact systems. Audio performance still depends on the complete circuit, contact force, cleanliness, cable and equipment.
a.zh: 合适触点系统中的金表面可改善耐腐蚀与接触稳定性，但音频表现仍取决于完整回路、接触力、清洁度、线缆与设备。

q.en: Can you develop from an existing audio cable sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有音频线样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample can support dimensions, visible wiring and construction review. Hidden materials, electrical ratings, exact shield strategy, equipment behavior and intellectual-property responsibility still require confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可辅助整理尺寸、可见接线与结构，但隐藏材料、电气额定、具体屏蔽策略、设备表现和知识产权责任仍需确认。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both devices and interfaces, connector sex and orientation, signal class and level, balanced or unbalanced wiring, channel and pin map, cable and branch lengths, flexibility, shielding and ground requirements, environment, quantity, labels and validation needs.
a.zh: 请提供两端设备与接口、接口公母和方向、信号类型与电平、平衡或非平衡接线、通道和针脚、线缆与分支长度、柔软性、屏蔽和接地要求、环境、数量、标签与验证需求。

intro.en: Video cable assemblies connect cameras, displays, switchers, recorders, control rooms, industrial panels and imaging equipment. HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI, VGA, BNC/coaxial and equipment-specific interfaces may look familiar, but bandwidth, impedance, pair geometry, shielding, cable length, power and mechanical installation determine the finished assembly.
intro.zh: 视频电缆组件用于连接摄像机、显示器、切换台、录像设备、控制室、工业面板与成像设备。HDMI、DisplayPort、DVI、VGA、BNC/同轴及设备专用接口外形可能很熟悉，但真正定义成品的是带宽、阻抗、线对几何、屏蔽、线长、供电与机械安装。

knowledge.en: A connector family does not prove a resolution, refresh rate or transmission distance. The source, sink, coding mode, cable category, conductor or optical construction, equalization and full installation path must be reviewed as one link.
knowledge.zh: 接口家族并不能单独证明分辨率、刷新率或传输距离。信号源、接收端、编码模式、线缆类别、铜缆或光缆结构、均衡方式与完整安装路径必须作为一条链路共同审核。

notes.en: Provide both devices, connector type and orientation, video protocol, target format and refresh rate, color depth or chroma requirement, audio/control channels, cable and branch lengths, installation route, bend and flex conditions, shielding or grounding constraints, quantity and validation method.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口类型与方向、视频协议、目标格式与刷新率、色深或色度采样要求、音频/控制通道、线缆与分支长度、安装路径、弯曲与运动工况、屏蔽或接地限制、数量及验证方法。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface map, cable construction, pair or coax assignment, shield termination, directionality, active components, overmold or backshell, labels and inspection limits before release. Production checks wiring, shorts, shield paths, dimensions and workmanship; agreed link or equipment tests are added where continuity alone is insufficient.
delivery.zh: 工程在放行前冻结接口映射、线缆结构、线对或同轴分配、屏蔽端接、方向性、有源器件、包胶或后壳、标识与检验限值。生产检查接线、短路、屏蔽路径、尺寸和工艺；当导通不足以证明性能时，再按约定增加链路或设备测试。

subtitle.en: Interfaces, link budget, construction and validation
subtitle.zh: 接口、链路裕量、结构与验证

lead.en: Video interconnects range from short passive display leads to coaxial broadcast runs, active optical links, panel extensions and mixed video-control harnesses. We define each assembly from the complete source-to-display path, then turn bandwidth, impedance, shielding, direction, mechanics and inspection into controlled production information.
lead.zh: 视频互连从短距离无源显示线、广播同轴线，到有源光纤链路、面板延长线与视频控制复合线束，结构差异很大。我们从完整的信号源到显示端路径定义组件，再把带宽、阻抗、屏蔽、方向、机械结构与检验要求转化为受控生产资料。

introduction.zh: 从完整视频链路开始定义

faq.zh: 视频电缆组件常见问题

title.en: Display, camera, panel and equipment-specific assemblies
title.zh: 显示、摄像、面板与设备专用组件

copy.en: The category includes HDMI and DisplayPort leads, DVI and VGA legacy links, BNC coaxial assemblies, camera and monitor tails, panel-mount extensions, breakout looms and mixed-interface harnesses. Straight, angled, locking, molded and serviceable backshells solve different installation problems even when the signal function is similar.
copy.zh: 这一小类包括 HDMI 与 DisplayPort 线、DVI 与 VGA 传统链路、BNC 同轴组件、摄像机和显示器尾线、面板安装延长线、分支线束与混合接口线束。即使信号功能相近，直式、弯式、锁紧式、包胶式与可维修后壳也分别解决不同安装问题。

copy.en: Mating-face photos, device model, plug or receptacle, keying and exit direction prevent a familiar shell from being specified incorrectly.
copy.zh: 插合面照片、设备型号、插头或插座、键位与出线方向可以避免把熟悉外壳定义错误。

copy.en: A matching connector does not by itself establish supported format, bandwidth, direction or power behavior.
copy.zh: 接口能够插合，并不能单独证明支持的格式、带宽、方向或供电行为。

title.en: HDMI and DisplayPort are controlled transmission links
title.zh: HDMI 与 DisplayPort 是受控传输链路

copy.en: High-speed display cables use tightly controlled differential channels plus auxiliary, clock, configuration or power conductors. Pair impedance, intra-pair skew, insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk, shield continuity and connector transition all contribute to link margin; pin-to-pin continuity is only a construction check.
copy.zh: 高速显示线使用受控差分通道，并包含辅助、时钟、配置或供电导体。线对阻抗、对内时延、插入损耗、回损、串扰、屏蔽连续性与接口过渡共同决定链路裕量；点对点导通只是结构检查。

copy.en: Excessive untwist, separation, flattening, tight bends or uncontrolled molding can disturb the highest-speed portion of the assembly.
copy.zh: 过度解绞、线对分离、压扁、急弯或失控包胶都会扰动组件中最敏感的高速区域。

copy.en: Conductor size, dielectric, shield construction and finished length are selected together for the required certified or project-specific performance class.
copy.zh: 导体线径、绝缘介质、屏蔽结构与成品长度需要一起选择，以匹配所需认证或项目性能等级。

title.en: BNC, SDI and equipment coaxial paths

copy.en: Professional video and imaging systems often use coaxial cable with BNC or equipment-specific connectors. Characteristic impedance, cable attenuation, connector launch, shield coverage, bend damage and installed length affect the signal reaching the receiver; a generic RF-looking cable is not automatically suitable for a specified SDI link.
copy.zh: 专业视频与成像系统常使用配 BNC 或设备专用接口的同轴电缆。特性阻抗、线缆衰减、接口过渡、屏蔽覆盖、弯折损伤与安装长度都会影响接收端信号；外观看起来像射频线，并不代表一定适合指定 SDI 链路。

copy.en: Strip dimensions, dielectric support, braid preparation and crimp or solder process must preserve the coaxial transition.
copy.zh: 剥线尺寸、介质支撑、编织准备及压接或焊接工艺应保持同轴过渡。

title.en: Treat length as an electrical value

copy.en: Allowable reach depends on format, cable type, loss, connector count, routing and receiver capability, not a universal distance claim.
copy.zh: 允许距离取决于格式、线缆类型、损耗、接口数量、走线和接收端能力，不能套用统一距离。

title.en: Resolution is only one part of the requirement
title.zh: 分辨率只是需求的一部分

copy.en: Two installations described as 4K can require different data rates because refresh rate, color depth, chroma format, compression, blanking and protocol mode differ. Audio return, content protection, control channels, multi-display functions and equipment firmware can also change the acceptance boundary.
copy.zh: 两套都称为 4K 的系统，可能因刷新率、色深、色度格式、压缩、消隐与协议模式不同而需要完全不同的数据率。音频回传、内容保护、控制通道、多屏功能与设备固件也会改变验收边界。

copy.en: Source and display models plus the required format are more useful than a resolution label printed on an old cable.
copy.zh: 信号源与显示端型号，加上目标格式，比旧线缆上印刷的分辨率标签更有价值。

copy.en: Adapters, docks, extenders, wall plates and switchers form part of the real link and should be included where they affect performance.
copy.zh: 转接器、扩展坞、延长器、墙面板和切换设备都属于真实链路，影响性能时应纳入验证。

title.en: Choose the construction from distance and installation
title.zh: 依据距离与安装选择结构

copy.en: Short links may use passive copper, while longer or lower-loss routes may need active electronics, equalization or optical conversion. Active and optical assemblies can be directional and may have defined source and display ends, power needs, minimum bend radius and service limitations that must appear on drawings and labels.
copy.zh: 短距离链路可采用无源铜缆，较长或低损耗路径则可能需要有源电子、均衡或光电转换。有源与光纤组件可能具有方向性，并规定信号源端与显示端、供电要求、最小弯曲半径和维修限制，这些内容都应写入图纸与标签。

copy.en: Permanent SOURCE and DISPLAY identification reduces installation failure in active optical and converted assemblies.
copy.zh: 在有源光纤与转换组件上永久标识 SOURCE 与 DISPLAY，可减少安装失败。

copy.en: Routing, pulling eye, strain relief and storage method are selected so installation forces do not exceed the cable construction.
copy.zh: 走线、牵引保护、应力消除与存放方式应避免安装力超过线缆结构承受范围。

title.en: Shielding works only as a complete path
title.zh: 屏蔽只有形成完整路径才有效

copy.en: Foil, braid, drain wires, connector shells and chassis bonds form a system. Coverage, transfer impedance, shield termination length and enclosure bonding affect susceptibility and emissions; adding more metal layers cannot correct an undefined ground path or a poor connector transition.
copy.zh: 铝箔、编织、排流线、接口外壳与机壳连接共同形成系统。覆盖率、转移阻抗、屏蔽端接长度与机箱搭接都会影响抗扰度和辐射；增加金属层不能弥补未定义的接地路径或不良接口过渡。

copy.en: Motors, inverters, lighting, radio transmitters, medical electronics and bundled power cables create different interference conditions.
copy.zh: 电机、变频器、灯光、无线发射设备、医疗电子与成束电源线会形成不同干扰环境。

copy.en: Shield pigtails, 360-degree terminations and chassis bonds have different high-frequency behavior and must follow the approved architecture.
copy.zh: 屏蔽尾线、360 度端接与机壳连接具有不同高频表现，应服从批准的系统架构。

copy.en: Legacy video links remain common in industrial, laboratory, security and installed equipment. VGA may carry analog video with identification channels, while DVI variants differ in analog and digital support. A shape-changing adapter may be passive only when the source already provides the required signal; protocol conversion needs defined active electronics.
copy.zh: 传统视频链路仍广泛存在于工业、实验室、安防与固定设备中。VGA 可能承载模拟视频与识别通道，DVI 不同版本对模拟与数字信号的支持也不同。只有信号源本身提供目标信号时，外形转换才可能是无源的；协议转换需要明确的有源电子。

title.en: Name the exact DVI or VGA function
title.zh: 明确 DVI 或 VGA 功能

copy.en: Connector appearance, pin population and equipment documentation are reviewed before a legacy assembly is copied or redesigned.
copy.zh: 复制或重新设计传统组件前，应审核接口外观、针脚配置与设备资料。

title.en: Do not hide converters in vague wording
title.zh: 不要用模糊名称掩盖转换器

copy.en: Active conversion introduces chipset, firmware, direction, power, compatibility and thermal responsibilities that belong in the BOM and test plan.
copy.zh: 有源转换会引入芯片、固件、方向、供电、兼容性与散热责任，应纳入 BOM 与测试计划。

title.en: Routing, panel exits and strain relief
title.zh: 走线、面板出线与应力消除

copy.en: Video links are often installed behind shallow displays, through cabinets, inside camera rigs or along moving equipment. Connector length, right-angle orientation, panel thickness, fastening access, service loop, cable diameter, bend radius and pull load must fit the actual envelope rather than an ideal drawing alone.
copy.zh: 视频链路常安装在浅空间显示器背后、机柜内部、摄像机支架或运动设备上。接口长度、弯式方向、面板厚度、紧固空间、检修余量、线缆外径、弯曲半径与拉力必须适配实际包络，而不能只看理想图纸。

title.en: Define angle from the mating face
title.zh: 以插合面定义弯式方向

copy.en: Left, right, up and down exits are referenced to a clear mating-face view so mirror-image parts are not produced.
copy.zh: 左、右、上、下出线应相对清晰插合面定义，避免生产镜像错误。

copy.en: Boot length and stiffness should spread bending gradually while clamps support the jacket without crushing controlled signal geometry.
copy.zh: 尾套长度和硬度应让弯曲逐渐过渡，夹持则要支撑护套且不压坏受控信号几何。

title.en: Broadcast, live production, imaging and installed systems
title.zh: 广播、现场制作、成像与固定系统

copy.en: A studio patch cable prioritizes known bandwidth and serviceability; a touring lead adds repeated handling and fast identification; a security camera route adds distance and installation exposure; an industrial or medical imaging harness adds device-specific interfaces, enclosure limits and controlled documentation. The category covers all of these, but not with one universal construction.
copy.zh: 演播室跳线重视已知带宽与可维护性；巡演线还要承受反复操作并快速识别；安防摄像路径增加距离和安装暴露；工业或医疗成像线束则加入设备专用接口、机壳限制与受控文件。它们都属于这一小类，但不会使用同一种通用结构。

copy.en: Fixed installation, frequent mating, continuous flex, portable use and outdoor routing lead to different cable, jacket and connector decisions.
copy.zh: 固定安装、频繁插拔、连续弯曲、移动使用与户外走线会导向不同的线缆、护套与接口选择。

copy.en: Source, destination, direction, length, format group and revision labels reduce errors in dense racks and multi-camera systems.
copy.zh: 在密集机柜与多摄像机系统中，源端、目标端、方向、长度、格式组与版本标识可以减少错误。

title.en: From pin map to repeatable link performance
title.zh: 从针脚图到可重复链路表现

copy.en: A prototype first confirms interface fit, wiring, direction, dimensions and installation handling. Depending on the project, validation may then add equipment operation, eye or waveform measurements, insertion and return loss, impedance, crosstalk, bit errors or defined format testing. The released drawing, BOM, process and limits become the batch reference.
copy.zh: 样品首先确认接口插合、接线、方向、尺寸与安装手感。根据项目风险，验证还可增加设备运行、眼图或波形、插入与回波损耗、阻抗、串扰、误码或指定格式测试。最终由放行图纸、BOM、工艺与限值形成批次基准。

title.zh: 导通证明接线，不证明带宽

copy.en: Open, short and pin-map tests are essential, but high-speed performance requires a method appropriate to the actual link claim.
copy.zh: 开路、短路与针脚测试必不可少，但高速性能仍需要与真实链路声明相匹配的方法。

copy.en: Source, display, adapters, firmware, format, cable length and acceptance criteria are recorded so later production is compared with the same boundary.
copy.zh: 记录信号源、显示端、转接件、固件、格式、线长与验收标准，使后续生产始终在同一边界内比较。

q.en: Does an HDMI connector guarantee a particular resolution?
q.zh: 使用 HDMI 接口就能保证某个分辨率吗？

a.en: No. The cable category and construction, length, source, display, operating mode and every adapter or switch in the path determine the supported link.
a.zh: 不能。线缆类别与结构、长度、信号源、显示端、运行模式以及路径中的每个转接器或切换设备共同决定链路能力。

q.en: Can continuity testing prove a high-speed video cable?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明高速视频线性能吗？

a.en: No. Continuity verifies pin routing, opens and shorts. High-speed performance may require representative equipment or defined signal-integrity measurements.
a.zh: 不能。导通测试用于确认针脚、开路与短路；高速性能可能还需要代表性设备或规定的信号完整性测量。

q.en: Are active optical video cables directional?
q.zh: 有源光纤视频线有方向性吗？

a.en: Many are. Source and display ends, power requirements, bend limits and service conditions must be confirmed for the selected design.
a.zh: 很多有方向性。所选设计的信号源端与显示端、供电要求、弯曲限制和维修条件都必须确认。

q.en: Can VGA or DVI be converted with a passive adapter?
q.zh: VGA 或 DVI 可以用无源转接器转换吗？

a.en: Only when the source already provides the target signal through compatible pins. Converting between incompatible analog and digital protocols requires active electronics.
a.zh: 只有信号源已通过兼容针脚提供目标信号时才可能无源转换；在不兼容的模拟与数字协议之间转换需要有源电子。

q.en: Can you develop from an existing video cable sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有视频线样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample supports interface, dimension and visible construction review, but hidden cable category, impedance, active devices, firmware, direction and verified bandwidth still require documentation or testing.
a.zh: 样品可辅助审核接口、尺寸与可见结构，但隐藏的线缆类别、阻抗、有源器件、固件、方向和已验证带宽仍需资料或测试确认。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both devices and interfaces, direction and orientation, protocol, target format and refresh rate, color depth if relevant, cable and branch lengths, routing and bend limits, environment, quantity, labels and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供两端设备与接口、方向与方位、协议、目标格式和刷新率、必要时的色深、线缆与分支长度、走线和弯曲限制、环境、数量、标签与验证要求。

intro.en: Power cable assemblies include detachable cord sets, equipment leads, panel connections, industrial power jumpers and low-voltage DC supply cables. The finished assembly is defined by the source, load, voltage, current, grounding, connector system, conductor construction, environment and applicable market requirements—not by plug shape alone.
intro.zh: 电源线组件包括可拆卸电源线、设备引线、面板连接线、工业电源跳线和低压直流供电线。成品必须由电源端、负载端、电压、电流、接地、连接器系统、导体结构、使用环境及目标市场要求共同定义，不能只按插头外形判断。

knowledge.en: A safe power path is a coordinated system. Conductor resistance creates voltage drop and heat; contacts add localized resistance; insulation and jacket must suit voltage, temperature and environment; strain relief must keep mechanical loads away from energized terminations.
knowledge.zh: 可靠的供电路径是一套相互配合的系统。导体电阻会产生压降和热量，接触件会引入局部电阻，绝缘与护套必须适应电压、温度和环境，应力消除则要把机械载荷隔离在带电端接之外。

notes.en: Provide source and load interfaces, AC or DC, nominal and maximum voltage, continuous and peak current, grounding and polarity, cable length, ambient and conductor temperature limits, flex and routing conditions, regional destination, quantity and required compliance or validation.
notes.zh: 请提供电源端与负载端接口、交流或直流、额定及最高电压、持续与峰值电流、接地与极性、线长、环境及导体温度限制、弯曲与走线工况、销售地区、数量以及所需合规或验证。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the approved circuit, conductor and cord type, connector ratings, contact and terminal process, grounding, overmold or backshell, labels and inspection limits. Production verifies wiring, polarity, shorts, dimensions and workmanship, with earth continuity, dielectric, insulation, leakage, temperature or equipment tests added only where the project requires them.
delivery.zh: 工程放行受控回路、导体和软线类别、连接器额定值、接触件与端接工艺、接地、包胶或后壳、标识及检验限值。生产检查接线、极性、短路、尺寸和工艺，并仅在项目要求时增加接地连续性、耐压、绝缘、泄漏、温升或设备运行测试。

subtitle.en: Load, conductor, protection and controlled release
subtitle.zh: 负载、导体、防护与受控放行

lead.en: From an IEC appliance cord to a keyed industrial jumper, every power assembly must carry the required load without excessive drop or temperature while preserving insulation, grounding and mechanical protection. We begin with the complete source-to-load path, then define materials, terminations, compliance boundaries and inspection around the actual installation.
lead.zh: 从 IEC 设备电源线到带键位的工业电源跳线，每个组件都必须在不过度压降或升温的前提下承载所需负载，并保持绝缘、接地和机械防护。我们从完整的电源端到负载端路径开始，再围绕真实安装条件定义材料、端接、合规边界与检验。

introduction.zh: 按完整供电路径进行工程定义

faq.zh: 电源线组件常见问题

title.en: Cord sets, equipment leads and industrial jumpers
title.zh: 电源线、设备引线与工业跳线

copy.en: This category spans regional mains plugs to IEC appliance couplers, hardwired equipment tails, panel-mount extensions, locking industrial connectors, splitter assemblies and custom DC power leads. Detachable, captive, straight, angled, molded and serviceable versions solve different installation and maintenance needs.
copy.zh: 这一小类覆盖各地区市电插头至 IEC 设备耦合器、硬接线设备尾线、面板安装延长线、锁紧式工业连接器、分配组件及定制直流电源线。可拆卸、固定式、直式、弯式、包胶式和可维修结构分别解决不同安装与维护需求。

title.en: Define both ends and the installation
title.zh: 同时定义两端与安装条件

copy.en: Mating-face photos, equipment models, panel thickness, exit direction and available fastening space prevent an apparently familiar connector from being misapplied.
copy.zh: 插合面照片、设备型号、面板厚度、出线方向与紧固空间可避免把外形熟悉的连接器用错。

copy.en: A household cord set, an internal equipment lead and an industrial machine cable can require different constructions, approvals and installation controls.
copy.zh: 家用电源线、设备内部引线和工业机器电缆可能需要完全不同的结构、认可与安装控制。

title.en: Voltage, current, inrush and duty cycle come first
title.zh: 先确认电压、电流、浪涌与工作循环

copy.en: Nominal current alone is not enough. Starting inrush, intermittent peaks, ambient temperature, conductor grouping, connector derating and operating duration influence conductor and contact temperature. AC frequency, DC polarity, protective earth and any auxiliary or control circuits must also be explicit.
copy.zh: 只给额定电流并不足够。启动浪涌、间歇峰值、环境温度、成束方式、连接器降额和通电时长都会影响导体与接触件温度。交流频率、直流极性、保护接地以及辅助或控制回路也必须明确。

title.zh: 采用可信的最不利负载

copy.en: Conductor, terminal and connector selection is checked against the highest credible operating condition, not only a nameplate average.
copy.zh: 导体、端子和连接器应按可信的最高运行工况审核，而不是只看铭牌平均值。

copy.en: Fuse, breaker, current-limited source and equipment protection affect allowable cable construction and must be part of the system definition.
copy.zh: 熔断器、断路器、限流电源和设备保护会影响允许使用的电缆结构，必须纳入系统定义。

title.en: Size the copper for resistance and temperature
title.zh: 按电阻与温升选择铜导体

copy.en: Conductor area, strand construction, length, termination resistance, allowable voltage drop and thermal environment are evaluated together. Fine stranding can improve flexibility, but it does not increase copper area; a thicker outside diameter does not prove lower resistance.
copy.zh: 导体截面积、绞线结构、长度、端接电阻、允许压降与热环境需要共同评估。细绞可以改善柔韧性，但不会增加铜截面积；更粗的外径也不能证明电阻更低。

copy.en: DC and low-voltage systems are especially sensitive to the resistance of both supply and return conductors plus every contact interface.
copy.zh: 直流和低压系统尤其容易受到供电与回流导体以及各接触界面总电阻的影响。

copy.en: Terminal barrels, mating contacts, molded transitions and bundled sections can run hotter than the free cable and deserve targeted review.
copy.zh: 端子压接筒、对插接触件、包胶过渡区与成束位置可能比自由电缆更热，需要重点审核。

title.en: Match interface, rating and destination market
title.zh: 接口、额定值与销售地区必须匹配

copy.en: IEC appliance couplers, NEMA configurations, regional mains plugs and industrial connectors have defined geometry, grounding, polarization and ratings. A connector that physically fits is not automatically permitted for the intended voltage, current, environment or market.
copy.zh: IEC 设备耦合器、NEMA 配置、各地区市电插头及工业连接器都有明确的几何、接地、极性与额定值。能够物理插合并不代表适用于目标电压、电流、环境或市场。

title.en: Certification belongs to the exact construction

copy.en: Marks, file numbers, component conditions and finished-product scope are verified for the exact materials and factory process; similar appearance is not evidence of certification.
copy.zh: 标志、档案号、零部件使用条件与成品范围必须针对确切材料和工厂流程核实；外观相似不是认证证据。

title.en: Ground and polarity cannot be assumed
title.zh: 接地与极性不能靠猜测

copy.en: Protective earth, neutral and line assignments follow the approved system and regional connector definition, with permanent identification where needed.
copy.zh: 保护接地、中性线和相线分配应遵循批准的系统及地区接口定义，必要时采用永久标识。

title.en: Materials follow voltage, heat and environment
title.zh: 材料选择服从电压、温度与环境

copy.en: PVC, rubber, TPE, XLPE, PUR, silicone and other specified compounds differ in flexibility, temperature behavior, abrasion, oil, chemical, UV and flame performance. Material family names alone are insufficient; the approved grade, wall, color, markings and conditions of use matter.
copy.zh: PVC、橡胶、TPE、XLPE、PUR、硅胶及其他指定材料在柔韧性、温度、耐磨、耐油、耐化学、耐紫外和阻燃表现上各不相同。只写材料家族并不足够，批准的具体牌号、壁厚、颜色、印字及使用条件同样重要。

title.en: Insulation and jacket do different jobs
title.zh: 绝缘与护套承担不同职责

copy.en: Core insulation provides electrical separation while the overall jacket manages handling and environmental exposure; one layer cannot automatically replace the other.
copy.zh: 芯线绝缘负责电气隔离，整体护套负责操作与环境暴露；两者不能自动相互替代。

copy.en: A cable that handles well at room temperature may stiffen, soften or creep at operating extremes, changing bend and strain behavior.
copy.zh: 室温下手感良好的电缆，在极端工作温度下可能变硬、变软或蠕变，从而改变弯曲与受力表现。

title.en: Contacts, crimping and overmold form one system
title.zh: 接触件、压接与包胶是一套系统

copy.en: Contact alloy and plating, wire range, strip length, crimp tooling, conductor and insulation support, solder process where specified, backshell and overmold geometry all influence resistance and mechanical life. Pull strength alone cannot prove a low-resistance termination.
copy.zh: 接触件合金与镀层、适用线径、剥线长度、压接模具、导体与绝缘支撑、指定焊接工艺、后壳和包胶几何都会影响电阻与机械寿命。仅有拉力结果不能证明端接低电阻。

copy.en: Approved applicator, height or force criteria, wire preparation and visual limits keep strands captured without cutting, folding or insulation intrusion.
copy.zh: 批准的模具、压接高度或力值标准、线材准备和外观限值可保证线股被正确包覆，避免切伤、折叠或绝缘压入。

copy.en: Clamp, boot and overmold stiffness should transfer pull and bending gradually into the cable instead of creating a hard hinge behind the terminal.
copy.zh: 夹持、尾套与包胶硬度应把拉力和弯曲逐步传递到电缆，而不是在端子后方形成硬折点。

title.en: Protective earth is an engineered current path
title.zh: 保护接地是一条受控电流路径

copy.en: Earth conductor size, color, terminal, bond point, contact sequence and continuity limit are defined with the equipment protection architecture. Shields, chassis bonds and protective earth can interact, but they are not interchangeable names for the same conductor.
copy.zh: 接地导体尺寸、颜色、端子、搭接点、接触顺序及连续性限值应与设备保护架构共同定义。屏蔽、机壳搭接和保护接地可能相互作用，但不是同一根导体的不同叫法。

copy.en: Connections intended to carry fault current require stable contact, suitable conductor capacity and mechanical protection throughout service life.
copy.zh: 承担故障电流的连接必须在整个使用寿命内保持稳定接触、足够导体能力与机械防护。

copy.en: Foil, braid, drain and connector-shell terminations follow EMC needs and should not obscure the safety grounding definition.
copy.zh: 铝箔、编织、排流线与连接器外壳端接应按 EMC 需求定义，不能模糊安全接地要求。

title.en: Routing and service conditions shape the assembly
title.zh: 走线与服役条件决定组件结构

copy.en: Fixed cabinets, moving machinery, portable equipment, outdoor routes and dense power distribution create different demands. Bend radius, torsion, drag, abrasion, fluids, sunlight, connector access, cable support and neighboring heat sources must be reviewed against the actual installation.
copy.zh: 固定机柜、运动机械、便携设备、户外走线和密集配电会产生不同要求。弯曲半径、扭转、拖拽、磨损、液体、日照、连接器操作空间、电缆支撑及邻近热源都必须结合真实安装审核。

title.en: Do not hang the load from the contact
title.zh: 不要让接触件承受线缆重量

copy.en: Clamps and supports carry cable mass and installation pull so the mated interface is not used as a structural anchor.
copy.zh: 夹具与支撑应承担电缆重量和安装拉力，避免把对插界面当作结构锚点。

copy.en: Tight bundling, enclosed ducts and nearby hot equipment can reduce current capacity and increase connector temperature.
copy.zh: 紧密成束、封闭线槽和邻近高温设备可能降低载流能力并提高连接器温度。

title.en: IT, appliances, industrial equipment and controlled systems
title.zh: IT、家电、工业设备与受控系统

copy.en: Server and rack power leads prioritize density, identification and service replacement; appliances need correct regional interfaces and captive-cord protection; industrial equipment adds locking, routing and harsher environments; laboratory and medical equipment may add leakage, grounding and documentation requirements defined by the finished equipment program.
copy.zh: 服务器与机柜电源线重视密度、标识和维护更换；家电强调正确的地区接口与固定线防护；工业设备增加锁紧、走线和严苛环境要求；实验室与医疗设备还可能根据整机项目增加泄漏、接地与文件要求。

title.zh: 同一小类，不同风险画像

copy.en: A desktop appliance lead and a machine power jumper may share copper and molded plugs but require different validation and traceability.
copy.zh: 桌面设备电源线与机器电源跳线可能都使用铜导体和包胶插头，但验证与追溯要求可以完全不同。

copy.en: Part number, electrical rating, destination, length and revision markings reduce unsafe substitutions in field service.
copy.zh: 料号、电气额定值、适用设备、长度与版本标识可减少现场维护中的不安全替换。

title.en: Test construction against the agreed safety boundary
title.zh: 按约定安全边界验证并放行

copy.en: Every assembly needs documented wiring, polarity, shorts, dimensions and workmanship checks. Depending on the product and applicable program, the plan may add protective-earth resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, leakage, contact resistance, temperature rise, flex, pull, strain-relief or equipment operation tests. We do not treat one generic test as proof of every claim.
copy.zh: 每个组件都需要记录接线、极性、短路、尺寸与工艺检查。根据产品及适用项目，计划还可能增加保护接地电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压、泄漏、接触电阻、温升、弯曲、拉力、应力消除或设备运行测试。我们不会把一项通用测试当作所有性能声明的证明。

title.en: Freeze the approved sample and documents

copy.en: Released drawing, BOM, material references, process limits, labels and inspection plan become the production baseline.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、BOM、材料依据、工艺限值、标签与检验计划共同成为生产基准。

copy.en: Wire, plug, terminal, compound, tool or supplier changes are reviewed against the same electrical, mechanical and compliance boundary.
copy.zh: 线材、插头、端子、材料、工具或供应商变更都应依据相同的电气、机械与合规边界重新审核。

q.en: Can wire gauge be selected from current alone?
q.zh: 线径只按电流选择就可以吗？

a.en: No. Length, allowable voltage drop, ambient and conductor temperature, bundling, duty cycle, insulation rating, terminal range and protective device all affect the selection.
a.zh: 不可以。长度、允许压降、环境与导体温度、成束、工作循环、绝缘额定值、端子适用范围和保护器件都会影响选择。

q.en: Does a plug that fits have the correct rating?
q.zh: 插头能插上就代表额定值正确吗？

a.en: No. Connector geometry, current, voltage, grounding, polarization, temperature, environment and regional approval must all match the application.
a.zh: 不代表。连接器几何、电流、电压、接地、极性、温度、环境及地区认可必须全部匹配应用。

q.en: Can an existing power cord sample be copied?
q.zh: 可以依据现有电源线样品复制吗？

a.en: A sample helps confirm fit and visible construction, but hidden conductor area, material grade, ratings, approval scope and electrical load still require documentation or testing.
a.zh: 样品有助于确认装配与可见结构，但隐藏的导体截面积、材料牌号、额定值、认可范围和电气负载仍需资料或测试确认。

q.en: Is thicker cable always safer?
q.zh: 电缆越粗就一定越安全吗？
