a.en: No. Outside diameter can come from jacket, fillers or shielding. Safety depends on verified conductor, insulation, termination, connector, protection and use conditions.
a.zh: 不一定。外径可能来自护套、填充或屏蔽；安全性取决于经确认的导体、绝缘、端接、连接器、保护及使用条件。

q.en: Do all power assemblies require hipot testing?
q.zh: 所有电源线组件都必须做耐压测试吗？

a.en: The test method and limits depend on product construction, applicable standard, customer specification and risk. They must be agreed before production rather than assumed universally.
a.zh: 测试方法与限值取决于产品结构、适用标准、客户规范和风险，应在生产前约定，不能一概而论。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both interfaces, AC or DC, voltage, continuous and peak current, grounding and polarity, length, conductor or drop target, environment, flex and routing, destination market, quantity, labels and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供两端接口、交流或直流、电压、持续与峰值电流、接地与极性、长度、导体或压降目标、环境、弯曲与走线、销售地区、数量、标签与验证要求。

intro.en: Battery cable assemblies carry high DC current between batteries, starters, alternators, disconnects, fuse blocks, busbars and grounded structures. They include positive and negative leads, inter-battery links, ground straps, fused branches, charging leads and service jump connections, each engineered around the actual load and installation.
intro.zh: 电池电缆组件用于在电池、起动机、发电机、隔离开关、熔断器座、母排与接地结构之间传输大电流直流电。它覆盖正负极引线、电池间连接、接地带、带熔断分支、充电线与维修搭电线，每一种都必须围绕真实负载和安装条件设计。

knowledge.en: High-current DC exposes every milliohm. Cable resistance, crimp interfaces, bolted joints and ground returns all create voltage drop and heat, especially during starting or charging peaks. A dependable assembly therefore coordinates conductor area, strand flexibility, terminal geometry, joint preparation, protection, routing and inspection.
knowledge.zh: 在大电流直流回路中，每一个毫欧都不可忽视。电缆电阻、压接界面、螺栓连接与接地回路都会产生压降和热量，在起动或充电峰值时尤其明显。因此，可靠组件必须把导体截面积、绞线柔韧性、端子几何、接合面处理、保护、走线与检验作为整体协调。

notes.en: Provide system voltage, continuous and peak current, peak duration and repetition, cable lengths, battery and equipment interfaces, lug-hole sizes and orientations, ground points, fuse or disconnect arrangement, ambient and conductor temperature, fluids, vibration, routing, quantity and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供系统电压、持续与峰值电流、峰值持续时间及重复频率、线长、电池与设备接口、端子孔径和方向、接地点、熔断或隔离布置、环境与导体温度、液体、振动、走线、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the circuit, conductor, lugs, boots, seals, branch protection, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls strip length, strand condition, crimp tooling and orientation, then verifies continuity, polarity, resistance, dimensions and workmanship; pull, section analysis, voltage-drop, thermal, vibration or environmental checks are added when specified.
delivery.zh: 工程放行回路、导体、线鼻、护套、密封、分支保护、标识、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线长度、线股状态、压接工具与方向，再检查导通、极性、电阻、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加拉力、截面分析、压降、温升、振动或环境验证。

subtitle.en: High-current DC, terminations and protected routing
subtitle.zh: 大电流直流、端接与受保护走线

lead.en: A battery lead is not simply a thick red or black cable. The finished assembly must deliver starting, charging or auxiliary current through a controlled loop while keeping each crimp, stud joint, branch and ground return mechanically stable and electrically low resistance. We define the complete circuit first, then turn it into a repeatable assembly.
lead.zh: 电池线并不只是粗一点的红线或黑线。成品必须通过受控回路传递起动、充电或辅助负载电流，同时让每个压接、螺柱连接、分支和接地回路都保持机械稳定与低电阻。我们先定义完整电路，再把它转化为可重复生产的组件。

introduction.zh: 建立完整的大电流回路

faq.zh: 电池电缆组件常见问题

title.en: Positive leads, grounds, links and protected branches
title.zh: 正极引线、接地线、电池连线与受保护分支

copy.en: This category includes battery-to-starter and battery-to-distribution leads, engine and chassis grounds, series or parallel interconnects, generator and alternator leads, fused auxiliary branches, disconnect-switch jumpers, Anderson-style service links and heavy equipment battery cables. Straight, angled, multi-hole, flag and formed lugs support different stud and routing geometries.
copy.zh: 这一小类包括电池至起动机与配电端引线、发动机和车架接地线、串联或并联电池连接、发电机引线、带熔断辅助分支、隔离开关跳线、Anderson 类维修连接及重型设备电池线。直式、弯式、多孔、旗形和成形线鼻可适配不同螺柱与走线几何。

title.zh: 从机械条件定义每一端

copy.en: Stud diameter, pad width, stack order, tightening access, exit angle and anti-rotation features determine the terminal form—not current alone.
copy.zh: 螺柱直径、接触面宽度、叠装顺序、紧固空间、出线角度与防转结构共同决定端子形式，而不只是电流。

title.zh: 区分维修连接与固定线束

copy.en: Jump-start and removable links need touch-safe handling, clear polarity and connector protection that fixed internal cables may not require.
copy.zh: 搭电线和可拆卸连接需要防误触操作、清晰极性与接口保护，这些要求与固定内部线缆不同。

title.en: Copper area, strand construction and length set the baseline
title.zh: 铜截面积、绞线结构与长度构成设计基线

copy.en: Conductor selection begins with loop resistance, allowable voltage drop, continuous and transient current, temperature and mechanical duty. Fine-stranded copper improves flexibility and vibration tolerance, while compact or coarser constructions can suit fixed routing. Outside diameter is not a substitute for verified conductor area and resistance.
copy.zh: 导体选择应从回路电阻、允许压降、持续与瞬态电流、温度及机械工况开始。细绞铜导体可改善柔韧性与抗振能力，紧压或较粗绞线结构则可能更适合固定走线。外径不能替代经确认的导体截面积与电阻。

title.zh: 计算供电与回流的完整回路

copy.en: Positive and negative cable lengths, chassis bonds, crimp resistance and bolted contacts all contribute to delivered voltage.
copy.zh: 正负极线长、车架搭接、压接电阻与螺栓接触都会影响负载端实际电压。

copy.en: Starter current may be brief and severe; charging or auxiliary loads may be lower but continuous. The thermal model must reflect both.
copy.zh: 起动电流可能短暂但极高，充电或辅助负载可能较低却持续存在，热设计必须同时反映两者。

title.en: A few poor interfaces can dominate the whole circuit
title.zh: 少数不良界面就可能主导整条回路

copy.en: Heat often concentrates at the crimp barrel, lug palm, stud joint, disconnect or fuse connection rather than in the free cable. Oxidation, loose hardware, small contact area, incorrect plating or damaged strands add resistance. Reviewing only cable gauge can therefore miss the true failure point.
copy.zh: 热量常集中在压接筒、线鼻接触面、螺柱连接、隔离开关或熔断器连接处，而不是自由电缆段。氧化、紧固不足、接触面积过小、镀层不当或线股损伤都会增加电阻，因此只检查线径可能遗漏真正的失效点。

title.zh: 在有意义的边界测量电阻

copy.en: Assembly or joint resistance limits should match the circuit and measurement method; generic continuity alone cannot reveal milliohm-level loss.
copy.zh: 组件或接点电阻限值应与回路和测量方法匹配，普通导通测试无法揭示毫欧级损耗。

title.zh: 关注热循环后的稳定性

copy.en: Expansion and contraction can change a marginal crimp or bolted joint, so project validation may include current cycling and remeasurement.
copy.zh: 热胀冷缩会改变临界压接或螺栓连接，项目验证可能需要通电循环后重新测量。

title.en: Match lug barrel, cable and tooling as one system
title.zh: 把线鼻压接筒、线缆与模具作为一个系统匹配

copy.en: The lug barrel must suit conductor size and strand class; the palm must suit the mating stud and joint surface. Strip length, strand containment, die profile, crimp position and orientation are controlled together. Solder is not used to conceal an unqualified mechanical crimp.
copy.zh: 线鼻压接筒必须适配导体尺寸和绞线等级，接触面必须适配对接螺柱与接合面。剥线长度、线股包覆、模具轮廓、压接位置和方向要共同受控，不能用焊锡掩盖未经验证的机械压接。

copy.en: Crimp height or force, visual condition, pull, section geometry and electrical resistance provide different evidence and are selected by the project.
copy.zh: 压接高度或力值、外观、拉力、截面几何与电阻分别提供不同证据，应按项目选择。

copy.en: Clocking between two lugs matters on short or stiff cables; forcing the finished lead into position creates torsion at the barrel.
copy.zh: 短线或硬线两端线鼻的相对角度十分重要，强行扭到安装位置会让压接筒承受持续扭力。

title.en: Protect the conductor as close to the energy source as practical
title.zh: 尽可能在靠近能源端的位置保护导体

copy.en: Battery sources can deliver very high fault current. Fuse type, continuous rating, interrupting capability, time-current behavior, cable ampacity, branch length and mounting environment must be coordinated. Disconnects, contactors and service plugs add isolation functions but do not automatically replace overcurrent protection.
copy.zh: 电池电源能够输出极高故障电流。熔断器类型、持续额定值、分断能力、时间—电流特性、线缆载流能力、分支长度与安装环境必须协调。隔离开关、接触器和维修插头可提供隔离功能，但不能自动替代过流保护。

copy.en: When one large feed divides into smaller conductors, each downstream path is reviewed against its own fault and load conditions.
copy.zh: 当大线径主路分为更小导体时，每个下游路径都应按自身故障与负载条件审核。

copy.en: Boots, covers, barriers and service procedures reduce accidental shorting at battery posts, studs and fuse blocks.
copy.zh: 护套、盖板、隔板与维修流程可降低电池柱、螺柱和熔断器座意外短路的风险。

title.en: The negative path deserves the same engineering as the positive lead
title.zh: 负极回路需要与正极引线同等的工程设计

copy.en: Chassis and engine structures can form part of the return path only when bond locations, surface preparation, fasteners, coatings and current capacity are controlled. Flexible ground straps bridge vibration and relative motion; dedicated return cables reduce dependence on uncertain structural joints.
copy.zh: 只有在搭接位置、表面处理、紧固件、涂层与载流能力均受控时，车架和发动机结构才可作为回流路径的一部分。柔性接地带用于跨越振动与相对运动，专用回流线则可减少对不确定结构连接的依赖。

title.en: Remove resistance from the joint stack
title.zh: 控制接合层中的附加电阻

copy.en: Paint, corrosion, sealants and unsuitable washers can reduce real contact area even when the bolt appears tight.
copy.zh: 油漆、腐蚀、密封剂与不合适的垫圈即使在螺栓看似紧固时，也会减少真实接触面积。

copy.en: Where specified, corrosion protection is applied without insulating the current-carrying interface or interfering with service inspection.
copy.zh: 需要时应在不绝缘载流界面、不妨碍维修检查的前提下施加防腐保护。

title.en: Materials follow heat, fluids, abrasion and battery chemistry
title.zh: 材料选择服从温度、液体、磨损与电池环境

copy.en: Battery cables may encounter engine heat, oil, fuel, coolant, cleaning agents, road splash, battery electrolyte, UV and cold. Cable insulation, heat-shrink, molded boots, terminal covers, seals and labels are selected as a compatible system. A sealed boot cannot compensate for capillary paths inside an uncontrolled crimp.
copy.zh: 电池线可能接触发动机热量、油液、燃油、冷却液、清洗剂、道路飞溅、电池电解液、紫外线与低温。线缆绝缘、热缩管、成型端子帽、保护盖、密封与标签应作为兼容系统选择。仅有密封端子帽并不能弥补失控压接内部的毛细通道。

title.en: Seal the transition, not just the opening
title.zh: 密封整个过渡区，而不只是开口

copy.en: Adhesive-lined shrink or molded protection must overlap sound insulation and remain stable under flex, heat and fluid exposure.
copy.zh: 带胶热缩或成型防护需要覆盖完好的绝缘层，并在弯曲、温度和液体暴露下保持稳定。

title.zh: 让标识经得起使用环境

copy.en: Polarity, circuit, destination and part markings are positioned where they remain legible after installation and cleaning.
copy.zh: 极性、回路、去向与料号标识应布置在安装和清洁后仍能清晰识读的位置。

title.en: Support cable mass before it reaches the terminal
title.zh: 在线缆重量传到端子前提供支撑

copy.en: Large conductors are heavy and can be stiff. Bend radius, clamp spacing, service slack, edge protection, motion between battery and equipment, vibration, installation sequence and tool access all influence life. The lug should lie naturally on the stud without being used to pull the cable into place.
copy.zh: 大截面导体重量大且可能较硬。弯曲半径、夹持间距、维修余量、边缘防护、电池与设备间相对运动、振动、安装顺序和工具空间都会影响寿命。线鼻应自然落在螺柱上，而不应被用来把线缆硬拉到位。

copy.en: Abrupt stiffness changes at lugs, boots and clamps concentrate bending; a progressive transition spreads movement into the cable.
copy.zh: 线鼻、端子帽和夹具处的刚度突变会集中弯曲，应通过渐进过渡把运动分散到线缆。

copy.en: Branch order, lug clocking and fastener access are checked against the actual installation so technicians do not twist or cross the leads.
copy.zh: 分支顺序、线鼻角度与紧固空间应结合实际安装审核，避免技术人员扭转或交叉线缆。

title.en: Vehicles, material handling, generators and stationary DC systems
title.zh: 车辆、物料搬运、发电机与固定式直流系统

copy.en: Passenger and commercial vehicles use battery, starter, alternator and ground leads; trucks and construction equipment add longer runs, multiple batteries and severe vibration; forklifts and material-handling equipment demand serviceable high-current links; generator, marine, solar and backup systems add their own enclosure, corrosion and maintenance constraints.
copy.zh: 乘用车与商用车使用电池、起动机、发电机和接地引线；卡车与工程设备增加更长走线、多电池与强振动；叉车和物料搬运设备需要可维护的大电流连接；发电机、船舶、太阳能与备用系统则各自增加机柜、防腐和维护限制。

title.zh: 同一类别，多种系统架构

copy.en: A short starter lead, a dual-battery interconnect and a stationary battery-bank jumper may share copper and lugs but not the same design assumptions.
copy.zh: 短起动线、双电池连接与固定电池组跳线可能都使用铜导体和线鼻，但设计假设并不相同。

title.zh: 与高压新能源项目清晰区分

copy.en: This page focuses on conventional low-voltage battery cable assemblies. Orange high-voltage traction wiring requires a separate system definition and validation path.
copy.zh: 本页聚焦常规低压电池电缆组件。橙色高压牵引系统线束需要独立的系统定义与验证路径。

title.en: Release the cable, joint and installation evidence together
title.zh: 把线缆、接点与安装证据一起放行

copy.en: Routine inspection verifies circuit, polarity, dimensions, lug orientation, labels, strand condition and workmanship. Project-specific plans may add milliohm resistance, voltage-drop under load, crimp pull and section analysis, temperature rise, current cycling, vibration, flex, sealing, corrosion or fluid exposure. The drawing, BOM, tooling and inspection limits then become the controlled production baseline.
copy.zh: 常规检验确认回路、极性、尺寸、线鼻方向、标签、线股状态与工艺。项目计划还可增加毫欧电阻、负载压降、压接拉力与截面分析、温升、电流循环、振动、弯曲、密封、腐蚀或液体暴露。随后由图纸、BOM、工具与检验限值共同构成受控生产基线。

title.en: Do not infer a result from a test name
title.zh: 不能仅凭测试名称推断结果

copy.en: Method, current, duration, fixture, measurement points and acceptance limits are agreed before testing and recorded with the result.
copy.zh: 测试方法、电流、时长、夹具、测量点与接收限值应在测试前约定，并与结果一起记录。

title.en: Review every material or tool change
title.zh: 审核每次材料或工具变更

copy.en: Cable, lug, plating, shrink, boot, die, press or supplier changes are checked against the approved electrical and mechanical boundary.
copy.zh: 线缆、线鼻、镀层、热缩、端子帽、模具、压机或供应商变更都应对照批准的电气与机械边界审核。

q.en: Can battery cable size be selected from starter current alone?
q.zh: 电池线径只按起动电流选择可以吗？

a.en: No. Loop length, allowable voltage drop, peak duration and repetition, continuous charging or auxiliary load, temperature, bundling, conductor construction, termination resistance and protection all affect selection.
a.zh: 不可以。回路长度、允许压降、峰值持续时间及重复频率、持续充电或辅助负载、温度、成束、导体结构、端接电阻与保护都会影响选择。

q.en: Can you build from an existing battery cable sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有电池线样品开发吗？

a.en: Yes, a sample helps confirm length, routing and terminal geometry, but conductor area, material grade, electrical duty, joint specification and validation limits still require customer data or engineering confirmation.
a.zh: 可以，样品有助于确认长度、走线与端子几何，但导体截面积、材料牌号、电气工况、接点规范与验证限值仍需客户资料或工程确认。

q.en: Is a soldered lug better than a crimped lug?
q.zh: 焊接线鼻一定比压接线鼻好吗？

a.en: Not inherently. A properly engineered crimp provides a controlled mechanical and electrical interface. Solder can wick into strands and create a stiff transition; either process must be specified and validated for the application.
a.zh: 不一定。正确工程化的压接能够形成受控机械与电气界面。焊锡可能沿线股渗入并形成硬过渡；无论哪种工艺都必须针对应用明确并验证。

q.en: Why does a ground cable become hot?
q.zh: 接地线为什么会发热？

a.en: Possible causes include undersized conductor, loose or corroded joints, poor surface preparation, damaged strands, excessive current or an unintended return path. The complete loop should be measured and inspected.
a.zh: 可能原因包括导体偏小、接点松动或腐蚀、接触面处理不良、线股损伤、电流过大或出现非预期回流路径，应对完整回路进行测量与检查。

q.en: Do you supply fused or multi-branch battery leads?
q.zh: 可以制作带熔断器或多分支的电池线吗？

a.en: Yes, where the circuit, protection device, ratings, mounting, branch sizes, fault-current assumptions and service access are defined and reviewed as one system.
a.zh: 可以，但需要把回路、保护器件、额定值、安装方式、分支线径、故障电流假设与维修空间作为一个系统定义和审核。

q.en: What information is required for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些信息？

a.en: Provide voltage, continuous and peak current, peak timing, both interfaces, stud and lug geometry, cable lengths, conductor or voltage-drop target, ground and fuse arrangement, environment, routing, quantity, labels and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供电压、持续与峰值电流、峰值时序、两端接口、螺柱与线鼻几何、线长、导体或压降目标、接地与熔断布置、环境、走线、数量、标签与验证要求。

intro.en: LED cable assemblies connect drivers, controllers, dimmers, switches, distribution points, light engines, strips and luminaires. The category includes simple two-wire power leads, multi-channel RGB or RGBW harnesses, addressable-light power-and-data assemblies, sealed outdoor branches, automotive relay harnesses and equipment-internal lighting looms.
intro.zh: LED 线缆组件用于连接驱动电源、控制器、调光器、开关、分配节点、光源模组、灯带与灯具。这一小类覆盖简单两芯供电线、多通道 RGB 或 RGBW 线束、可寻址灯光的电源与数据组件、户外密封分支、汽车继电器灯光线束及设备内部照明线束。

knowledge.en: Stable light output depends on more than a connector. Supply voltage, load current, cable length, return path, channel assignment, PWM or data behavior, connector contact resistance, polarity, sealing and heat all influence brightness, color consistency and reliability. The harness is therefore engineered as part of the complete lighting circuit.
knowledge.zh: 稳定出光不只取决于连接器。供电电压、负载电流、线长、回流路径、通道分配、PWM 或数据信号、连接器接触电阻、极性、密封与温度都会影响亮度、色彩一致性和可靠性，因此线缆必须作为完整照明回路的一部分进行设计。

notes.en: Provide the LED type and load, constant-voltage or constant-current architecture, supply and controller models, pin or channel definition, continuous and peak current, cable lengths, allowable voltage drop, dimming or data protocol, connector and mating details, indoor or outdoor environment, movement, mounting, quantity, labeling and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供 LED 类型与负载、恒压或恒流架构、电源与控制器型号、针脚或通道定义、持续与峰值电流、线长、允许压降、调光或数据协议、连接器与对插件资料、室内或户外环境、运动与安装条件、数量、标识及验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the circuit map, conductor sizes, channel colors, connector keying, branches, seals, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls stripping, crimping or specified soldering, polarity and sealing, then verifies circuit, shorts, dimensions and workmanship; resistance, voltage-drop, load, thermal, flex, vibration or ingress checks are added when specified.
delivery.zh: 工程放行回路图、导体尺寸、通道颜色、连接器防错、分支、密封、标签、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线、压接或指定焊接、极性与密封，再检验回路、短路、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加电阻、压降、带载、温升、弯曲、振动或防护验证。

subtitle.en: Power, control, sealing and repeatable light-system wiring
subtitle.zh: 供电、控制、密封与可重复照明系统布线

lead.en: An LED harness can carry power only, power plus several color channels, or power together with timing-sensitive control data. We define what each conductor does, what reaches the final light after cable loss, and how every joint survives its real installation before selecting wire and connectors.
lead.zh: LED 线束可能只传输电源，也可能同时承载多路色彩通道，或把电源与对时序敏感的控制数据放在同一组件中。我们先定义每根导体的功能、线损后到达末端灯具的实际条件，以及每个接点如何适应真实安装，再选择线材与连接器。

introduction.en: Wire the Light as a Complete System
introduction.zh: 把灯光作为完整系统布线

faq.zh: LED 线缆组件常见问题

title.en: From two-wire lamps to multi-channel lighting looms
title.zh: 从两芯灯具引线到多通道照明线束

copy.en: This category includes driver-to-board leads, strip-to-wire tails, extension and jumper cables, Y and multi-drop branches, cabinet and signage lighting looms, RGB and RGBW controller harnesses, addressable-pixel power/data cables, sealed outdoor connectors, automotive lamp and light-bar harnesses, panel-mount feeds and serviceable modular lighting systems.
copy.zh: 这一小类包括驱动器至灯板引线、灯带尾线、延长线与跳线、Y 形及多点分支、机柜与标识照明线束、RGB 和 RGBW 控制器线束、可寻址像素电源/数据线、户外密封连接、汽车灯具与灯条线束、面板供电及可维护模块化照明系统。

title.en: Define the light load, not only the plug
title.zh: 先定义光源负载，不只看插头

copy.en: LED type, wattage, channel count, driver behavior and installation topology determine the electrical work behind a familiar connector.
copy.zh: LED 类型、功率、通道数量、驱动方式与安装拓扑共同决定熟悉连接器背后的真实电气任务。

title.en: Separate fixed, serviceable and moving links
title.zh: 区分固定、可维护与运动连接

copy.en: A soldered internal tail, a replaceable luminaire jumper and a moving sign harness need different strain relief and connector access.
copy.zh: 焊接内部尾线、可更换灯具跳线与运动标识线束需要不同的应力消除与连接器操作空间。

title.en: Deliver the required voltage at the last light
title.zh: 让末端灯具仍获得所需电压

copy.en: Low-voltage lighting is sensitive to cable resistance. Conductor area, one-way length, supply-and-return loop, current per branch, connector losses, ambient temperature and simultaneous channel use determine delivered voltage and heat. Long runs or dense arrays may need larger copper, shorter branches, parallel feeds or deliberate power injection.
copy.zh: 低压照明对线缆电阻十分敏感。导体截面积、单程长度、供电与回流完整回路、各分支电流、连接器损耗、环境温度及多通道同时工作情况都会决定末端电压与发热。长距离或密集灯阵可能需要更大铜截面、更短分支、并联供电或有计划的补电点。

title.zh: 按最不利通道组合计算

copy.en: RGBW and dynamic systems may draw very different current by scene; sizing should cover the agreed maximum simultaneous output and duty cycle.
copy.zh: RGBW 与动态系统在不同场景下电流差异很大，选型应覆盖约定的最大同时输出与工作循环。

copy.en: Unequal lengths and daisy-chain resistance can make distant luminaires dimmer or shift color, so topology matters as much as gauge.
copy.zh: 不等长分支与串接电阻会让远端灯具变暗或偏色，因此拓扑与线径同样重要。

title.en: Keep power, dimming channels and data unambiguous
title.zh: 让电源、调光通道与数据定义清晰无歧义

copy.en: Single-color assemblies may use positive and return only; tunable white adds warm and cool channels; RGB or RGBW adds shared and individual color conductors; addressable lighting adds clock or data references that can be more noise-sensitive. Pin count alone cannot define polarity, common-anode or common-cathode arrangement, channel order or signal reference.
copy.zh: 单色组件可能只有正极与回流；可调色温增加暖白和冷白通道；RGB 或 RGBW 增加公共端与各颜色导体；可寻址照明还会增加更易受干扰的时钟或数据参考。仅凭针数无法确定极性、共阳或共阴、通道顺序与信号参考。

copy.en: Connector cavity, wire color, circuit name and destination are recorded together so controller and luminaire revisions cannot silently swap colors.
copy.zh: 连接器孔位、线色、回路名称与去向应一起记录，避免控制器或灯具变更时悄然互换颜色。

title.zh: 需要时保护信号完整性

copy.en: Twisted pairs, controlled return paths, shielding, separation and termination are selected from protocol, edge rate, length and interference—not added by habit.
copy.zh: 双绞、受控回流、屏蔽、间距与端接应按协议、边沿速度、长度与干扰选择，而不是习惯性堆叠。

title.en: Treat the copper pad and light engine as real interfaces
title.zh: 把铜焊盘与光源模组视为真实接口

copy.en: Driver-to-board and strip tails may terminate by connector, crimp contact, soldered pad, board header or overmolded transition. Pad width, pitch, copper condition, polarity marks, thermal exposure, adhesive or encapsulation and available strain relief all affect a reliable joint. Cutting or modifying a protected strip can change the protection boundary.
copy.zh: 驱动器至灯板或灯带尾线可通过连接器、压接触点、焊盘、板端插座或包胶过渡端接。焊盘宽度与间距、铜面状态、极性标记、热暴露、胶黏或封装以及可用应力消除都会影响连接可靠性；切割或修改受保护灯带可能改变其防护边界。

copy.en: Solder temperature, contact time, wetting and wire support are controlled to avoid lifted pads, brittle transitions or damaged encapsulation.
copy.zh: 焊接温度、接触时间、润湿与线材支撑需要受控，以避免焊盘翘起、硬脆过渡或封装损伤。

copy.en: Permanent joins and field-replaceable modules are documented differently so service work does not destroy sealing or polarity control.
copy.zh: 永久连接与现场可更换模组应采用不同文件定义，避免维修破坏密封或极性控制。

title.en: Key, lock and label every repeatable connection
title.zh: 让每个可重复连接都具备防错、锁止与标识

copy.en: Wire-to-wire plugs, board connectors, barrel connectors, circular sealed couplers, quick connectors and molded splitters solve different assembly and service problems. Contact rating, cavity sealing, latch retention, keying, mating cycles, touch protection, branch orientation and installation tool access are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 线对线插头、板端连接器、圆柱电源接口、密封圆形连接、快接件与成型分配器分别解决不同装配与维护问题。接触件额定值、孔位密封、卡扣保持、防错、插拔次数、防触碰、分支方向与安装工具空间需要共同审核。

title.zh: 避免形成可互插的危险接口

copy.en: Circuits with different voltage, polarity or control functions should not share an easily mis-mated connector without effective keying and identification.
copy.zh: 不同电压、极性或控制功能的回路不应共用易误插接口，除非具备有效防错与标识。

title.en: Place splits where they can be supported
title.zh: 把分支放在可支撑的位置

copy.en: A splitter adds mass and stiffness; its location should not hang from a strip pad, lamp tail or unsupported connector.
copy.zh: 分配器会增加重量与刚度，其位置不应悬挂在线带焊盘、灯具尾线或无支撑连接器上。

title.en: Crimping, soldering and strain relief must agree
title.zh: 让压接、焊接与应力消除相互配合

copy.en: Crimp contacts require the correct wire range, strip length, applicator and conductor/insulation support. Soldered joints require controlled preparation, heat, wetting and cleaning. In both cases, the cable must transition gradually into support, boot, potting or overmold so vibration and installation pull are not concentrated at the electrical joint.
copy.zh: 压接触点需要正确的适用线径、剥线长度、模具以及导体/绝缘支撑；焊接接点需要受控的准备、温度、润湿与清洁。两种方式都必须让线缆逐步过渡到夹持、尾套、灌封或包胶区域，避免振动和安装拉力集中在电气接点。

title.en: Inspect what each process can reveal

copy.en: Visual condition, crimp height or force, pull, section geometry, solder fillet, resistance and functional load each reveal different defects.
copy.zh: 外观、压接高度或力值、拉力、截面几何、焊角、电阻与带载功能分别揭示不同缺陷。

title.zh: 控制助焊剂与残留物兼容性

copy.en: Cleaning and residue limits follow the board, conductor, encapsulant and environment so chemistry does not undermine insulation or adhesion.
copy.zh: 清洁与残留限值应与电路板、导体、封装材料及环境匹配，避免化学残留破坏绝缘或粘接。

title.en: Water resistance belongs to the complete joint
title.zh: 防水性能属于完整接点，而不是单个零件

copy.en: Outdoor assemblies face rain, condensation, dust, UV, heat, cold and cleaning. Connector interface seals, individual wire seals, cable jacket, gland or overmold, branch transitions, end caps and enclosure entries must form one continuous protection concept. A high-rated connector cannot compensate for an open cable end or unsealed splice nearby.
copy.zh: 户外组件会面对雨水、凝露、粉尘、紫外线、冷热与清洁。连接器界面密封、单线密封、线缆护套、格兰或包胶、分支过渡、端帽与机箱入口必须形成连续防护方案。高防护等级连接器无法弥补附近裸露线端或未密封接头。

title.en: Choose jacket by the actual exposure

copy.en: PVC, PUR, TPE, silicone and specified compounds differ in UV, abrasion, flexibility, temperature and chemical behavior; the grade matters more than the family name.
copy.zh: PVC、PUR、TPE、硅胶及指定材料在耐紫外、耐磨、柔韧、温度和化学性能上不同，具体牌号比材料家族名称更重要。

copy.en: Connector orientation, drip loops, branch direction and enclosure entries are arranged so gravity does not continually drive water toward a seal.
copy.zh: 连接器方向、滴水弯、分支方向与机箱入口应让重力不会持续把水带向密封界面。

title.en: Lamp, relay, fuse and vehicle interface form one harness
title.zh: 灯具、继电器、熔断器与车辆接口构成一套线束

copy.en: Headlamp, fog-lamp, work-light, marker, interior and light-bar assemblies may include battery or ignition feeds, relays, switches, fuses, body grounds, dimming or vehicle-control inputs and sealed lamp connectors. Wire size, fuse position, relay coil logic, ground path, heat, vibration and routing are defined around the vehicle rather than copied from a generic kit.
copy.zh: 前照灯、雾灯、工作灯、示廓灯、内饰灯与灯条组件可能包括电池或点火供电、继电器、开关、熔断器、车身接地、调光或车辆控制输入及密封灯具接口。线径、熔断位置、继电器线圈逻辑、接地路径、温度、振动与走线必须围绕具体车辆定义，而不是复制通用套件。

copy.en: Auxiliary lighting load and switching strategy are reviewed so the harness does not overload or confuse the existing control system.
copy.zh: 辅助照明负载与开关策略需要审核，避免线束过载或干扰原车控制系统。

title.zh: 同时保留维修空间与密封

copy.en: Connectors, fuse holders and relays are placed where they remain protected yet inspectable without pulling on lamp tails.
copy.zh: 连接器、熔断器座与继电器应布置在既受保护又可检查的位置，避免维修时拉扯灯具尾线。

title.en: Scale repeatable branches across signs, buildings and infrastructure
title.zh: 让标识、建筑与基础设施的分支可重复扩展

copy.en: Retail displays, channel letters, façade lighting, street furniture, tunnels, warehouses and machine-vision illumination often repeat many fixtures over long routes. Harness drawings can standardize feed points, branch lengths, connector identity, installation sequence and replaceable modules while accounting for voltage drop, enclosure boundaries and site access.
copy.zh: 零售展示、发光字、建筑立面、城市设施、隧道、仓库与机器视觉照明常在长距离上重复大量灯具。线束图纸可以在考虑压降、机箱边界与现场空间的同时，标准化供电点、分支长度、连接器身份、安装顺序和可更换模组。

copy.en: Sequential labels and modular connectors help technicians locate one branch without disturbing an entire illuminated structure.
copy.zh: 连续编号标签与模块化连接可帮助技术人员定位单一分支，而不必扰动整套照明结构。

title.zh: 明确区分市电与低压侧

copy.en: Driver input, protective earth and low-voltage LED output are documented as different boundaries with suitable separation and components.
copy.zh: 驱动器输入、保护接地与低压 LED 输出应作为不同边界记录，并采用合适的隔离与零部件。

title.en: Moisture, spectrum channels and long duty cycles change the design
title.zh: 潮湿、光谱通道与长工作循环会改变设计

copy.en: Grow lights, display cases, laboratory illumination and other special-light systems can combine long operating hours, warm fixtures, humid cleaning environments and multiple independently controlled channels. Cable temperature, connector location, condensation paths, channel identity and service replacement therefore need to be considered with the lighting schedule and enclosure.
copy.zh: 植物灯、展示柜、实验室照明及其他专用光照系统可能同时具有长时间运行、灯具温升、潮湿清洁环境与多路独立控制通道。线缆温度、连接器位置、凝露路径、通道身份与维修更换因此需要结合照明时序和机箱一起考虑。

title.en: Do not infer cable temperature from room air
title.zh: 不要只用室温推断线缆温度

copy.en: Drivers, LEDs, reflectors and enclosed channels can create local hot zones well above the measured ambient.
copy.zh: 驱动器、LED、反射结构与封闭线槽可能形成明显高于环境温度的局部热点。

copy.en: Where fixtures repeat, connector keying and durable labels prevent warm, cool, red, blue or control branches from being exchanged during service.
copy.zh: 灯具重复布置时，连接器防错与耐久标签可避免维修时互换暖白、冷白、红、蓝或控制分支。

title.en: Verify the harness with the agreed driver and load
title.zh: 使用约定驱动器与负载验证线束

copy.en: Routine inspection confirms circuit, polarity, channel assignment, shorts, dimensions, labels and workmanship. Project plans may add contact or assembly resistance, voltage drop at maximum load, temperature rise, PWM or data operation, current balance, pull, flex, vibration, seal or environmental exposure. A no-load continuity check cannot prove correct brightness or thermal behavior.
copy.zh: 常规检验确认回路、极性、通道分配、短路、尺寸、标签与工艺。项目计划可增加接触或组件电阻、最大负载压降、温升、PWM 或数据运行、电流平衡、拉力、弯曲、振动、密封或环境暴露。空载导通测试不能证明亮度与热表现正确。

copy.en: Supply, driver, controller program, load, cable length, channel state, measurement points and acceptance limits are captured with the result.
copy.zh: 电源、驱动器、控制程序、负载、线长、通道状态、测量点与接收限值应与结果一起记录。

title.zh: 冻结重复生产所需文件

copy.en: Released drawing, BOM, approved components, tooling, work instructions, labels and inspection plan become the controlled production baseline.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、BOM、批准零部件、工具、作业指导、标签与检验计划共同成为受控生产基线。

q.en: Can LED wire size be selected from wattage alone?
q.zh: LED 线径只按功率选择可以吗？

a.en: No. Supply voltage, current per channel, run length, complete return path, allowable drop, connector losses, ambient and local temperature, bundling and duty cycle all affect selection.
a.zh: 不可以。供电电压、各通道电流、线长、完整回流路径、允许压降、连接器损耗、环境与局部温度、成束及工作循环都会影响选择。

q.en: Can one four-pin connector be used for every RGB system?
q.zh: 四针连接器可以通用于所有 RGB 系统吗？

a.en: No. Systems can differ in voltage, common-anode or common-cathode arrangement, channel order, current, connector keying and control method. The exact pin map and mating device must be confirmed.
a.zh: 不可以。系统在电压、共阳或共阴、通道顺序、电流、连接器防错与控制方式上都可能不同，必须确认确切针脚图与对接设备。

q.en: Does an IP67 connector make the whole LED harness IP67?
q.zh: 使用 IP67 连接器就代表整条 LED 线束达到 IP67 吗？

a.en: No. The complete assembly boundary includes cable entry, wire seals, mating interface, branch transitions, splices, end caps and enclosure entries. The agreed test configuration must cover the finished assembly.
a.zh: 不代表。完整组件边界还包括线缆入口、单线密封、对插界面、分支过渡、接头、端帽与机箱入口，约定测试配置必须覆盖最终成品。

q.en: Can you build a harness from an LED controller and lamp samples?
q.zh: 可以依据 LED 控制器与灯具样品开发线束吗？

a.en: Samples help confirm fit and visible pin locations, but voltage, channel definition, current, control behavior, environmental rating and acceptance limits still require documentation or engineering confirmation.
a.zh: 样品有助于确认装配与可见针位，但电压、通道定义、电流、控制方式、环境等级与接收限值仍需资料或工程确认。

q.en: Why do LED lights become dimmer at the end of a run?
q.zh: 为什么 LED 灯在长线末端会变暗？

a.en: Cable, connector and joint resistance create voltage drop, and daisy-chained current makes early sections carry more load. Conductor size, branch topology, feed position and power-injection strategy should be reviewed.
a.zh: 线缆、连接器与接点电阻会产生压降，串接电流还会让前段承担更大负载，需要审核导体尺寸、分支拓扑、供电位置与补电策略。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide LED and driver/controller models, voltage and current, pin or channel map, dimming/data protocol, both interfaces, cable and branch lengths, allowable drop, environment and IP target, movement, mounting, quantity, labels and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供 LED 与驱动器/控制器型号、电压与电流、针脚或通道图、调光/数据协议、两端接口、线长与分支长度、允许压降、环境与 IP 目标、运动、安装、数量、标签及验证要求。

intro.en: LVDS cable assemblies carry high-speed differential data between processors, serializers, displays, cameras and control electronics. This category covers internal display looms, panel links, shielded twisted-pair assemblies and application-specific power/control branches—not one universal screen cable.
intro.zh: LVDS 电缆组件用于在处理器、串行器、显示屏、摄像头与控制电子之间传输高速差分数据。这一小类覆盖设备内部屏线、面板连接、屏蔽双绞组件及按项目定义的电源/控制分支，并不是一种通用屏线。

knowledge.en: LVDS is an electrical signaling layer rather than a complete connector or display protocol. Cable geometry, differential impedance, pair balance, termination, connector transitions and grounding must match the actual transmitter, receiver and data format.
knowledge.zh: LVDS 是电气信号层，并不等同于某一种连接器或完整显示协议。线缆几何、差分阻抗、线对平衡、端接、连接器过渡与接地必须匹配实际发送端、接收端及数据格式。

notes.en: Confirm transmitter and receiver part numbers; connector drawings and pin map; pair count and lane assignment; target differential impedance; data rate and clock; cable length and routing; power/backlight circuits; shield and ground strategy; mechanical movement; sample and validation limits.
notes.zh: 需要确认发送端与接收端型号、连接器图纸和针脚表、线对数量与通道分配、目标差分阻抗、数据速率与时钟、线长和走线、电源/背光回路、屏蔽接地策略、机械运动、样品及验证限值。

delivery.en: After interface and signal requirements are frozen, engineering reviews the interconnect stack, prepares controlled samples, verifies electrical continuity and the agreed high-speed performance, then releases drawings, BOM, tooling and inspection points for repeat production.
delivery.zh: 接口与信号要求冻结后，工程团队审核完整互连链路，制作受控样品，确认电气导通与约定的高速性能，再放行图纸、BOM、工具和检验点用于重复生产。

subtitle.en: Pair geometry, impedance, shielding and display-system integration
subtitle.zh: 线对几何、阻抗、屏蔽与显示系统集成

lead.en: A reliable LVDS assembly is a continuous high-speed path: transmitter launch, connector, cable pair, shield and receiver termination all matter. We define this path from the equipment interface outward, then design the cable construction and manufacturing controls around it.
lead.zh: 可靠的 LVDS 组件是一条连续高速通道：发送端起始过渡、连接器、线缆差分对、屏蔽与接收端端接都不可分割。我们从设备接口出发定义整条路径，再围绕它设计线缆结构与制造控制。

introduction.zh: 设计完整信号路径

faq.zh: LVDS 电缆组件常见问题

title.en: One category, many display and data architectures
title.zh: 一个小类，覆盖多种显示与数据架构

copy.en: LVDS assemblies can connect a main board to an LCD timing controller, serializer to deserializer, camera to processor, industrial computer to operator panel, or acquisition electronics to an instrument display. Builds may combine one or several differential pairs with clock, low-speed control, panel power, backlight power, enable, ground and shield circuits. Connector families, lane count and pin maps therefore follow the equipment—not the category name.
copy.zh: LVDS 组件可以连接主板与 LCD 时序控制板、串行器与解串器、摄像头与处理器、工业计算机与操作面板，或采集电子与仪器显示器。组件可能把一对或多对差分信号与时钟、低速控制、面板电源、背光电源、使能、地线及屏蔽组合在一起，因此连接器系列、通道数量与针脚定义必须服从具体设备，而不是只看小类名称。

title.zh: 区分 LVDS 与外观相似接口

copy.en: eDP, FPD-Link, OpenLDI, camera links and proprietary display buses may use similar compact connectors while requiring different lane maps, coupling, power and validation.
copy.zh: eDP、FPD-Link、OpenLDI、摄像头链路与专用显示总线可能使用相似紧凑接口，却需要不同通道映射、耦合方式、电源与验证。

copy.en: Panel power, backlight, I²C, touch, hot-plug and enable lines are documented beside the differential pairs so no conductor is inferred from color alone.
copy.zh: 面板电源、背光、I²C、触控、热插拔与使能线需要与差分对一起记录，不能仅凭线色推断。

title.en: Keep the two conductors electrically and mechanically balanced
title.zh: 让两根导体保持电气与机械平衡

copy.en: A differential receiver responds to the voltage difference between two conductors. Conductor size, insulation diameter, dielectric, twist pitch, pair spacing and shield proximity affect impedance, attenuation and balance. Both wires in a pair should experience closely matched length, geometry, termination and surrounding materials from end to end.
copy.zh: 差分接收器响应两根导体之间的电压差。导体尺寸、绝缘外径、介质、绞距、线对间距与屏蔽距离都会影响阻抗、衰减和平衡。一对中的两根线从起点到终点应尽量经历一致的长度、几何、端接与周围材料。

copy.en: Excessive untwist at a connector creates an unbalanced discontinuity exactly where the signal is already changing media.
copy.zh: 连接器处过长的解绞会在信号介质发生变化的位置形成额外不平衡与阻抗突变。

title.zh: 控制不同线对的一致性

copy.en: Multi-lane display links also depend on comparable pair length and construction so clock and data lanes arrive within the system timing budget.
copy.zh: 多通道显示链路还依赖各线对具有可比的长度与结构，使时钟和数据通道在系统时序预算内到达。

title.en: Treat cable and connectors as a transmission line
title.zh: 把线缆与连接器作为传输线处理

copy.en: LVDS links commonly use a controlled differential path near 100 ohms, but the exact target and tolerance belong to the equipment specification. Cable, connector, board launch and receiver termination form one impedance chain. Extra transitions, incorrect termination or long stubs can create reflections that reduce eye opening even when every conductor passes continuity.
copy.zh: LVDS 链路通常使用接近 100Ω 的受控差分路径，但确切目标与公差应由设备规范确定。线缆、连接器、板端过渡与接收端端接共同构成阻抗链；多余过渡、错误端接或长支路会产生反射，即使每根导体都导通，也可能缩小眼图开口。

title.en: Do not add termination by habit

copy.en: Many receivers already include termination. Duplicating it can reduce amplitude, while omitting the required far-end termination can increase reflections.
copy.zh: 很多接收器已经内置端接，重复端接会降低幅度；遗漏所需的远端端接则可能增加反射。

copy.en: Board-to-connector, contact-to-wire, splice, adapter and test fixture discontinuities all contribute to the measured channel.
copy.zh: 板端至连接器、触点至线材、接头、转接件与测试夹具的阻抗突变都会进入最终测量通道。

title.en: The housing name does not define the signal assignment
title.zh: 连接器外壳名称不能定义信号分配

copy.en: Compact board connectors may differ by pitch, height, keying, latch, contact plating, cable exit, mating board orientation and approved wire range. The pin map must identify every positive and negative lane, clock, ground, power and control circuit together with connector view direction and cavity numbering.
copy.zh: 紧凑板端连接器可能在间距、高度、防错、锁扣、触点镀层、出线方向、对接板方向与适用线径上不同。针脚表必须结合连接器观察方向与孔位编号，明确每个正负差分通道、时钟、地线、电源与控制回路。

title.en: Confirm the mating part and board drawing
title.zh: 确认对插件与板端图纸

copy.en: A photograph helps recognition but cannot prove pitch, contact sequence, key position or electrical assignment.
copy.zh: 照片有助于识别，但无法证明间距、触点顺序、防错位置或电气定义。

copy.en: Contact seating, latch engagement, secondary locks and pull direction are checked without using the fine conductors as a handle.
copy.zh: 触点到位、卡扣啮合、二次锁与拉力方向需要检查，不能把细导体当作操作把手。

title.en: Mechanical routing becomes part of signal performance
title.zh: 机械走线本身就是信号性能的一部分

copy.en: Cable length increases loss and changes timing margin; unequal pair or lane lengths add skew. Tight folds, crushed bundles, sharp chassis edges, hinge cycles and connector torque can change pair geometry or damage shields. The released drawing therefore controls datum points, branch lengths, bend zones, fixation, service slack and prohibited routing areas.
copy.zh: 线长增加会提高损耗并改变时序裕量，线对或通道长度不一致则会增加时延差。紧折、束线挤压、锐利机壳边缘、转轴循环与连接器扭力可能改变线对几何或损坏屏蔽，因此放行图纸需要控制基准点、分支长度、弯曲区域、固定方式、维修余量与禁布区域。

copy.en: Overall length alone can hide unequal electrical paths; pair and branch definitions must use repeatable references.
copy.zh: 仅看总长可能掩盖不同电气路径，线对与分支需要使用可重复基准定义。

title.en: Keep bends away from hard transitions

copy.en: Flex should be distributed through a supported cable zone rather than concentrated at solder, crimp, shield termination or connector exits.
copy.zh: 弯曲应分布在受支撑线缆区域，而不是集中在焊接、压接、屏蔽端接或连接器出口。

title.en: Displays inside noisy equipment need a defined EMC path
title.zh: 强干扰设备内部的显示连接需要明确 EMC 路径

copy.en: Industrial HMI, machine-vision monitors, test stands and embedded computers place display links near drives, relays, motors and switching power. Pair shielding, overall shield, chassis bonding, ground references, cable separation and connector backshell treatment are coordinated with the enclosure and board design rather than specified as isolated cable features.
copy.zh: 工业 HMI、机器视觉显示器、测试台与嵌入式计算机常把显示链路布置在驱动器、继电器、电机与开关电源附近。线对屏蔽、总屏蔽、机壳搭接、地参考、线缆间距与连接器尾部处理必须与机箱和电路板设计协调，而不是作为孤立线缆特征。

title.en: Decide where the shield current returns
title.zh: 先决定屏蔽电流的回流位置

copy.en: Drain wires and shield tails are implementation details; the grounding architecture determines whether they help or create a noisy loop.
copy.zh: 排流线与屏蔽尾线只是实施细节，接地架构决定它们是在抑制干扰，还是形成噪声回路。

title.zh: 让干扰源远离敏感线对

copy.en: Distance and crossing geometry around motor, relay and power wiring can matter as much as adding another shield layer.
copy.zh: 与电机、继电器及电源线之间的距离和交叉方式，可能与增加一层屏蔽同样重要。

kicker.zh: 汽车显示与摄像头链路

title.en: Design for temperature, vibration and vehicle packaging
title.zh: 围绕温度、振动与整车空间设计

copy.en: Instrument clusters, center displays, surround-view cameras and rear-seat systems combine high-speed links with automotive temperature, vibration, restricted routing and service requirements. Depending on the electronics, the project may use LVDS or a serializer/deserializer family with its own impedance, coupling, shielding, power-over-cable and diagnostic behavior; these are not interchangeable by connector appearance.
copy.zh: 仪表盘、中控屏、环视摄像头与后排娱乐系统把高速链路置于汽车温度、振动、受限走线与维修条件中。根据电子架构，项目可能采用 LVDS 或具有自身阻抗、耦合、屏蔽、同轴/线对供电与诊断方式的串行器/解串器体系，不能凭连接器外观互换。

title.zh: 确认实际 SerDes 体系

copy.en: Data sheet, ECU and display part numbers are needed before defining lane count, shield, coupling and test limits.
copy.zh: 必须取得数据手册、ECU 与显示器型号，才能定义通道数、屏蔽、耦合方式与测试限值。

title.zh: 保护安装后的弯曲路径

copy.en: Clips, wraps, grommets and service loops prevent vibration and trim installation from repeatedly loading a compact connector.
copy.zh: 卡扣、包覆、护圈与维修弯可避免振动及内饰装配反复加载紧凑连接器。

title.en: Stable display data starts with controlled interconnects
title.zh: 稳定显示数据始于受控互连

copy.en: Patient monitors, laboratory analyzers, measurement instruments and inspection equipment may route display or acquisition data through compact internal assemblies. Low signal swing makes pair balance and common-mode behavior important, while equipment-specific safety, cleaning, isolation and traceability requirements remain separate project inputs. The page does not imply a medical certification; compliance must be defined and evidenced for the final device and project.
copy.zh: 监护仪、实验室分析设备、测量仪器与检测设备可能通过紧凑内部组件传输显示或采集数据。低信号摆幅使线对平衡与共模行为十分重要，而设备特定的安全、清洁、隔离与追溯要求仍是独立项目输入。本页面不代表医疗认证，最终设备与项目的合规性必须另行定义并以证据确认。

title.en: Keep functional and safety evidence separate
title.zh: 区分功能证据与安全证据

copy.en: A correct image does not demonstrate dielectric, leakage, isolation or cleaning compatibility; each acceptance item needs its own method.
copy.zh: 图像正确并不能证明耐压、漏电、隔离或清洁兼容性，每项接收要求都需要独立方法。

copy.en: Approved connector, wire, shield, assembly revision and inspection record can be linked to the released configuration when required.
copy.zh: 需要时可将批准连接器、线材、屏蔽、组件版本与检验记录关联到放行配置。

title.en: Continuity is necessary, but it is not a high-speed result
title.zh: 导通是必要条件，但不是高速性能结果

copy.en: Routine checks verify circuit, shorts, connector orientation, dimensions, labels and workmanship. Project validation may add differential impedance or TDR, insertion loss, pair and lane skew, eye diagram, jitter, bit-error or functional display testing, shield continuity, flex, vibration and environmental exposure. Test fixtures, equipment bandwidth, patterns, data rate, cable length and acceptance masks are recorded with any result.
copy.zh: 常规检验确认回路、短路、连接器方向、尺寸、标签与工艺。项目验证还可增加差分阻抗或 TDR、插入损耗、线对与通道时延差、眼图、抖动、误码或显示功能测试、屏蔽导通、弯曲、振动及环境暴露。任何结果都应同时记录测试夹具、设备带宽、码型、数据速率、线长与接收模板。

copy.en: Cable length and connector stack used for validation should represent the released product; an ideal laboratory jumper cannot substitute for it.
copy.zh: 验证所用线长与连接器链应代表放行产品，理想实验室跳线不能替代真实组件。

title.zh: 冻结对变更敏感的细节

copy.en: Wire construction, twist, shield, connector, contact, strip length, termination, tooling and routing controls become part of the repeat-production baseline.
copy.zh: 线材结构、绞距、屏蔽、连接器、触点、剥线长度、端接、工具与走线控制共同成为重复生产基线。

q.en: Is every display cable an LVDS cable?
q.zh: 所有显示屏线都是 LVDS 线吗？

a.en: No. Displays may use LVDS, eDP, MIPI, FPD-Link, GMSL or proprietary parallel/serial interfaces. Connector appearance alone cannot identify the electrical interface.
a.zh: 不是。显示系统可能使用 LVDS、eDP、MIPI、FPD-Link、GMSL 或专用并行/串行接口，仅凭连接器外观无法判断电气接口。

q.en: Can the cable be built from an old sample?
q.zh: 可以依据旧样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample helps with connector, length and routing, but data rate, pin map, pair assignment, impedance, termination, shield grounding, power circuits and acceptance limits still require equipment data or engineering confirmation.
a.zh: 样品有助于确认连接器、长度与走线，但数据速率、针脚表、线对分配、阻抗、端接、屏蔽接地、电源回路与接收限值仍需设备资料或工程确认。

q.en: Does 100-ohm cable guarantee a good LVDS link?
q.zh: 使用 100Ω 线缆就一定能保证 LVDS 链路正常吗？

a.en: No. Connector and board transitions, pair balance, length, loss, termination, stubs, grounding, crosstalk and the actual transmitter/receiver also affect the complete channel.
a.zh: 不能。连接器与板端过渡、线对平衡、长度、损耗、端接、支路、接地、串扰及实际收发器都会影响完整通道。

q.en: Can power and backlight wires be included?
q.zh: 可以同时包含电源与背光线吗？

a.en: Yes, when voltage, current, return path, sequencing, connector rating, separation and thermal conditions are defined. They are documented separately from the high-speed pairs.
a.zh: 可以，但需要明确电压、电流、回流路径、上电顺序、连接器额定值、间距与热条件，并与高速差分对分开记录。

q.en: Why can a cable pass continuity but still show flicker?
q.zh: 为什么线缆导通正常，画面仍可能闪烁？

a.en: Continuity does not reveal impedance discontinuity, attenuation, skew, poor termination, intermittent contact, grounding noise or marginal timing. The agreed high-speed or functional test is needed.
a.zh: 导通无法揭示阻抗突变、衰减、时延差、端接不良、间歇接触、接地噪声或临界时序，需要执行约定的高速或功能测试。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要哪些资料？

a.en: Provide both mating interfaces and drawings, equipment or chipset models, pin map, pair/lane count, data rate, target impedance, cable and branch lengths, auxiliary power/control circuits, shield/ground plan, movement and environment, quantity, labels and validation requirements.
a.zh: 请提供两端对接接口与图纸、设备或芯片型号、针脚表、线对/通道数量、数据速率、目标阻抗、线长与分支长度、附加电源/控制回路、屏蔽接地方案、运动与环境、数量、标签及验证要求。

intro.en: RF and coaxial cable assemblies carry radio-frequency, microwave, video, timing and antenna signals through a controlled-impedance path. This category includes flexible, low-loss, miniature, semi-rigid, panel-mount and application-specific assemblies—not one universal coax lead.
intro.zh: RF 与同轴电缆组件通过受控阻抗路径传输射频、微波、视频、时钟与天线信号。这一小类覆盖柔性、低损耗、微型、半刚性、面板安装及按应用定义的组件，并不是一种通用同轴线。

knowledge.en: Coaxial performance belongs to the whole channel: conductor geometry, dielectric, shield, connector interface, termination, cable length and installed routing. Connector names alone do not define impedance, usable frequency, power, loss or environmental capability.
knowledge.zh: 同轴性能属于整条通道：导体几何、介质、屏蔽、连接器界面、终端、线长与安装路由需要一起定义。仅有连接器名称不能确定阻抗、可用频率、功率、损耗或环境能力。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, standard or reverse polarity, impedance, frequency band, power and DC bias, maximum insertion loss and return-loss/VSWR target, cable length and phase requirement, shielding or PIM requirement, routing and bend radius, panel sealing, environment, quantity and agreed test method.
notes.zh: 请提供两端对接界面、标准或反极性、阻抗、频段、功率与直流偏置、最大插入损耗和回波损耗/VSWR 目标、线长与相位要求、屏蔽或 PIM 要求、走线与弯曲半径、面板密封、环境、数量及约定测试方法。

delivery.en: Engineering first freezes the channel definition and mechanical envelope, then builds controlled samples. Released production can include connector gauging, visual and dimensional inspection, continuity and the RF measurements explicitly agreed for the project; limits and fixtures are recorded with the result.
delivery.zh: 工程团队先冻结通道定义与机械包络，再制作受控样品。放行生产可包括连接器量规、外观与尺寸、导通，以及项目明确约定的 RF 测量；限值与夹具与结果一同记录。

subtitle.en: Impedance, loss, shielding, connectors and installed RF performance
subtitle.zh: 阻抗、损耗、屏蔽、连接器与安装后 RF 性能

lead.en: A useful RF cable is not selected from a connector photograph. We define the operating band, impedance, loss budget, return path, connector reference plane and installed environment first; cable family and termination process follow those inputs.
lead.zh: 有效的 RF 电缆不能只凭连接器照片选择。我们先定义工作频段、阻抗、损耗预算、回流路径、连接器参考面与安装环境，再选择线缆系列和端接工艺。

introduction.en: Specify the Channel Before the Cable
introduction.zh: 先定义通道，再定义电缆

faq.zh: RF 与同轴电缆组件常见问题

title.en: One category covers many electrical and mechanical constructions
title.zh: 一个小类覆盖多种电气与机械结构

copy.en: RF assemblies may use miniature flexible coax for internal modules, low-loss cable for longer antenna runs, highly flexible cable for service movement, semi-rigid or conformable cable for stable routing, phase-matched sets for multi-channel systems, or rugged panel leads for outdoor equipment. Straight, right-angle, bulkhead and pigtail arrangements can be combined, but every construction has a different loss, bend, size and termination envelope.
copy.zh: RF 组件可以采用微型柔性同轴线连接内部模块，使用低损线完成较长天线路径，使用高柔线应对维护运动，也可以使用半刚性或可成形线保持路由稳定，或制作多通道相位匹配组和户外面板引线。直式、弯式、隔板式与尾线式可组合，但每种结构都有不同的损耗、弯曲、尺寸与端接边界。

title.en: Flexible does not mean low loss

copy.en: Fine, flexible constructions often trade diameter and motion capability against attenuation, shielding or power handling.
copy.zh: 细径高柔结构往往需要在直径和运动能力与衰减、屏蔽或功率承载之间取舍。

copy.en: The cable family, support and minimum bend radius should match whether the installed section bends once or repeatedly.
copy.zh: 线缆系列、支撑与最小弯曲半径应匹配安装部位是一次弯曲还是重复运动。

title.en: The dielectric and conductor geometry create the transmission line
title.zh: 介质与导体几何共同形成传输线

copy.en: A coaxial line places an inner conductor inside a dielectric and concentric outer conductor. Conductor diameter, dielectric constant and dimensions establish characteristic impedance and influence capacitance, velocity and attenuation. Solid, stranded and plated conductors; solid or foamed dielectrics; foil, braid and solid outer conductors therefore cannot be substituted on appearance alone.
copy.zh: 同轴线把内导体置于介质与同心外导体内。导体直径、介电常数与几何尺寸建立特性阻抗，并影响电容、传播速度与衰减。实心、绞合或镀层内导体，实心或发泡介质，以及铝箔、编织或实心外导体都不能只凭外观替代。

copy.en: Crush, ovalization and poor strip control change the field geometry and can create a local impedance discontinuity.
copy.zh: 挤压、失圆与剥线控制不良会改变电场几何，并可能形成局部阻抗突变。

copy.en: Temperature, flexibility, flame, chemical exposure and frequency all affect conductor, dielectric, shield and jacket selection.
copy.zh: 温度、柔性、阻燃、化学暴露与工作频率会共同影响导体、介质、屏蔽与护套选择。

title.en: Series, gender and polarity must all be correct
title.zh: 系列、性别与极性必须同时正确

copy.en: SMA, RP-SMA, SMB, SMC, MCX, MMCX, BNC, TNC, N-type, UHF, FAKRA and other families differ in coupling, size, impedance, usable band, sealing and mechanical retention. Standard and reverse-polarity versions can share the same external thread while reversing the center contact. The exact mating part number, interface drawing and orientation should be frozen before tooling or sampling.
copy.zh: SMA、RP-SMA、SMB、SMC、MCX、MMCX、BNC、TNC、N 型、UHF、FAKRA 等系列在耦合方式、尺寸、阻抗、可用频段、密封与机械保持上都有区别。标准型与反极性型可能共用外螺纹，却将中心触点反转。开始工装或打样前应冻结对插件精确型号、界面图与方向。

title.zh: 照片不是界面控制文件

copy.en: A photo may not reveal dielectric depth, center-contact gender, key code, thread or reference plane.
copy.zh: 照片可能无法显示介质深度、中心触点性别、防错编码、螺纹或参考面。

title.zh: 扭矩是可重复性的一部分

copy.en: Threaded RF interfaces need the mating and torque practice specified for that connector, especially during measurement.
copy.zh: 螺纹 RF 界面需要采用该连接器规定的对插与扭矩方法，测量时尤其如此。

title.en: A connector that mates mechanically may still be electrically wrong
title.zh: 能够机械对插仍可能在电气上错误

copy.en: Fifty-ohm systems are common in RF, wireless and test equipment; 75-ohm systems are common in video and broadcast distribution. Some connector families have both impedance versions, and mixing them can create a discontinuity or damage contacts even when coupling appears possible. The equipment port, cable and both connectors must belong to the same defined impedance system.
copy.zh: 50Ω 系统常见于 RF、无线与测试设备，75Ω 系统常见于视频与广播分配。某些连接器系列同时存在两种阻抗版本，混用时即使看似可以耦合，也可能产生阻抗突变或损伤触点。设备端口、线缆与两端连接器必须属于同一明确的阻抗系统。

title.en: Do not infer impedance from shell shape
title.zh: 不要从外壳形状推断阻抗

copy.en: Dielectric and center-contact geometry determine the RF interface, not only the bayonet or thread outside.
copy.zh: 介质与中心触点几何才定义 RF 界面，不只是外部卡口或螺纹。

copy.en: Every adapter adds two interfaces and should be included in loss and return-loss review.
copy.zh: 每个转接器都增加两个界面，应计入损耗与回波审核。

title.en: Insertion loss is a function of frequency, length and construction
title.zh: 插入损耗取决于频率、长度与结构

copy.en: Attenuation generally rises with frequency and cable length. Connector loss and transitions add to the cable contribution, while temperature, bend condition and manufacturing variation can change the result. A quotation should therefore state the operating band, assembly length, connector pair and maximum accepted loss—not a cable attenuation value copied without its frequency and units.
copy.zh: 衰减通常随频率与线长增加。连接器损耗和过渡会叠加到线缆损耗上，温度、弯曲状态与制造差异也可能改变结果。因此报价资料应明确工作频段、组件长度、连接器对与最大允许损耗，不能把脱离频率和单位的线缆衰减值直接复制进来。

copy.en: Cable, both connectors, adapters, bulkheads and any launch or fixture must be assigned consistently.
copy.zh: 线缆、两端连接器、转接器、隔板和任何过渡或夹具都应采用一致的边界定义。

copy.en: A single “low loss” label is not an acceptance criterion; frequency points and units make the requirement testable.
copy.zh: 单独一个“低损”标签不是接收标准，频点与单位才能让要求可测量。

title.en: Transitions and termination determine how much energy reflects
title.zh: 过渡与终端决定反射能量

copy.en: Return loss and VSWR describe mismatch, not the same phenomenon as insertion loss. Excess strip length, braid disturbance, solder accumulation, incorrect dielectric position, poor panel launch or a wrong load can create reflections. Performance is referenced to defined connector planes and a calibrated measurement band, so the drawing and fixture must agree on where the cable assembly begins and ends.
copy.zh: 回波损耗与 VSWR 描述失配，与插入损耗不是同一现象。剥线过长、编织层被扰乱、焊料堆积、介质位置不对、面板过渡不良或负载错误都可能产生反射。性能应相对明确的连接器参考面与校准频段测量，因此图纸与夹具必须对组件始末边界达成一致。

copy.en: Strip dimensions and shield termination shape are electrical dimensions at RF, not only workmanship dimensions.
copy.zh: 剥线尺寸与屏蔽端接形状在 RF 中是电气尺寸，不只是工艺尺寸。

copy.en: Fixture and adapter effects must be removed or included consistently before comparing a result with its limit.
copy.zh: 在将结果与限值比较前，夹具与转接器的影响必须一致地去嵌或计入。

title.en: Coverage, bonding and contact cleanliness matter together
title.zh: 覆盖率、搭接与接触清洁必须同时受控

copy.en: Foil, braid, double-braid and solid outer conductors provide different shielding, flexibility and termination behavior. Shield effectiveness can be defeated by a long exposed tail or poor 360-degree termination. In systems sensitive to passive intermodulation, loose or contaminated metal contacts, ferromagnetic materials, plating condition, torque and cable movement may become part of the acceptance plan; PIM capability is never inferred from appearance.
copy.zh: 铝箔、编织、双层编织与实心外导体具有不同的屏蔽、柔性与端接特性。过长的暴露尾端或不良 360° 端接会破坏屏蔽效果。对无源交调敏感的系统中，松动或污染的金属接触、铁磁材料、镀层状态、扭矩与线缆运动都可能进入接收计划；PIM 能力绝不能从外观推断。

copy.en: Pigtail, crimp ferrule and full-circumference terminations have different high-frequency behavior.
copy.zh: 尾线、压接套管与全圆周端接具有不同的高频行为。

copy.en: Cleaning, protective caps, plating inspection and torque discipline protect repeatable RF contact.
copy.zh: 清洁、防护帽、镀层检查与扭矩纪律保护 RF 接触的可重复性。

title.en: Installed bends, water paths and strain decide field reliability
title.zh: 安装弯曲、进水路径与应变决定现场可靠性

copy.en: Repeated flexing, tight tie-downs, connector side load, vibration, abrasion and water tracking can change the cable or interface after it passes bench testing. Outdoor and vehicle projects may require sealed bulkheads, boots, heat shrink, drip paths, UV- or chemical-resistant jackets and protected routing. The requested IP or environmental result belongs to the complete mated and installed configuration, not to a loose cable photograph.
copy.zh: 重复弯曲、过紧绑扎、连接器侧向负载、振动、磨损与沿线进水可能在台架测试通过后继续改变线缆或界面。户外与车载项目可能需要密封隔板、尾套、热缩、滴水路径、耐紫外或耐化学护套与受保护走线。所要求的 IP 或环境结果属于完整对插与安装配置，不属于一根散线照片。

title.zh: 区分一次弯曲与重复弯曲

copy.en: A routing bend used during installation is not the same duty as a hinge, service loop or moving carriage.
copy.zh: 安装时的路由弯曲与铰链、维护弯或移动滑台的工况不同。

title.en: Protect the connector from cable load
title.zh: 让连接器免受线缆负载

copy.en: Clamps and strain relief transfer pull and vibration into a supported cable zone rather than the RF interface.
copy.zh: 夹具与应力缓解将拉力和振动传递到受支撑线段，而不是 RF 界面。

title.en: Antenna links combine RF performance with coded vehicle packaging
title.zh: 天线链路将 RF 性能与编码式整车布置结合

copy.en: GNSS, AM/FM, cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, V2X, satellite and remote-entry systems can use different cables, connector codes and frequency bands within one vehicle. FAKRA and miniature coax interfaces add mechanical keying and color coding, but the coding does not replace confirmation of the RF port, standard, cable loss, power-over-coax condition, temperature, vibration and installed route.
copy.zh: GNSS、AM/FM、蜂窝通信、Wi-Fi、蓝牙、V2X、卫星与遥控进入系统可能在同一辆车内使用不同线缆、连接器编码与频段。FAKRA 与微型同轴界面增加机械防错和颜色编码，但编码不能代替对 RF 端口、制式、线缆损耗、同轴供电状态、温度、振动与安装路由的确认。

copy.en: Housing color, mechanical key and cable exit must match the vehicle-side interface and assembly sequence.
copy.zh: 外壳颜色、机械防错与出线方向必须匹配整车端界面与装配顺序。

title.en: Confirm DC on the RF path
title.zh: 确认 RF 路径上的直流

copy.en: Active antennas or remote modules may receive bias power through the same coax and need current and short-circuit review.
copy.zh: 有源天线或远端模块可能通过同一同轴线获得偏置供电，需要审核电流与短路状态。

title.en: Short internal jumpers and long antenna feeds solve different problems
title.zh: 短距内部跳线与长距天线馈线解决不同问题

copy.en: Embedded radios, software-defined radio, gateways, remote I/O, telemetry and industrial wireless devices may need board-level micro-coax jumpers, panel pigtails or longer low-loss antenna leads. Space, mating cycles, module service, enclosure grounding, ESD route and separation from digital or power noise affect the assembly just as much as nominal frequency.
copy.zh: 嵌入式无线模块、软件定义无线电、网关、远程 I/O、遥测与工业无线设备可能需要板级微型同轴跳线、面板尾线或较长低损天线线。空间、对插次数、模块维护、机箱接地、ESD 路径以及与数字或功率噪声的隔离，与标称频率同样影响组件。

copy.en: Tiny board connectors need defined insertion direction, tool access and pull tabs so service does not load the cable.
copy.zh: 微型板端连接器需要明确插入方向、工具空间与拉带，避免维护操作拉扯线缆。

copy.en: Bulkhead location, grounding and internal strain relief should be reviewed as one mechanical and EMC detail.
copy.zh: 隔板位置、接地与内部应力缓解应作为一个机械与 EMC 细节审核。

title.en: Strip, contact and shield dimensions are RF-critical process controls
title.zh: 剥线、触点与屏蔽尺寸是 RF 关键工艺控制

copy.en: Crimp, solder, clamp and compression connector designs each require their own preparation dimensions, tools, inspection criteria and rework limits. Center-conductor damage, dielectric nicking, loose braid strands, solder wicking and incorrect ferrule position can change both mechanical retention and high-frequency response. The approved work instruction must therefore follow the exact connector and cable pairing.
copy.zh: 压接、焊接、夹持与压缩式连接器分别需要自己的准备尺寸、工具、检验标准与返工限制。内导体损伤、介质划伤、编织丝松散、焊料爬升与套管位置错误都可能同时改变机械保持与高频响应。因此批准作业文件必须针对精确的连接器与线缆组合。

copy.en: Die, positioner, strip tool, torque wrench and interface gauge are selected from the approved component system.
copy.zh: 模具、定位器、剥线工具、扭矩手及界面量规应来自批准元件系统。

copy.en: Contact, dielectric and shield preparation should be checked before boots or heat shrink hide the termination.
copy.zh: 触点、介质与屏蔽准备应在尾套或热缩将端接遮蔽前检查。

title.en: Measure the parameters that the application actually depends on
title.zh: 测量应用真正依赖的参数

copy.en: Routine production checks can verify configuration, connector orientation, dimensions, labeling, continuity and workmanship. Depending on the project, RF validation may include insertion loss, return loss or VSWR, time-domain distance-to-fault, phase or delay matching, shielding, PIM, power, flex or environmental exposure. Instrument, calibration method, reference plane, frequency sweep, fixture, cable state and limit are documented; a network-analyzer screenshot without those conditions is not a complete result.
copy.zh: 常规生产检查可验证配置、连接器方向、尺寸、标签、导通与工艺。根据项目，RF 验证可能包括插入损耗、回波损耗或 VSWR、时域故障距离、相位或延时匹配、屏蔽、PIM、功率、弯曲或环境暴露。仪器、校准方法、参考面、扫频、夹具、线缆状态与限值都需记录；缺少这些条件的网络分析仪截图不是完整结果。

title.en: Test the released length and connector stack
title.zh: 测试放行长度与连接器链

copy.en: A short laboratory lead cannot represent a longer product or a product containing bulkheads and adapters.
copy.zh: 短实验室线不能代表更长产品，也不能代表包含隔板与转接器的产品。

title.zh: 冻结对变更敏感的变量

copy.en: Cable construction, connector revision, strip dimensions, tooling, torque and test setup form the repeat-production baseline.
copy.zh: 线缆结构、连接器版本、剥线尺寸、工具、扭矩与测试设置共同形成重复生产基线。

q.en: Can an RF cable be selected from connector photos?
q.zh: 可以只凭连接器照片选择 RF 电缆吗？

a.en: No. Photos help identify a family, but exact interface, gender, polarity, impedance, frequency, cable type, length and environment still require drawings, part numbers or equipment data.
a.zh: 不可以。照片只有助于识别系列，精确界面、性别、极性、阻抗、频率、线缆类型、长度与环境仍需图纸、型号或设备资料。

q.en: What is the difference between 50-ohm and 75-ohm coax?
q.zh: 50Ω 与 75Ω 同轴线有什么区别？

a.en: They use different conductor and dielectric geometry and serve different systems. Fifty ohms is common in RF and test equipment; 75 ohms is common in video and broadcast. The cable and both interfaces must match the equipment impedance.
a.zh: 它们使用不同导体与介质几何，服务于不同系统。50Ω 常见于 RF 与测试设备，75Ω 常见于视频与广播；线缆和两端界面都必须匹配设备阻抗。

q.en: Does a higher-frequency connector guarantee the complete cable rating?
q.zh: 使用更高频率连接器就能保证整条电缆频率吗？

a.en: No. The usable assembly band is limited by the cable, both connectors, termination quality, transitions, length, routing and acceptance limits. The complete assembly must be reviewed and, where required, measured.
a.zh: 不能。组件可用频段受线缆、两端连接器、端接质量、过渡、长度、路由与接收限值共同限制，需要审核完整组件，必要时进行测量。

q.en: Can you build phase-matched RF cable sets?
q.zh: 可以制作相位匹配 RF 电缆组吗？

a.en: The project can be reviewed when frequency band, number of channels, nominal length, phase or delay tolerance, bend state, connector planes and test method are defined. Capability and limits are confirmed before quotation.
a.zh: 当频段、通道数、标称长度、相位或延时公差、弯曲状态、连接器参考面与测试方法明确时可进入项目审核，报价前确认能力与限值。

q.en: Is continuity testing enough for an RF assembly?
q.zh: 导通测试足以验证 RF 组件吗？

a.en: Continuity detects open and short circuits but does not measure insertion loss, mismatch, phase, shielding or PIM. The application determines which additional RF tests and limits are needed.
a.zh: 导通可检测开路与短路，但不能测量插入损耗、失配、相位、屏蔽或 PIM。应用决定需要哪些附加 RF 测试与限值。

q.en: What should be supplied for a custom quotation?
q.zh: 定制报价应提供哪些资料？

a.en: Send mating connector part numbers or drawings, impedance, frequency band, length, cable and exit preference, power or bias, loss and VSWR targets, shielding or PIM requirement, environment, quantity and validation method. A physical sample can supplement but not replace electrical definition.
a.zh: 请提供对插连接器型号或图纸、阻抗、频段、长度、线缆与出线偏好、功率或偏置、损耗与 VSWR 目标、屏蔽或 PIM 要求、环境、数量与验证方法。实物样品可作为补充，不能代替电气定义。

intro.en: Aerospace project cable assemblies connect avionics, sensors, actuators, power distribution, communication equipment and ground-support interfaces. This is a project-defined family spanning aircraft, unmanned systems, test rigs and spacecraft-related equipment—not a claim that one generic harness is flight-qualified.
intro.zh: 航空航天项目电缆组件用于连接航电设备、传感器、执行器、配电、通信设备与地面保障接口。这是覆盖飞机、无人系统、试验台及航天相关设备的项目定义类别，并不表示某一种通用线束天然具备飞行资格。

knowledge.en: The assembly is governed by the released drawing and flowed-down requirements. Electrical load, signal integrity, mass, routing, derating, vibration, temperature, pressure, fluids, flammability, outgassing, shielding, workmanship and traceability can all change the construction.
knowledge.zh: 组件应以放行图纸和逐级下达的要求为准。电气负载、信号完整性、重量、走线、降额、振动、温度、压力、液体、阻燃、放气、屏蔽、工艺与追溯都可能改变其结构。

notes.en: Provide the platform and installation zone, applicable drawing and revision, mating connector part numbers, circuit and shield schedule, voltage/current/signal data, wire and component specifications, length and branch datum, mass or space limits, environmental profile, workmanship standard, prohibited processes, inspection hold points, serialization and acceptance test plan.
notes.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、适用图纸及版本、对插件型号、回路与屏蔽表、电压/电流/信号数据、线材和器件规范、长度与分支基准、重量或空间限制、环境谱、工艺标准、禁用工艺、检验停点、序列化和验收测试计划。

delivery.en: We review aerospace-related work project by project. Materials, personnel or process approvals, special tooling, samples, qualification evidence and customer source inspection are agreed before production. Routine manufacturing capability does not replace platform approval, airworthiness approval or mission qualification.
delivery.zh: 航空航天相关工作按项目逐项审核。材料、人员或工艺批准、专用工具、样品、鉴定证据与客户源检要求需在生产前约定。常规制造能力不能替代平台批准、适航批准或任务鉴定。

subtitle.en: Configuration, mass, environment, workmanship and evidence under one controlled definition
subtitle.zh: 在一个受控定义下管理配置、重量、环境、工艺与证据

lead.en: An aerospace harness is an installed system component. Connector family and wire gauge are only the beginning: every branch, shield, clamp, splice, backshell, label and test point must relate to the approved design, installation environment and acceptance plan.
lead.zh: 航空航天线束是安装系统的一部分。连接器系列和线径只是起点；每个分支、屏蔽、夹具、接续、尾罩、标签与测试点都必须对应批准的设计、安装环境与验收计划。

introduction.en: Build to a Controlled Mission Definition
introduction.zh: 围绕受控任务定义制造

faq.zh: 航空航天项目电缆组件常见问题

title.en: One category spans airframe, avionics, propulsion and support equipment
title.zh: 一个小类覆盖机体、航电、推进与保障设备

copy.en: Projects can include point-to-point avionics leads, branched airframe harnesses, engine or actuator looms, sensor and thermocouple extensions, shielded data cables, RF jumpers, power feeders, test adapters and ground-support assemblies. A prototype drone loom and a crewed-aircraft flight harness may look similar but carry very different material, process, documentation and approval obligations.
copy.zh: 项目可包括点对点航电引线、分支机体线束、发动机或执行器线束、传感器与热电偶延长线、屏蔽数据线、RF 跳线、供电馈线、测试转接线及地面保障组件。无人机样机线束与载人飞机飞行线束外观可能相似，但材料、工艺、文件与批准义务可能完全不同。

copy.en: Pressurized cabin, engine bay, wing, external pod, payload, test rack and launch environment impose different hazards.
copy.zh: 增压舱、发动机舱、机翼、外挂、载荷、测试机架与发射环境具有不同风险。

copy.en: Ground-support assemblies can still be mission critical, but their materials, mating cycles and acceptance plan may differ.
copy.zh: 地面保障组件仍可能任务关键，但其材料、插拔次数与验收计划可能不同。

title.en: Shell size, insert arrangement, keying and finish are controlled together
title.zh: 壳体尺寸、孔位排列、防错与表面处理共同受控

copy.en: Aerospace circular and rectangular connectors are selected by the exact specification, series, shell, insert arrangement, contact type, keying, coupling, backshell and finish. Similar-looking parts may not mate or may differ in contact retention, sealing, vibration response, shielding or environmental compatibility. Mating interface drawings and approved manufacturer part numbers take priority over photographs.
copy.zh: 航空航天圆形与矩形连接器需要按准确规范、系列、壳体、孔位排列、触点类型、防错、锁紧、尾罩与表面处理选择。外形相似的零件可能无法对插，也可能在触点保持、密封、抗振、屏蔽或环境兼容性上不同。对插界面图和批准制造商型号优先于照片。

copy.en: Contact size, wire range, sealing plugs, grommets, banding and strain relief belong to the connector system.
copy.zh: 触点尺寸、适用线径、封堵件、密封圈、束带和应力消除都属于连接器系统。

title.en: Do not generalize from MIL-style appearance
title.zh: 不能凭军规外观推断性能

copy.en: A metal shell or catalogue description does not prove qualification to a required specification or platform.
copy.zh: 金属壳体或目录描述不能证明已经满足指定规范或平台鉴定。

title.en: Materials follow current, temperature, mass and chemical exposure
title.zh: 材料选择服从电流、温度、重量与化学暴露

copy.en: Copper alloy, tin-, silver- or nickel-plated copper, and insulation families such as ETFE, cross-linked fluoropolymer, PTFE or polyimide are considered only against the governing specification and installation duty. Fine-gauge conductors can reduce mass but increase voltage drop and handling sensitivity; plating and insulation choices affect temperature capability, termination process, flex behavior and compatibility with fluids or cleaning agents.
copy.zh: 铜合金、镀锡、镀银或镀镍铜，以及 ETFE、交联氟聚合物、PTFE 或聚酰亚胺等绝缘体系，都必须结合适用规范与安装工况审核。细线径可降低重量，却会增加压降与加工敏感性；镀层和绝缘会影响耐温、端接工艺、弯曲行为及与液体或清洗剂的兼容性。

title.zh: 依据真实束内条件降额

copy.en: Ambient temperature, bundle size, duty cycle and ventilation affect allowable current and temperature rise.
copy.zh: 环境温度、线束规模、工作周期与通风条件都会影响允许电流和温升。

copy.en: Equivalent gauge alone does not make conductor plating, insulation wall or strand construction interchangeable.
copy.zh: 线径相同并不代表导体镀层、绝缘壁厚或绞线结构可以互换。

title.en: Branch geometry, support and service loops protect the installed harness
title.zh: 分支几何、支撑与维修余量共同保护安装后的线束

copy.en: Form-board datums translate the released installation into repeatable branch lengths, clocking and breakout positions. Clamps, lacing, sleeving, grommets and service loops prevent the harness from transferring mass and vibration into contacts. Bend radius, crossover, chafe points, moving controls and installation sequence are reviewed before freezing the drawing.
copy.zh: 工装板基准把放行安装状态转化为可重复的分支长度、角度和出线位置。夹具、绑扎、套管、护圈与维修余量可避免线束重量和振动传递到触点。冻结图纸前还要审核弯曲半径、交叉点、磨损点、运动控制部件与安装顺序。

title.en: Do not use ties as a drawing substitute
title.zh: 不能用扎带代替结构定义

copy.en: Tie location and tension must preserve geometry without crushing insulation or distorting the bundle.
copy.zh: 绑扎位置与张力应保持几何，同时不能压伤绝缘或扭曲线束。

copy.en: A harness that lies neatly on a bench can still be overstressed after mating and clamping in the vehicle.
copy.zh: 工作台上整齐的线束在装机、对插和夹紧后仍可能承受过大应力。

title.en: Shield coverage and termination geometry define the return path
title.zh: 屏蔽覆盖与端接几何共同定义回流路径

copy.en: Twisted pairs, individual shields, overall braid, conductive backshells and shield jumpers serve different interference and grounding plans. Long pigtails add inductance and can become ineffective at higher frequency; full-circumference terminations may improve high-frequency behavior but require compatible hardware and controlled assembly. Shield grounding at one end, both ends or through the chassis must follow the system design.
copy.zh: 双绞线、单独屏蔽、总编织层、导电尾罩与屏蔽引线服务于不同的干扰与接地方案。过长尾线会增加电感，在更高频率下可能失效；360° 端接可改善高频表现，但需要匹配硬件和受控装配。屏蔽单端、双端或通过机壳接地必须遵循系统设计。

copy.en: Drawing and circuit schedule should show which shield terminates where and whether a drain or jumper is permitted.
copy.zh: 图纸与回路表应标明每层屏蔽的端接位置，以及是否允许排流线或跳线。

copy.en: Separation, twisting and return-path control are reviewed alongside the harness route, not after installation.
copy.zh: 间距、绞合与回流路径应与线束路由同时审核，而不是安装完成后补救。

title.en: Temperature, vibration, pressure and contamination require separate evidence
title.zh: 温度、振动、压力与污染需要分别提供证据

copy.en: Launch vibration, aircraft vibration, thermal cycling, altitude or vacuum, humidity, salt atmosphere, hydraulic fluid, fuel, cleaning agents, fungus, radiation and flammability are distinct requirements. Material data can support selection, but complete-assembly performance depends on geometry, interfaces and process. Environmental tests, severities, sample size and pass criteria must be flowed down rather than inferred from a category name.
copy.zh: 发射振动、飞机振动、热循环、高度或真空、湿热、盐雾、液压油、燃油、清洗剂、霉菌、辐射与阻燃是彼此独立的要求。材料数据可以支持选型，但完整组件性能仍取决于几何、界面与工艺。环境试验、严酷度、样本量和通过准则必须逐项下达，不能从类别名称推断。

copy.en: Changing wire, connector, backshell, splice, potting or routing can invalidate the relevance of prior evidence.
copy.zh: 更换线材、连接器、尾罩、接续、灌封或走线后，原有证据可能不再适用。

title.zh: 分别定义存储与工作环境

copy.en: Non-operating storage, transport and powered operation may use different temperature and vibration profiles.
copy.zh: 非工作存储、运输与通电运行可能采用不同温度和振动谱。

title.en: Mixed signal types need controlled separation and interfaces
title.zh: 混合信号需要受控隔离与明确接口

copy.en: An avionics harness may combine discrete I/O, serial data, Ethernet, RF, analog sensors, thermocouples, resolver lines and power. Each circuit family has its own impedance, twist, shielding, return, isolation and connector-contact constraints. The pin schedule must distinguish signal names, mates, splices, shields and unused contacts so that continuity alone cannot hide a functional error.
copy.zh: 航电线束可能同时包含离散 I/O、串行数据、以太网、RF、模拟传感器、热电偶、旋变线与供电。每类回路都有自身阻抗、绞距、屏蔽、回流、隔离与连接器触点约束。针脚表必须区分信号名称、对插端、接续、屏蔽与空闲触点，避免仅靠导通掩盖功能错误。

copy.en: Thermocouple and other low-level measurement circuits need compatible conductors, transitions and reference-junction treatment.
copy.zh: 热电偶等低电平测量回路需要兼容导体、过渡与参考端处理。

copy.en: Unterminated, spare and reserved circuits require an explicit insulation, sealing and identification method.
copy.zh: 未端接、备用与保留回路需要明确绝缘、密封和标识方法。

title.en: Rapid development still needs a frozen electrical baseline
title.zh: 快速开发仍需要冻结电气基线

copy.en: Unmanned aircraft, payloads, simulators and laboratory rigs often evolve quickly. Modular breakouts and test adapters can accelerate integration, but pinout, polarity, power sequencing, interlocks and software-controlled lines must be revisioned. Development harnesses should be visibly distinguished from released hardware to prevent an experimental configuration entering service by mistake.
copy.zh: 无人机、载荷、模拟器与实验室台架往往快速迭代。模块化分支和测试转接线可加速集成，但针脚、极性、上电顺序、互锁与软件控制线必须进行版本管理。开发线束应与放行硬件明显区分，防止实验配置误入使用。

copy.en: Part number, revision, serial status and temporary modifications should be readable without opening the bundle.
copy.zh: 无需拆开线束即可识别料号、版本、序列状态与临时改动。

title.zh: 有意识地设计测试接口

copy.en: Breakouts and measurement points must avoid creating stubs, loading or unsafe exposed power.
copy.zh: 分支测试点应避免形成支路、额外负载或危险的裸露电源。

title.en: Preparation, tooling and inspection preserve every conductor
title.zh: 线材准备、工具与检验共同保护每根导体

copy.en: Controlled stripping avoids nicked strands, crushed insulation and damaged shields. Contacts are matched to wire size and finish, crimped with specified tooling and inspected for conductor position, deformation and retention. Soldered terminations, solder sleeves, shield rings, splices, potting and heat-shrink operations require their own approved parameters and inspection points.
copy.zh: 受控剥线可避免伤丝、压伤绝缘和损坏屏蔽。触点需匹配线径与镀层，使用规定工具压接，并检查导体位置、变形与保持。焊接端接、焊锡环、屏蔽环、接续、灌封与热缩工序各自需要批准参数和检验点。

title.zh: 工具属于工艺的一部分

copy.en: Applicator, locator, die, calibration and maintenance status are linked to the termination instruction.
copy.zh: 压模、定位器、刀具、校准与维护状态应关联到端接作业要求。

copy.en: Hidden shield, splice, solder or potting features need in-process evidence before backshells and coverings close.
copy.zh: 被尾罩与包覆遮蔽的屏蔽、接续、焊接或灌封特征，需要在封闭前留下过程证据。

title.en: Foreign-object and contamination control continue through packaging
title.zh: 异物与污染控制持续到包装环节

copy.en: Cut strands, braid whiskers, solder debris, uncured compound, oil and uncontrolled cleaning residues can threaten adjacent circuitry or insulation. Work areas, tools, interim covers, cleaning methods, drying, capped connectors and packaging are defined for the project. Electrostatic-discharge controls are applied when the assembly contains or connects directly to sensitive electronics under the relevant handling requirement.
copy.zh: 断丝、编织毛刺、焊渣、未固化材料、油污与失控清洗残留可能威胁相邻电路或绝缘。工作区、工具、临时遮盖、清洁方法、干燥、连接器防尘帽与包装需按项目定义。当组件包含或直接连接敏感电子器件时，还应按适用要求实施静电防护。

copy.en: Temporary covers and dedicated storage prevent completed features from being contaminated during later operations.
copy.zh: 临时遮盖与专用存储可防止已完成部位在后续工序中被污染。

copy.en: Minimum bend radius, connector caps, moisture or ESD protection and serial identification continue into shipment.
copy.zh: 最小弯曲半径、连接器防护帽、防潮或防静电保护及序列标识应延续到出货。

title.en: The build record must point back to the released configuration
title.zh: 制造记录必须能追溯到放行配置

copy.en: The controlled package may include drawing and revision, bill of materials, approved sources, wire cut list, form-board data, work instructions, tooling status, operator and inspector records, deviations, in-process photographs, serial numbers and acceptance results. Traceability depth is agreed by contract; it is not created after production by adding a label.
copy.zh: 受控文件包可包括图纸与版本、物料清单、批准来源、裁线表、工装板数据、作业指导、工具状态、操作与检验记录、偏差、过程照片、序列号及验收结果。追溯深度应由合同约定，不能在生产后仅靠补贴标签形成。

copy.en: Purchasing, kitting, fabrication, inspection and test must use the same authorized baseline.
copy.zh: 采购、配料、制造、检验与测试必须使用同一授权基线。

copy.en: Repair, rework, substitution and drawing change require documented disposition before release.
copy.zh: 修理、返工、替代与图纸变更在放行前需要形成书面处置。

title.en: Inspection, electrical test and environment answer different questions
title.zh: 检验、电气测试与环境试验回答不同问题

copy.en: Visual and dimensional inspection confirms configuration and workmanship. Electrical acceptance may include continuity, resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand and shield isolation when compatible with the assembly. Functional, signal-integrity, vibration, shock, thermal, altitude, fluid or flammability testing requires an approved procedure, representative specimens, calibrated equipment and explicit limits. Tests that could damage embedded electronics are not applied without engineering authorization.
copy.zh: 外观与尺寸检验确认配置和工艺。电气验收可在与组件兼容时包括导通、电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压和屏蔽隔离。功能、信号完整性、振动、冲击、温度、高度、液体或阻燃试验需要批准程序、代表性样件、校准设备与明确限值。可能损伤内置电子器件的试验不得在未经工程授权时实施。

copy.en: Fixture, channel map, voltage, dwell, sweep, temperature, mounting and acceptance limit make a result interpretable.
copy.zh: 夹具、通道表、电压、保持时间、扫频、温度、安装方式与接收限值使结果可解释。

copy.en: Evidence is reviewed against the exact hardware, severity and configuration to which it applies.
copy.zh: 任何证据都要结合其适用的准确硬件、严酷度与配置进行审核。

q.en: Does this page mean Super Smile is an approved flight-hardware supplier?
q.zh: 这个页面是否表示超斯迈尔已经是获批飞行硬件供应商？

a.en: No. The page describes a category available for project review. Customer, platform, quality-system, personnel, process and part approvals must be defined and completed before any flight-use claim.
a.zh: 不是。本页面说明该类别可进入项目审核。客户、平台、质量体系、人员、工艺与零件批准必须另行定义和完成，之后才能作出任何飞行用途声明。

q.en: Can you build from an existing aerospace harness sample?
q.zh: 可以依据现有航空线束样品开发吗？

a.en: A sample supports dimensional and interface study, but it cannot reveal all conductor specifications, derating, shield topology, prohibited materials, hidden splices or qualification history. Approved drawings and engineering confirmation remain necessary.
a.zh: 样品有助于尺寸与接口研究，但不能揭示全部导体规范、降额、屏蔽拓扑、禁用材料、隐藏接续或鉴定历史，仍需批准图纸与工程确认。

q.en: Are MIL-DTL-38999-style connectors enough to make a harness aerospace grade?
q.zh: 使用类似 MIL-DTL-38999 的连接器就足以称为航空级线束吗？

a.en: No. Connector approval, exact part number and source are only part of the system. Wire, accessories, routing, workmanship, documentation, testing and platform approval also apply.
a.zh: 不足。连接器批准、准确型号与来源只是系统的一部分；线材、附件、走线、工艺、文件、测试与平台批准同样适用。

q.en: Which workmanship standard can be used?
q.zh: 可以采用哪种工艺标准？

a.en: The customer or program must flow down the applicable revision and any addendum, tailoring or drawing-specific requirements. We review the requested standard and capability before quotation rather than selecting one unilaterally.
a.zh: 客户或项目必须下达适用版本以及任何附录、裁剪或图纸专项要求。我们在报价前审核指定标准与能力，不会单方面替客户选择。

q.en: What testing can be included?
q.zh: 可以包含哪些测试？

a.en: Routine checks can cover configuration, dimensions, workmanship and continuity. Resistance, insulation, dielectric, signal-integrity, environmental or functional tests are added only when method, hardware compatibility, specimen quantity and limits are defined.
a.zh: 常规检查可覆盖配置、尺寸、工艺与导通。电阻、绝缘、耐压、信号完整性、环境或功能测试仅在方法、硬件兼容性、样本数量与限值明确后增加。

q.en: What is needed for an initial capability review?
q.zh: 初步能力审核需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send the platform and installation zone, drawing and revision, connector and wire specifications, circuit/shield schedule, geometry and mass constraints, environment, workmanship and inspection requirements, quantity, documentation package and qualification or source-inspection plan.
a.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、图纸及版本、连接器和线材规范、回路/屏蔽表、几何与重量限制、环境、工艺与检验要求、数量、文件包以及鉴定或源检计划。

mediaCredits.author: U.S. Navy / John Phillip Wagner Jr.

intro.en: Medical equipment cable assemblies connect sensors, patient-monitoring accessories, diagnostic instruments, therapy equipment, laboratory systems and internal electronics. The category includes many electrical and mechanical constructions; suitability is defined by the device manufacturer, intended use and released specification—not by a generic ‘medical cable’ label.
intro.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件用于连接传感器、患者监护附件、诊断仪器、治疗设备、实验室系统与设备内部电子部件。该小类包含多种电气和机械结构；是否适用应由设备制造商、预期用途与放行规范共同确定，而不能仅凭“医疗线缆”这一通用名称判断。

knowledge.en: A cable can carry low-level physiological signals, digital data, power, pneumatic tubing or several functions in one hybrid assembly. Patient proximity, applied-part classification, cleaning chemistry, flexing, connector touch-proofing, EMC, leakage-current paths and service life can change the design. Relevant IEC, ISO, AAMI, UL or customer requirements must be flowed down by exact edition and scope.
knowledge.zh: 一根组件可能传输低电平生理信号、数字数据、电源、气路，或在混合结构中同时承担多种功能。患者接近程度、应用部分分类、清洁化学品、弯折、连接器防触电、EMC、漏电流路径与使用寿命都会改变设计。适用的 IEC、ISO、AAMI、UL 或客户要求必须按准确版本与范围逐项下达。
