notes.en: Provide the device and intended-use description, patient-contact boundary, mating interfaces and keying, circuit and shield schedule, signal levels and bandwidth, voltage/current, cable geometry, cleaning or disinfection method, flex and pull duty, environmental limits, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, sample quantity and the approved verification plan.
notes.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途说明、患者接触边界、对插接口与防错方式、回路和屏蔽表、信号电平与带宽、电压/电流、线缆几何、清洁或消毒方法、弯折与拉力工况、环境限值、材料限制、标签、追溯、样品数量及批准的验证计划。

delivery.en: Medical-device-related projects are reviewed individually. We can build engineering samples and controlled production assemblies to the agreed file package, but device registration, biological evaluation, electrical-safety certification and clinical or regulatory approval remain the responsibility of the legal manufacturer and qualified laboratories unless separately contracted and evidenced.
delivery.zh: 医疗器械相关项目需逐项审核。我们可依据约定文件包制作工程样品与受控量产组件，但器械注册、生物学评价、电气安全认证、临床或法规批准仍由法定制造商与具备资质的实验室负责，除非另有合同和证据明确约定。

introduction.en: Define the Device Context Before the Cable
introduction.zh: 先定义器械场景，再定义线缆

faq.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: From patient-side leads to internal equipment interconnects
subtitle.zh: 从患者侧导联到设备内部互连

lead.en: Start with the device risk and intended use, then define signal, power, materials, cleaning, handling and evidence. One category can cover bedside monitoring, imaging, therapy, laboratory automation and portable care—each with a different construction baseline.
lead.zh: 先从设备风险与预期用途出发，再定义信号、电源、材料、清洁、操作和证据要求。一个小类可覆盖床旁监护、影像、治疗、实验室自动化与便携医疗，但每种用途都有不同的结构基线。

title.en: One category spans patient-side, equipment-side and internal assemblies
title.zh: 一个小类覆盖患者侧、设备侧与内部组件

copy.en: Medical equipment wiring ranges from detachable ECG and SpO₂ leads to ultrasound probe tails, NIBP hoses with signal conductors, foot-switch cables, endoscope or therapy handpiece connections, imaging-system interconnects and internal power or data harnesses. Connector family, circuit count and appearance alone do not establish interchangeability. The device model, accessory identification, pin assignment and risk-control function must stay linked.
copy.zh: 医疗设备布线可从可拆卸 ECG 与 SpO₂ 导联，延伸到超声探头尾线、含信号导体的 NIBP 管线、脚踏开关线、内窥镜或治疗手柄连接、影像系统互连，以及设备内部电源或数据线束。连接器系列、回路数量与外观都不足以证明可互换，设备型号、附件标识、针脚分配和风险控制功能必须始终关联。

copy.en: Identify patient-side, operator-accessible, internal, service-only and mains-related interfaces before choosing construction.
copy.zh: 选结构前先区分患者侧、操作者可触及、设备内部、仅维修与电网相关接口。

copy.en: A similar plug must not be presented as compatible without model, pinout and functional confirmation.
copy.zh: 外观相似的插头不得在未确认型号、针脚和功能前宣称兼容。

title.en: Low-level physiological signals need stable contact and controlled noise
title.zh: 低电平生理信号需要稳定接触与受控噪声

copy.en: ECG, EEG, EMG, temperature, SpO₂ and other monitoring leads work close to the patient and often carry small signals. Conductor resistance, triboelectric noise, cable capacitance, shielding, lead identification, electrode attachment and motion artefact can affect the complete signal chain. Snap, clip, pinch, DIN-style and proprietary monitor interfaces are selected from the device specification rather than visual similarity.
copy.zh: ECG、EEG、EMG、体温、SpO₂ 等监护导联靠近患者，且常传输微小信号。导体电阻、摩擦电噪声、电缆电容、屏蔽、导联标识、电极连接与运动伪差都可能影响完整信号链。按扣、夹子、夹持式、DIN 类及专用监护接口应依据设备规范选定，而不是依靠外观相似判断。

copy.en: Color, text, channel name and connector keying are coordinated with the target device and market convention.
copy.zh: 颜色、文字、通道名称与连接器防错需与目标设备及市场惯例协调。

copy.en: Repeated coiling, bed-rail contact, patient movement and disconnection at the grip influence flex and strain-relief geometry.
copy.zh: 反复盘绕、接触床栏、患者移动及握持处拔插都会影响弯折与应力消除结构。

title.en: Bandwidth, timing and electromagnetic environment define the interconnect
title.zh: 带宽、时序与电磁环境共同定义互连

copy.en: Ultrasound, X-ray, CT, MRI support equipment and optical diagnostic systems may use coaxial, twinaxial, twisted-pair, fiber, hybrid power/data or high-density internal assemblies. Characteristic impedance, skew, insertion loss, shield continuity, connector launch geometry and cable routing are reviewed with the equipment architecture. MRI-zone use or other special environments require an explicit material and compatibility review; a general cable page cannot establish suitability.
copy.zh: 超声、X 射线、CT、MRI 配套设备与光学诊断系统可能使用同轴、双轴、双绞、光纤、混合电源/数据或高密度内部组件。特性阻抗、时延偏差、插入损耗、屏蔽连续性、连接器过渡结构与走线需结合设备架构审核。MRI 区域或其他特殊环境还需明确进行材料和兼容性评估，通用产品页面不能证明适用。

copy.en: Cable, connector, termination and enclosure bonding are treated as one path for higher-frequency signals.
copy.zh: 对较高频信号，应将电缆、连接器、端接与机壳搭接作为一条完整路径处理。

copy.en: Pairing, return paths, physical spacing and shield termination are set before the harness route is frozen.
copy.zh: 在线束路线冻结前确定配对、回流路径、物理间距与屏蔽端接。

title.en: Handpieces, foot controls and moving equipment add mechanical risk
title.zh: 手柄、脚控与移动设备带来额外机械风险

copy.en: Surgical tools, therapy applicators, examination lamps, pumps, dental equipment and powered carts can expose cables to repeated flexing, rolling loads, cleaning fluids, tight storage and fast connection. The assembly may also carry interlock, identification or temperature-sensing circuits. Grip geometry, bend transition, connector retention, snag resistance and field-replacement method are part of usability and risk control, not decoration.
copy.zh: 手术工具、治疗施加器、检查灯、泵、牙科设备与移动设备可能使电缆经历反复弯折、滚轮碾压、清洁液、狭小收纳和快速连接。组件还可能承载互锁、识别或温度检测回路。握持几何、弯曲过渡、连接器保持、防勾挂与现场更换方式属于可用性和风险控制，而不是装饰。

copy.en: Bend radius, torsion, pull direction, cycle count and storage method are captured from actual use.
copy.zh: 从实际使用中提取弯曲半径、扭转、拉力方向、循环次数与收纳方式。

copy.en: Retention must resist accidental separation without making emergency or service disconnection unsafe.
copy.zh: 保持力既要抵抗意外脱开，也不能让紧急或维修断开变得不安全。

title.en: Automation harnesses combine motion, sensing, fluidics and service access
title.zh: 自动化线束同时服务运动、传感、流体与维护

copy.en: Analyzers, sample handlers, centrifuges, incubators and laboratory robots use internal harnesses for motors, encoders, heaters, valves, pumps, optical sensors, bar-code readers and communication modules. Compact routing must still allow service access and avoid pinch points, hot zones, reagents and moving mechanisms. In vitro diagnostic equipment has its own applicable requirements and should not be assumed to follow every medical-electrical rule in the same way.
copy.zh: 分析仪、样本处理设备、离心机、培养设备与实验室机器人通过内部线束连接电机、编码器、加热器、阀、泵、光学传感器、条码读头与通信模块。紧凑走线仍需保留维护空间，并避开夹点、热区、试剂与运动机构。体外诊断设备有自身适用要求，不能假定其与所有医用电气设备采用完全相同的规则。

copy.en: Connector access, replacement sequence, labels and test points are planned with the equipment service procedure.
copy.zh: 连接器可达性、更换顺序、标签与测试点应和设备维修程序一起规划。

copy.en: Leak paths, condensation, reagent exposure and washdown boundaries influence routing and protection.
copy.zh: 泄漏路径、冷凝、试剂暴露与清洗边界会影响走线和防护。

title.en: Signal, power and movement each demand a different cable core
title.zh: 信号、电源与运动分别需要不同芯线结构

copy.en: Fine-strand copper can support flexibility, while plated conductors may be selected for temperature, termination or corrosion conditions. Pair twist, coaxial geometry, drain wire, foil, braid and hybrid shields solve different coupling problems. Conductor gauge is calculated from current, resistance, voltage drop, temperature, bundle size and fault conditions; shielding is defined by frequency and grounding strategy rather than added generically.
copy.zh: 细绞铜导体可支持柔性，镀层导体则可能因温度、端接或腐蚀条件而选用。对绞、同轴结构、排流线、铝箔、编织与复合屏蔽分别解决不同耦合问题。线径应根据电流、电阻、压降、温度、束径与故障条件计算；屏蔽应按频率与接地策略定义，而不是笼统叠加。

copy.en: Materials and lay length can influence motion-generated charge in sensitive measurement cables.
copy.zh: 材料与成缆节距会影响敏感测量线缆中的运动生电噪声。

copy.en: Pigtail length, 360-degree termination, chassis bonding and isolated ends are selected for the actual circuit.
copy.zh: 屏蔽尾线长度、360 度端接、机壳搭接与隔离端需按实际回路选择。

title.en: The cleaning method must be treated as a design input
title.zh: 清洁方法必须作为设计输入

copy.en: PVC, TPE, TPU, silicone, FEP and other jackets differ in flexibility, abrasion, fluid resistance, surface feel and processing. ‘Medical grade’, ‘latex-free’ or ‘biocompatible’ are not interchangeable blanket claims. Biological evaluation depends on the finished device, nature and duration of contact, while cleanability depends on surface geometry, labels, overmold seams and the named disinfectants, concentrations, dwell times and cycle count.
copy.zh: PVC、TPE、TPU、硅胶、FEP 等护套在柔性、耐磨、耐液体、触感与加工方面各不相同。“医疗级”“不含乳胶”与“生物相容”不是可互换的笼统声明。生物学评价取决于成品器械及接触性质和时长；可清洁性则取决于表面几何、标签、包胶接缝，以及明确的消毒剂、浓度、作用时间与循环次数。

copy.en: Alcohol, bleach, peroxide, quaternary compounds and enzymatic cleaners can affect materials differently.
copy.zh: 酒精、含氯剂、过氧化物、季铵盐与酶清洗剂对材料的影响不同。

copy.en: Coupons support screening, but seams, markings, strain relief and assembled interfaces need representative evaluation.
copy.zh: 试片可用于筛选，但接缝、标识、应力消除与装配接口仍需代表性评估。

title.en: A soft jacket is not enough to guarantee flex life
title.zh: 柔软护套并不能单独保证弯折寿命

copy.en: Flex performance depends on strand construction, conductor lay, fillers, shield design, jacket thickness, cable diameter, overmold transition, bend radius and the direction of motion. A stiff connector next to a soft cable creates a concentrated strain zone. Test fixtures should reproduce the actual grip point, load, angle, speed, temperature and electrical monitoring rather than quote an unrelated cycle number.
copy.zh: 弯折性能取决于绞线结构、成缆节距、填充、屏蔽设计、护套厚度、线径、包胶过渡、弯曲半径与运动方向。硬连接器紧邻软线缆会形成应变集中区。试验夹具应复现实际握持点、负载、角度、速度、温度和电气监测，而不是引用无关的循环次数。

title.en: Move the bend away from the exit

copy.en: A progressive strain-relief profile distributes curvature instead of creating one sharp hinge.
copy.zh: 渐进式应力消除轮廓可分散曲率，避免形成单一尖锐铰点。

copy.en: Intermittent opens and resistance shifts can appear before visible jacket damage.
copy.zh: 间歇断路与电阻漂移可能早于可见护套损伤出现。

title.en: Keying, touch protection and identification reduce connection error
title.zh: 防错、防触电与标识共同降低误接风险

copy.en: Medical equipment can use circular, rectangular, push-pull, snap, clip, modular, board-to-wire and custom overmolded interfaces. Keying, color, tactile shape, insertion force, latch feedback, contact protection and cleanable grip areas should match the user and setting. A connector that is electrically adequate may still be unsuitable if it can be mis-mated, touched, trapped, disconnected unintentionally or confused in low light.
copy.zh: 医疗设备可采用圆形、矩形、推拉、自锁、夹式、模块化、板对线及定制包胶接口。防错、颜色、触觉形状、插入力、锁止反馈、触点防护与可清洁握持区域应匹配使用者和场景。即使连接器电气上合格，若可能误插、触及、夹伤、意外断开或在低照度下混淆，仍可能不适用。

title.en: Design the grip, not only the plug

copy.en: Users should pull from a defined cleanable grip instead of the cable or exposed hardware.
copy.zh: 使用者应从明确且可清洁的握持区拔插，而不是拉拽线缆或裸露硬件。

title.zh: 确认对插件与针脚编号

copy.en: Manufacturer drawing, exact part number and physical mate are reconciled before the first build.
copy.zh: 首件前核对制造商图纸、准确型号与实物对插件。

title.en: The released device file must flow into every production step
title.zh: 放行的器械文件必须落实到每一道生产工序

copy.en: Production begins with revision review, material and source confirmation, cut and strip data, termination instructions, shield and splice diagrams, overmold or heat-shrink parameters, label content and inspection hold points. Tooling, calibration, operator authorization and in-process records are linked where required. Samples and pilot lots are used to verify manufacturability before the repeat-production baseline is frozen.
copy.zh: 生产从版本审核、材料与来源确认开始，并落实裁线剥线数据、端接指导、屏蔽与接续图、包胶或热缩参数、标签内容及检验停点。按要求关联工具、校准、人员授权与过程记录。通过样品与试产验证可制造性后，再冻结重复生产基线。

copy.en: Drawing, BOM, pin table, work instruction, label file and tester program must share the authorized baseline.
copy.zh: 图纸、BOM、针脚表、作业指导、标签文件与测试程序必须使用同一授权基线。

copy.en: Crimps, shield joints, splices and soldered features are recorded before overmold or final covering.
copy.zh: 压接、屏蔽连接、接续与焊接特征应在包胶或最终包覆前完成记录。

title.en: Each test answers a defined risk-control question
title.zh: 每项测试都应对应明确的风险控制问题

copy.en: Visual and dimensional inspection confirms configuration and workmanship. Continuity and resistance verify circuit paths; insulation resistance and dielectric tests are applied only with approved limits and compatible connected hardware. Shield isolation, signal integrity, flex, pull, insertion/withdrawal, cleaning, ingress or functional tests require defined fixtures, sample quantities and acceptance criteria. A generic ‘100% tested’ statement is incomplete without the method and limit.
copy.zh: 外观与尺寸检验确认配置和工艺，导通与电阻验证回路；绝缘电阻与耐压测试只应在限值获批且所连硬件兼容时实施。屏蔽隔离、信号完整性、弯折、拉力、插拔、清洁、防护或功能测试都需要定义夹具、样本数量与接收准则。缺少方法和限值的“100% 测试”并不完整。

copy.en: High-voltage or insulation tests are not applied across sensitive circuitry without engineering authorization.
copy.zh: 未经工程授权，不得跨敏感电路实施高电压或绝缘测试。

copy.en: Tester revision, fixture, channel map, limits, environment and result make the evidence interpretable.
copy.zh: 测试机版本、夹具、通道表、限值、环境与结果共同构成可解释证据。

title.en: Risk, change and records continue after the first approved sample
title.zh: 风险、变更与记录不会在首件批准后结束

copy.en: The legal manufacturer determines the device classification, regulatory route, risk-management file and supplier controls. The cable supplier then follows the contracted configuration, record retention, lot or serial traceability, nonconformance disposition, change-notification and acceptance requirements. ISO 13485 describes a medical-device quality-management framework, while IEC 60601 addresses basic safety and essential performance for relevant medical electrical equipment; neither label automatically certifies an individual cable assembly.
copy.zh: 法定制造商确定器械分类、法规路径、风险管理文件与供应商控制；电缆供应商则遵循合同约定的配置、记录保存、批次或序列追溯、不合格处置、变更通知与验收要求。ISO 13485 描述医疗器械质量管理体系框架，IEC 60601 针对适用医用电气设备的基本安全与基本性能；任何标准名称都不会自动认证某一根电缆组件。

copy.en: Component lot, operator, tooling, inspection, tester and shipment links are defined by contract and risk.
copy.zh: 元件批次、人员、工具、检验、测试机与出货关联深度由合同和风险确定。

copy.en: Material substitution, process change, repair and rework need documented review before release.
copy.zh: 材料替代、工艺变更、修理与返工在放行前需要书面审核。

title.en: Protection, labeling and service planning complete the assembly
title.zh: 防护、标识与维修规划完成组件闭环

copy.en: Packaging prevents tight bends, connector damage, dust and mix-ups during storage and transport. The device maker specifies clean or non-sterile status, bag and label content, shelf-life controls where applicable, and whether the assembly is single-use, reusable, service-replaceable or permanently installed. Replacement cables require compatibility controls just as strict as original equipment because an apparently matching accessory can alter safety or performance.
copy.zh: 包装应防止存储与运输中的过度弯曲、连接器损伤、灰尘与混料。器械制造商需规定洁净或非无菌状态、袋装与标签内容、适用时的有效期控制，并说明组件是一次性、可重复使用、可维修更换还是永久安装。替换线缆需要与原装组件同样严格的兼容控制，因为外观匹配的附件也可能改变安全或性能。

copy.en: Tray, spool, cap, bag and carton geometry are selected around the actual connector and minimum bend radius.
copy.zh: 托盘、线轴、防尘帽、包装袋与纸箱结构应围绕实际连接器和最小弯曲半径选择。

copy.en: Part number, revision, lot or serial status and device compatibility remain readable through distribution and service.
copy.zh: 料号、版本、批次或序列状态及设备兼容信息应在流通和维修阶段保持可读。

q.en: Does ‘medical cable’ mean the assembly is already approved for patient use?
q.zh: “医疗线缆”是否表示组件已经获批用于患者？

a.en: No. It describes an application category. Intended use, patient-contact boundary, device risk controls, materials, manufacturing records and verification must be defined by the legal manufacturer and applicable regulatory route.
a.zh: 不是。它只是应用类别。预期用途、患者接触边界、器械风险控制、材料、制造记录与验证必须由法定制造商和适用法规路径确定。

q.en: Can you make ECG, SpO₂ or temperature lead sets from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据样品制作 ECG、SpO₂ 或体温导联吗？

a.en: A sample supports interface and dimensional study, but device model, pinout, signal requirements, electrode or sensor interface, materials, cleaning method and acceptance criteria still require written confirmation.
a.zh: 样品可支持接口与尺寸研究，但设备型号、针脚、信号要求、电极或传感器接口、材料、清洁方法与验收准则仍需书面确认。

q.en: Which jacket material is best for reusable medical cables?
q.zh: 可重复使用医疗线缆最适合哪种护套？

a.en: There is no universal answer. Flex, abrasion, skin proximity, disinfectant chemistry, temperature, sterilization or cleaning cycle, color and processing all matter. Candidate materials are screened, then evaluated in the finished construction.
a.zh: 没有统一答案。弯折、耐磨、皮肤接近、消毒剂化学、温度、灭菌或清洁循环、颜色与加工都需考虑。候选材料先筛选，再在成品结构中评价。

q.en: Can every assembly be hipot tested?
q.zh: 每种组件都可以做耐压测试吗？

a.en: No. Test voltage, duration, ramp, leakage limit and connection method must suit the insulation system and any connected electronics. Sensitive circuitry may require a different method or engineering isolation.
a.zh: 不可以。测试电压、时间、爬升、漏电限值与连接方式必须适合绝缘系统及所连电子部件；敏感电路可能需要其他方法或工程隔离。

q.en: Can one connector be used across several monitor brands?
q.zh: 一种连接器可以通用于多个监护仪品牌吗？

a.en: Only after exact model, mating hardware, keying, pin assignment, signal behavior and accessory-identification requirements are confirmed. Physical fit alone is insufficient and can create a hazardous misconnection.
a.zh: 只有在确认准确型号、对插硬件、防错、针脚、信号行为与附件识别要求后才可以。仅能物理插入并不足够，还可能造成危险误接。

q.en: What should we send for the first engineering review?
q.zh: 首次工程审核需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Send device and intended-use information, target markets, interface drawings or samples, pin and shield schedule, electrical data, patient-contact boundary, cable geometry, cleaning and flex duty, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, quantity and verification requirements.
a.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途、目标市场、接口图纸或样品、针脚与屏蔽表、电气数据、患者接触边界、线缆几何、清洁与弯折工况、材料限制、标签、追溯、数量及验证要求。

intro.en: Military-spec project cable assemblies connect power, controls, sensors, communications and mission equipment in ground, naval, airborne and deployable systems. The term describes a controlled requirement set—not a universal quality grade. Exact component part numbers, approved sources, workmanship, environment, inspection and acceptance evidence must be defined for each program.
intro.zh: 军规项目电缆组件用于连接地面、舰载、机载及可部署系统中的电源、控制、传感器、通信与任务设备。“军规”代表一套受控要求，而不是通用质量等级；每个项目都必须明确组件准确型号、批准来源、工艺、环境、检验与接收证据。

knowledge.en: A military drawing may invoke one or many specifications covering connectors, wire, contacts, accessories, identification, workmanship, environmental methods or documentation. A component that conforms to one specification does not make the complete assembly qualified. Applicability, revision, class, slash sheet, configuration and qualification status must be read together.
knowledge.zh: 军用图纸可能同时引用连接器、线材、触点、附件、标识、工艺、环境方法或文件管理等多项规范。某个元件符合一项规范，并不代表整套组件已经合格；适用范围、版本、等级、分规范、配置与鉴定状态必须结合审核。

notes.en: Provide platform and installation zone, drawing and revision, contract data requirements, exact connector and accessory PINs, approved manufacturer or QPL constraints, circuit and shield schedule, current and signal characteristics, environmental profiles, routing and support, maintenance concept, marking, traceability, lot size, source inspection and required acceptance or qualification procedures.
notes.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、图纸及版本、合同数据要求、连接器与附件准确型号、批准制造商或 QPL 限制、回路与屏蔽表、电流和信号特性、环境谱、走线与支撑、维修方案、标识、追溯、批量、源检及所需验收或鉴定程序。

delivery.en: Military-related projects are accepted only after capability, information-control, sourcing and compliance review. We can manufacture samples and controlled production assemblies to an agreed technical data package. We do not claim that a part is military-qualified, platform-approved or listed on a QPL unless the exact product, scope and current evidence support that statement.
delivery.zh: 军规相关项目仅在完成能力、信息控制、采购来源与合规审核后承接。我们可依据约定技术数据包制作样品与受控量产组件；除非准确产品、适用范围与当前证据能够支持，否则不会宣称零件已取得军用鉴定、平台批准或列入 QPL。

introduction.en: Translate the Mission Requirement into a Controlled Build
introduction.zh: 把任务要求转化为受控制造

faq.zh: 军规项目电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: From exact component identity to field-support evidence
subtitle.zh: 从准确元件身份到现场保障证据

lead.en: Begin with the platform, installation zone and released data. Then reconcile connector series, contacts, wire, shielding, routing, environment, workmanship, inspection and configuration records. Rugged appearance is never a substitute for a controlled requirement.
lead.zh: 先明确平台、安装区域与放行资料，再核对连接器系列、触点、线材、屏蔽、走线、环境、工艺、检验与配置记录。粗犷外观从来不能替代受控要求。

title.en: One category can serve vehicles, shelters, ships, aircraft and test systems
title.zh: 一个小类可覆盖车辆、方舱、舰船、航空与测试系统

copy.en: Military project assemblies include vehicle power and control harnesses, tactical radio and headset leads, rugged Ethernet and serial links, antenna coax, sensor breakouts, launcher or actuator interfaces, battery and distribution cables, shipboard equipment interconnects, avionics support leads and depot test adapters. Each family has different hazards, maintenance conditions and configuration authority. The page describes manufacturing capability for review; it does not imply approval for every platform.
copy.zh: 军规项目组件可包括车辆电源与控制线束、战术电台与耳机连接线、加固以太网与串行链路、天线同轴线、传感器分支、发射或执行器接口、电池与配电电缆、舰载设备互连、航电保障线及维修测试转接线。每类产品的危险、维护条件与配置权限均不同；本页说明可供审核的制造能力，并不代表已获所有平台批准。

copy.en: Internal, exposed, engine-bay, topside, occupied, unmanned and test-only locations require different evidence.
copy.zh: 设备内部、外露、发动机舱、甲板、载人、无人及仅测试区域需要不同证据。

copy.en: Prototype, test, training and operational assemblies need visible status and configuration control.
copy.zh: 原型、试验、训练与任务组件需要清晰状态和配置控制。

title.en: Series, class, insert, contact and keying define the actual interface
title.zh: 系列、等级、孔位、触点与键位共同定义真实接口

copy.en: MIL-DTL-38999, MIL-DTL-5015-derived families and other military circular systems contain many non-interchangeable series, shell classes, finishes, receptacle styles, insert arrangements, contact types and polarization positions. A shorthand connector name is insufficient for procurement or assembly. The exact PIN, mating half, backshell, contacts, sealing hardware and approved source requirements are reconciled before material release.
copy.zh: MIL-DTL-38999、源自 MIL-DTL-5015 的系列及其他军用圆形系统包含大量不可互换的系列、壳体等级、镀层、插座形式、孔位排列、触点类型与键位。简称不足以用于采购或装配；放料前必须核对准确型号、对插件、尾罩、触点、密封附件与批准来源要求。

title.en: Read every position in the PIN

copy.en: Shell size, class, finish, insert, contact style and polarization can change fit, sealing and performance.
copy.zh: 壳体尺寸、等级、镀层、孔位、触点形式与键位都会改变配合、密封与性能。

copy.en: A qualified connector source does not automatically qualify the cable assembly or a substituted accessory.
copy.zh: 获鉴定的连接器来源不会自动使整条电缆组件或替代附件获得鉴定。

title.en: Vehicle and shelter wiring must survive installation and field service
title.zh: 车辆与方舱布线必须兼顾安装和现场维修

copy.en: Tactical vehicles, trailers, generators, shelters, radar stations and mobile command equipment combine vibration, dust, mud, fluids, temperature swings and frequent configuration changes. Harness branches must clear steering, suspension, exhaust, doors, racks and moving mechanisms while remaining inspectable. Protection may use conduit, braid, boots, clamps, grommets and service loops selected from the actual abrasion, snag, water and maintenance exposure.
copy.zh: 战术车辆、拖车、发电机、方舱、雷达站与机动指挥设备同时面临振动、尘土、泥水、油液、温差和频繁改型。线束分支需避开转向、悬架、排气、舱门、机架与运动机构，同时保持可检修。防护可采用波纹管、编织、护套、夹具、护圈与维修余量，并按真实磨损、勾挂、进水和维护暴露选择。

copy.en: Clip spacing, edge clearance, branch take-off and connector support are defined with the installed route.
copy.zh: 夹具间距、边缘间隙、分支出口与连接器支撑需随安装路线一起定义。

copy.en: Access, tool clearance, labels and disconnect sequence matter as much as bench-level workmanship.
copy.zh: 可达性、工具空间、标签与断开顺序和台面工艺同样重要。

title.en: Moisture, salt, fluids and galvanic interfaces require explicit control
title.zh: 湿气、盐雾、油液与电偶界面需要明确控制

copy.en: Shipboard and externally mounted assemblies can encounter condensation, salt atmosphere, spray, washdown, fuels, hydraulic fluids and long storage periods. Jacket and boot compatibility, connector sealing, drain paths, backshell materials, plating combinations, bonding and corrosion prevention are reviewed as a system. Water resistance cannot be inferred from a circular shell or an overmolded appearance; the installed interface and test method define the claim.
copy.zh: 舰载与外部安装组件可能遭受冷凝、盐雾、喷淋、冲洗、燃油、液压油及长期存储。护套与护靴兼容性、连接器密封、排水路径、尾罩材料、镀层组合、搭接与防腐需作为系统审核。圆形外壳或包胶外观不能证明防水，只有安装界面和试验方法才能定义相关声明。

copy.en: Shell, backshell, fastener, shield and structure finishes are checked for the service environment.
copy.zh: 壳体、尾罩、紧固件、屏蔽与结构镀层需针对服役环境审核。

copy.en: Seals, boots and potting must not trap fluid where the equipment design expects drainage.
copy.zh: 密封、护靴与灌封不能在设备设计要求排水的位置困住液体。

title.en: Power, data, RF and audio need separate transmission rules
title.zh: 电源、数据、射频与音频需要各自的传输规则

copy.en: Rugged systems may combine DC power, discrete controls, Ethernet, serial buses, USB, timing, low-level sensors, radio audio and coaxial RF. Each circuit family has its own impedance, return path, pair twist, shield, loss, bend and separation limits. Cable geometry, connector transition, backshell bonding and equipment grounding are reviewed as one signal path; continuity alone cannot demonstrate link performance.
copy.zh: 加固系统可能同时包含直流电源、离散控制、以太网、串行总线、USB、时钟、低电平传感器、电台音频与同轴射频。每类回路都有自身阻抗、回流路径、绞距、屏蔽、损耗、弯曲与隔离限制。电缆几何、连接器过渡、尾罩搭接与设备接地需作为一条信号路径审核，单纯导通不能证明链路性能。

copy.en: Untwist, shield opening and contact transition length are limited at each termination.
copy.zh: 每个端接点都要限制解绞、屏蔽开口和触点过渡长度。

copy.en: Return loss, insertion loss, shielding or functional link tests require defined fixtures and frequency limits.
copy.zh: 回波损耗、插入损耗、屏蔽或功能链路测试需要明确夹具和频率限值。

title.en: Wire designation, temperature and derating must match the circuit
title.zh: 线材牌号、温度与降额必须匹配回路

copy.en: Military and aerospace wire families differ in conductor metal and plating, strand construction, insulation system, wall thickness, voltage rating, temperature range, fluid resistance, smoke and flame behavior, marking and approved usage. Gauge selection considers steady and transient current, bundle size, ambient temperature, installation altitude, voltage drop, protective device and fault clearing. A familiar color or nominal AWG does not prove equivalence.
copy.zh: 军用与航空线材在导体金属及镀层、绞线结构、绝缘体系、壁厚、电压等级、温度范围、耐液体、烟雾与阻燃、标识和批准用途方面均有差异。线径选择需考虑稳态与瞬态电流、束径、环境温度、安装高度、压降、保护器件与故障切除；熟悉的颜色或标称 AWG 不能证明等效。

copy.en: Tin, silver and nickel finishes interact differently with temperature, termination and mating materials.
copy.zh: 镀锡、镀银与镀镍在温度、端接及配合材料方面表现不同。

copy.en: Equivalent claims need drawing authority and evidence across electrical, mechanical and environmental attributes.
copy.zh: 等效替代需要图纸授权，并覆盖电气、机械与环境属性的证据。

title.en: Shield topology is part of the system grounding architecture
title.zh: 屏蔽拓扑属于系统接地架构的一部分

copy.en: Individual pair shields, overall foil or braid, double braid, conduit, conductive backshells, shield rings and drain wires solve different coupling and bonding problems. Pigtail length adds inductance; full-circumference termination can improve higher-frequency behavior when compatible hardware and workmanship are used. Single-end, double-end, chassis and isolated terminations follow the released system design rather than a universal rule.
copy.zh: 单对屏蔽、总箔或总编织、双层编织、导电管、导电尾罩、屏蔽环与排流线分别解决不同耦合和搭接问题。尾线长度会增加电感；匹配硬件和工艺下，360° 端接可改善较高频性能。单端、双端、机壳与隔离端接应遵循放行的系统设计，而不存在通用做法。

copy.en: Drawings should identify shield start, stop, splice, isolation and bonding hardware.
copy.zh: 图纸应标明屏蔽起止、接续、隔离与搭接硬件。

copy.en: Bond resistance and transfer behavior depend on finishes, joints, backshells and installation.
copy.zh: 搭接电阻与传输特性取决于镀层、接缝、尾罩和安装状态。

title.en: Strain relief begins at the connector and continues along the route
title.zh: 应力消除从连接器开始并贯穿整条路线

copy.en: Straight, 45-degree and 90-degree backshells, banding platforms, clamps, boots, heat-shrink transitions and overmolds affect cable exit, bend radius, shield termination, sealing and service access. Harness mass and unsupported length can load contacts or coupling hardware under shock and vibration. The connector accessory, cable build-up, clamp location and structure interface are therefore designed together.
copy.zh: 直式、45° 与 90° 尾罩、扎带平台、夹具、护靴、热缩过渡与包胶会影响出线、弯曲半径、屏蔽端接、密封和维修空间。冲击振动下，线束重量与无支撑长度可能对触点或锁紧机构施加载荷，因此连接器附件、电缆堆叠、夹具位置与结构界面必须协同设计。

copy.en: Braid, tape, conduit and boot layers must fit the accessory and preserve the intended clamp range.
copy.zh: 编织、胶带、套管与护靴层必须匹配附件并保留预期夹持范围。

copy.en: Route and clamp geometry should keep connector contacts from carrying bundle weight.
copy.zh: 走线与夹具几何应避免让连接器触点承担线束重量。

title.en: Every environmental method needs the right severity and configuration
title.zh: 每项环境方法都需要正确严酷度与样件配置

copy.en: MIL-STD-810 and component specifications contain test methods and tailoring guidance, not a single blanket certificate. Temperature, altitude, rain, immersion, dust, salt atmosphere, vibration, shock, acceleration, fluids, solar radiation and fungus answer different questions. Procedure, category, duration, axes, mounting, operating state, sample size and pass criteria must be selected by the responsible authority and tied to representative hardware.
copy.zh: MIL-STD-810 与元件规范提供试验方法和裁剪指导，并非单一通用证书。温度、高度、淋雨、浸水、砂尘、盐雾、振动、冲击、加速度、油液、日照与霉菌分别回答不同问题。程序、类别、持续时间、轴向、安装、工作状态、样本量与通过准则必须由责任方选定，并关联代表性硬件。

title.en: Tailor; do not copy a method number
title.zh: 应裁剪而非照抄方法编号

copy.en: The same method can contain multiple procedures and severities with very different meaning.
copy.zh: 同一方法可包含意义完全不同的多种程序与严酷度。

copy.en: Intermittent discontinuity, resistance change and functional state may need monitoring during exposure.
copy.zh: 环境暴露过程中可能需要监测瞬断、电阻变化与功能状态。

title.en: Approved sources and revision status are manufacturing inputs
title.zh: 批准来源与版本状态属于制造输入

copy.en: A controlled technical data package can include drawings, parts lists, approved manufacturer lists, QPL requirements, source-control documents, deviations, change notices, serialization and contract data deliverables. Procurement must preserve full part identity and traceability through receiving, storage and issue. Obsolescence, lead-time pressure or visual similarity does not authorize substitution; disposition belongs to the designated engineering authority.
copy.zh: 受控技术数据包可包括图纸、物料表、批准制造商清单、QPL 要求、来源控制文件、偏差、变更通知、序列化与合同数据交付物。采购必须在收货、存储与发料过程中保持完整型号身份和追溯。停产、交期压力或外观相似都不能授权替代，处置权属于指定工程责任方。

copy.en: Purchasing, fabrication, inspection and test must work from the same released revision.
copy.zh: 采购、制造、检验与测试必须使用同一放行版本。

copy.en: Prototype, deviation, rework, repaired and accepted conditions remain identifiable in records and marking.
copy.zh: 原型、偏差、返工、修理与接收状态需在记录和标识中保持可识别。

title.en: Preparation, calibrated tooling and in-process inspection protect hidden features
title.zh: 准备、校准工具与过程检验共同保护隐藏特征

copy.en: Controlled cutting, marking, stripping, crimping, soldering, contact insertion, shield termination, splice installation, lacing, sleeving, molding and potting each require the applicable instruction and acceptance criteria. Tool locator, die, applicator, calibration, maintenance and operator authorization form part of the process. Hidden conductor, shield, splice and seal features are inspected before backshells and coverings make them inaccessible.
copy.zh: 受控裁线、标识、剥线、压接、焊接、装触点、屏蔽端接、接续、绑扎、套管、包胶与灌封均需遵循适用作业指导和接收准则。工具定位器、压模、模具、校准、维护与人员授权属于工艺的一部分。导体、屏蔽、接续与密封等隐藏特征应在尾罩和包覆封闭前完成检验。

title.zh: 保护每根线丝与密封件

copy.en: Nicks, braid whiskers, displaced grommets and contamination can create failures after assembly appears complete.
copy.zh: 伤丝、编织毛刺、密封圈错位与污染可能在外观完成后形成故障。

copy.en: Solder, potting, molding and shield-band operations need controlled parameters and traceable inspection.
copy.zh: 焊接、灌封、包胶与屏蔽扎带操作需要受控参数和可追溯检验。

title.en: Configuration, workmanship and electrical behavior require separate checks
title.zh: 配置、工艺与电气行为需要分别检查

copy.en: Visual and dimensional inspection confirms materials, marking, geometry and workmanship. Electrical acceptance may include continuity, pin-to-pin mapping, resistance, insulation resistance, dielectric withstand, shield isolation or bonding when compatible with the hardware. Data, RF, functional and environmental tests require approved fixtures, limits and procedures. Tests that could damage filters, transient protection or embedded electronics are not applied without engineering authorization.
copy.zh: 外观与尺寸检验确认材料、标识、几何和工艺。与硬件兼容时，电气验收可包括导通、针脚映射、电阻、绝缘电阻、耐压、屏蔽隔离或搭接。数据、射频、功能与环境测试需要批准的夹具、限值和程序。可能损伤滤波器、瞬态保护或内置电子器件的试验不得在未经工程授权时实施。

copy.en: Fixture, channel map, voltage, dwell, bandwidth, mounting and acceptance limit make evidence interpretable.
copy.zh: 夹具、通道表、电压、保持时间、带宽、安装与接收限值使证据可解释。

title.en: Do not confuse acceptance with qualification

copy.en: Routine production checks and one-time design qualification serve different purposes and sample plans.
copy.zh: 常规生产验收与一次性设计鉴定具有不同目的和抽样方案。

title.en: Protection, spares and records continue beyond final inspection
title.zh: 防护、备件与记录延续到最终检验之后

copy.en: Protective caps, minimum bend radius, moisture barrier, desiccant, ESD controls, preservation materials, coiling method, labels and reusable transit cases are selected for shipping and storage. Shelf-life items and date-sensitive materials remain traceable. Spares, depot repair, connector replacement and configuration updates need the same controlled identity as original production so field support does not create an undocumented variant.
copy.zh: 防护帽、最小弯曲半径、防潮层、干燥剂、静电防护、防护材料、盘绕方式、标签与可重复使用运输箱需按运输和存储选择。具有货架寿命或日期敏感的材料必须保持追溯；备件、基地级维修、连接器更换与配置更新也需保持与原始生产一致的受控身份，避免现场保障形成未记录变型。

copy.en: Packaging should not introduce tight bends, connector loads or shield deformation during storage.
copy.zh: 包装不得在存储期间造成过小弯曲、连接器受力或屏蔽变形。

copy.en: Part number, revision, serial or lot status and applicable platform remain visible through issue and repair.
copy.zh: 料号、版本、序列或批次状态及适用平台在发放与维修中保持可见。

q.en: Does ‘military-spec’ mean the complete assembly is qualified?
q.zh: “军规”是否表示整套组件已经获得鉴定？

a.en: No. Qualification applies to the exact product, specification, class, source and scope supported by current evidence. A project assembly must separately satisfy its drawing, contract, workmanship, inspection and platform approval requirements.
a.zh: 不是。鉴定只适用于当前证据覆盖的准确产品、规范、等级、来源与范围。项目组件仍需单独满足图纸、合同、工艺、检验和平台批准要求。

q.en: Can you build with MIL-DTL-38999 connectors?
q.zh: 可以使用 MIL-DTL-38999 连接器制作吗？

a.en: Projects using this family can be reviewed when the exact series, class, slash-sheet PIN, insert, contact, keying, backshell, mating half and approved-source requirement are supplied. The connector name alone is not enough.
a.zh: 在提供准确系列、等级、分规范型号、孔位、触点、键位、尾罩、对插件与批准来源要求后，可进行项目审核；只有连接器名称还不够。

q.en: Can an existing sample be reverse engineered?
q.zh: 可以依据现有样品进行开发吗？

a.en: A sample supports dimensions and interface study, but it may not reveal wire designation, derating, shield topology, hidden splices, sealing materials, approved sources or qualification history. Released engineering data and authority are still required.
a.zh: 样品有助于尺寸和接口研究，但可能无法揭示线材牌号、降额、屏蔽拓扑、隐藏接续、密封材料、批准来源或鉴定历史，仍需放行工程资料与授权。

q.en: Do you test every assembly to MIL-STD-810?
q.zh: 每条组件都会按 MIL-STD-810 测试吗？

a.en: No. MIL-STD-810 contains methods and tailoring guidance. Environmental testing is performed only when the responsible authority defines the applicable method, procedure, severity, mounting, operating state, samples and acceptance criteria.
a.zh: 不会。MIL-STD-810 包含方法与裁剪指导。只有责任方明确适用方法、程序、严酷度、安装、工作状态、样本和接收准则后，才执行环境试验。

q.en: What routine acceptance tests are available?
q.zh: 可提供哪些常规验收测试？

a.en: The baseline can include configuration, visual, dimensional and continuity checks. Resistance, insulation, dielectric, shield, bonding, data, RF or functional checks are added when the assembly is compatible and the test method and limits are released.
a.zh: 基础验收可包括配置、外观、尺寸与导通检查。电阻、绝缘、耐压、屏蔽、搭接、数据、射频或功能检查仅在组件兼容且方法与限值已放行时增加。

q.en: What information is needed for a capability review?
q.zh: 能力审核需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send the platform and zone, drawing revision, exact component identities and source restrictions, circuit and shield schedule, electrical loads and signals, route and support, environmental profiles, workmanship and inspection criteria, traceability, quantity and required data deliverables.
a.zh: 请提供平台与区域、图纸版本、准确元件身份及来源限制、回路与屏蔽表、电气负载和信号、走线与支撑、环境谱、工艺与检验准则、追溯、数量及所需数据交付物。

mediaCredits.author: MSgt Kevin Wallace / U.S. Air Force
Capt Breck Archer / U.S. Marine Corps

intro.en: Solar cable assemblies carry DC power between PV modules, string circuits, combiner equipment, inverters and project-specific interfaces. The category includes extension leads, module leads, branch harnesses, flying leads and pre-terminated runs; voltage, current, cable family, connector identity, route and environmental exposure must be defined together.
intro.zh: 太阳能电缆组件用于在光伏组件、组串、汇流设备、逆变器及项目接口之间传输直流电力。该小类覆盖延长线、组件引线、分支线束、飞线与预端接线路；系统电压、电流、线材体系、连接器身份、走线路径和环境暴露必须一并定义。

knowledge.en: PV cable and PV connector standards address different products and scopes. IEC 62930 covers specified single-core cross-linked PV cables up to 1.5 kV DC, while IEC 62852 addresses connectors for DC photovoltaic circuits. A compliant cable or connector does not automatically make every finished assembly suitable for a particular installation; system design, compatible components, workmanship and acceptance evidence remain project inputs.
knowledge.zh: 光伏线材与光伏连接器标准分别覆盖不同产品和范围。IEC 62930 涵盖规定的 1.5 kV DC 及以下单芯交联光伏电缆，IEC 62852 则针对光伏直流回路连接器。某根线材或某个连接器符合标准，并不自动表示所有成品组件都适用于具体安装；系统设计、兼容元件、制造工艺与验收证据仍是项目输入。

notes.en: Provide the module, inverter or combiner interfaces; exact connector manufacturer and part numbers; maximum system voltage; string open-circuit voltage at the design minimum temperature; operating and fault current; conductor size and cable designation; route, length and voltage-drop target; installation zone; branch and protection arrangement; quantity; labels; packaging; and required inspection or test method.
notes.zh: 请提供组件、逆变器或汇流设备接口；连接器制造商与准确型号；最大系统电压；设计最低温度下的组串开路电压；工作及故障电流；导体截面积与线材牌号；走线、长度和压降目标；安装区域；分支与保护方案；数量；标签；包装以及所需检验或测试方法。

delivery.en: We review the released electrical architecture and component compatibility before sampling. Custom length, color, marking, branch geometry and equipment-side termination can then be frozen in a drawing and bill of materials. Certification, ingress, flame, weathering or lifetime claims are made only when the exact materials, assembly configuration and current evidence cover them.
delivery.zh: 打样前先审核已放行的电气架构与元件兼容性，再把定制长度、颜色、标识、分支几何和设备端端接冻结到图纸与物料表。只有当准确材料、组件配置与当前证据均覆盖时，才对认证、防护、阻燃、耐候或寿命作出相应声明。

introduction.en: Build the DC Route as One Electrical and Mechanical System
introduction.zh: 把直流路径作为完整电气与机械系统设计

faq.zh: 太阳能电缆组件常见问题

subtitle.en: From module connector to inverter-side termination
subtitle.zh: 从组件连接器到逆变器端接的完整路径

lead.en: The correct assembly begins with circuit voltage and current, then follows the full route through conductor, insulation, connector contact, seal, branch, support, marking and acceptance test. Similar black shells are not proof of compatibility.
lead.zh: 正确的组件从回路电压与电流开始，再沿完整路径审核导体、绝缘、连接器触点、密封、分支、支撑、标识与验收测试。外观相似的黑色壳体不能证明兼容。

title.en: One solar category includes far more than a male-to-female extension
title.zh: 一个太阳能小类远不止公母延长线

copy.en: The same category can include module leads, field extensions, home runs, Y or multi-branch harnesses, parallel jumpers, combiner-box flying leads, inverter adapters, panel feedthroughs and service replacements. Each geometry changes current paths, polarity risk, connector count, sealing interfaces, routing and installation sequence. The drawing should show finished length references, branch datum, connector orientation, labels, caps and equipment-side preparation.
copy.zh: 同一小类可包括组件引线、现场延长线、回路线、Y 型或多分支线束、并联跳线、汇流箱飞线、逆变器转接线、面板穿墙端接及维修替换件。不同几何会改变电流路径、极性风险、连接器数量、密封界面、走线与安装顺序。图纸应标明成品长度基准、分支定位、连接器方向、标签、防尘帽和设备端处理。

title.zh: 明确 A 端与 B 端

copy.en: Module-side connector identity and equipment-side lug, ferrule, terminal or flying lead are controlled separately.
copy.zh: 组件端连接器身份与设备端线鼻、管形端子、端子或飞线需分别受控。

copy.en: Color alone is not enough; connector gender, contact, label and circuit designation must agree.
copy.zh: 不能只依赖颜色；连接器性别、触点、标签和回路标识必须一致。

title.en: Cold-weather voltage and parallel current define the electrical envelope
title.zh: 低温电压与并联电流共同定义电气边界

copy.en: Modules in series increase string voltage; parallel strings increase available current and prospective reverse current. Maximum open-circuit voltage is evaluated at the project minimum cell temperature rather than only at standard test conditions. Conductor area, connector current rating, protective devices, grouping, ambient temperature, route length and allowable voltage drop are coordinated. A familiar 4 mm² or 6 mm² cable size is not a complete design decision by itself.
copy.zh: 组件串联会提高组串电压，并联会提高可用电流与可能的反向电流。最大开路电压应按项目最低电池片温度评估，而不能只看标准测试条件。导体截面积、连接器额定电流、保护器件、成束、环境温度、走线长度与允许压降需要协调；常见的 4 mm² 或 6 mm² 线径本身并不是完整设计结论。

copy.en: Positive and negative conductor lengths, terminations and branch points all contribute resistance and heat.
copy.zh: 正负极导体长度、端接和分支点都会形成电阻与热量。

copy.en: Branch harnesses are reviewed with module limits, fault current and the released protection concept.
copy.zh: 分支线束需结合组件限值、故障电流与已放行保护方案审核。

title.en: Conductor, cross-linked insulation and sheath are selected as a cable system
title.zh: 导体、交联绝缘与护套应作为线材系统选择

copy.en: IEC 62930 applies to specified single-core cross-linked PV power cables up to 1.5 kV DC; market and installation rules may instead call for EN 50618, UL 4703 or another listed cable family. Tinned flexible copper is common, but conductor class, strand count, insulation and sheath compound, wall thickness, temperature range, smoke and halogen behavior, wet rating, sunlight resistance, flame performance, marking and installation use must match the released requirement. Generic silicone or PVC wire is not automatically PV cable.
copy.zh: IEC 62930 适用于规定的 1.5 kV DC 及以下单芯交联光伏电力电缆；具体市场与安装规则也可能要求 EN 50618、UL 4703 或其他列名线材体系。柔性镀锡铜较常见，但导体等级、股数、绝缘与护套材料、壁厚、温度范围、烟雾与卤素特性、耐湿、耐日光、阻燃、标识和安装用途都必须匹配放行要求。普通硅胶线或 PVC 线不会自动成为光伏专用线。

copy.en: Manufacturer, type, voltage, conductor size and certification scope are preserved in purchasing and records.
copy.zh: 制造商、类型、电压、截面积与认证范围需在采购和记录中保持完整。

copy.en: A cable accepted in one scheme may not satisfy another jurisdiction or installation method.
copy.zh: 一种体系认可的线材未必满足另一司法辖区或安装方式。

title.en: “MC4-compatible” is not a complete mating specification
title.zh: “兼容 MC4”不是完整的对插规范

copy.en: PV connectors that look alike can differ in contact geometry, spring force, seal dimensions, polymer, cable gland range, locking detail, voltage/current rating and approved tooling. IEC 62852 addresses safety requirements and tests for DC photovoltaic connectors, but interchangeability still depends on the exact products and evidence. We require the manufacturer, series, part number, contact, seal, cable range, mating half and approved combination; mixed-brand or undocumented cross-mating is not assumed acceptable.
copy.zh: 外观相似的光伏连接器可能在触点几何、弹力、密封尺寸、树脂、压紧范围、锁止细节、电压电流额定值与批准工具方面不同。IEC 62852 规定光伏直流连接器的安全要求与试验，但互换性仍取决于准确产品和证据。我们要求明确制造商、系列、型号、触点、密封件、适配线径、对插件与批准组合，不默认接受跨品牌或无文件支持的混插。

copy.en: A replacement lead is reviewed against the installed counterpart, not only against a catalog photo.
copy.zh: 维修替换线要结合设备上已有对插件审核，不能只对照目录照片。

copy.en: Shipping caps and field caps keep contamination out before the qualified mated interface is formed.
copy.zh: 运输帽和现场防护帽可在形成合格对插界面前避免污染。

title.en: Custom branching must preserve circuit limits and field installation clarity
title.zh: 定制分支必须保持回路边界与现场安装清晰

copy.en: A Y-branch, multi-output trunk or connector-to-flying-lead assembly can reduce field cutting and speed installation, but every branch changes current sharing, fault exposure and labeling needs. Splitter housings, overmolded junctions and sealed splices are selected by current, voltage, cable diameter, temperature, ingress objective and repair concept. Flying leads are delivered to an agreed strip length, ferrule, lug, tinning rule or untouched end condition rather than a vague ‘ready to install’ description.
copy.zh: Y 型分支、多输出主干或连接器转飞线组件可以减少现场裁线并提高安装效率，但每个分支都会改变电流分配、故障暴露与标识需求。分线壳、包胶接点和密封接续需按电流、电压、线径、温度、防护目标及维修方案选择；飞线则按约定剥线长度、管形端子、线鼻、镀锡规则或未处理端状态交付，而不是笼统写成“可直接安装”。

copy.en: Lengths are measured from agreed connector, junction and breakout references with tolerances.
copy.zh: 长度需从约定的连接器、接点和分支基准测量并给出公差。

copy.en: Connector arrangement and labels should make the intended circuit topology difficult to misread.
copy.zh: 连接器布局和标签应让预期回路拓扑不易被误读。

title.en: Contact, conductor and tooling form one qualified termination stack
title.zh: 触点、导体与工具共同构成端接体系

copy.en: The contact must match conductor area, strand construction, plating and connector housing. Strip length, strand condition, brush, crimp height or other process control, bellmouth, insulation position and contact retention are set by the applicable manufacturer data and workmanship criteria. The correct applicator, locator and die are verified and maintained. A pull test can support process control, but it does not replace sectioning, dimensional checks or the connector manufacturer’s assembly instructions when those are required.
copy.zh: 触点必须匹配导体截面积、绞线结构、镀层与连接器壳体。剥线长度、线丝状态、刷丝、压接高度或其他过程控制、喇叭口、绝缘位置和触点保持力按适用制造商资料与工艺准则设定；正确的模具、定位器和压模需经过核对与维护。拉力测试可支持过程控制，但在需要时不能替代剖面、尺寸检查或连接器制造商装配说明。

copy.en: A tool that closes the contact is not necessarily the approved geometry for that contact and wire.
copy.zh: 能把触点压紧的工具，并不一定能形成该触点与线材要求的批准几何。

copy.en: Conductor and seal features are checked before the housing makes them difficult to see.
copy.zh: 在壳体遮挡之前检查导体与密封相关特征。

title.en: Water resistance belongs to the complete mated and installed interface
title.zh: 防水能力属于完整对插与安装界面

copy.en: Connector seals, cable glands, molded junctions, caps and equipment entries each protect a different boundary. Cable outer diameter and roundness must fit the gland and seal range; cut seals, contamination, under-tightening, over-tightening and side load can defeat the design. An IP statement or connector test applies only to the defined configuration and method. A loose connector on a bench, an unmated end or an unsealed equipment entry does not inherit the same protection.
copy.zh: 连接器密封圈、电缆压紧件、包胶接点、防护帽与设备进线口分别保护不同边界。电缆外径和圆度必须适合压紧与密封范围；密封件受伤、污染、锁紧不足、过度锁紧或侧向受力都可能破坏设计。IP 声明或连接器试验只适用于规定配置与方法，台面上松散的连接器、未对插端或未密封设备入口不会自动获得相同防护。

copy.en: Dust, jacket damage and trapped strands are controlled before mating and tightening.
copy.zh: 对插与锁紧前控制灰尘、护套损伤和夹入线丝。

copy.en: Unused branches and service disconnects need a deliberate temporary or permanent protection method.
copy.zh: 未使用分支和维修断开端需要明确临时或永久防护方式。

title.en: Cable management prevents edges, heat, movement and pooled water from becoming failures
title.zh: 线缆管理避免边缘、热量、运动与积水转化为故障

copy.en: Under-module routing should keep conductors off abrasive roofing, sharp frame edges and places where water, ice or debris collect. Clip spacing, compatible ties, bend radius, thermal expansion, tracker motion, service loops and connector support are designed together. Connector bodies should not carry cable weight or rest where repeated movement and moisture attack the seal. Roof penetrations, conduit transitions and equipment entries remain part of the installation design rather than the cable assembly alone.
copy.zh: 组件下方走线应让导体避开磨蚀性屋面、锋利边框以及容易积水、结冰或堆积杂物的位置。卡扣间距、相容扎带、弯曲半径、热胀冷缩、跟踪器运动、维修余量与连接器支撑需要协同设计。连接器壳体不应承受线缆重量，也不应放在反复运动和潮气持续攻击密封的位置。屋面穿透、导管过渡与设备入口仍属于安装设计，而不只是线缆组件本身。

copy.en: The first clip and service loop protect contact retention and the mated seal from cable load.
copy.zh: 首个卡扣与维修余量可避免线缆载荷作用于触点保持和对插密封。

copy.en: Trackers and thermal cycles need planned flex zones without rubbing or tight bends.
copy.zh: 跟踪器和温度循环需要规划弯曲区域，并避免摩擦和急弯。

title.en: Sun, heat, cold, moisture and chemistry age different materials differently
title.zh: 日照、冷热、湿气与化学环境会以不同方式老化材料

copy.en: PV assemblies may experience long UV exposure, elevated conductor and rooftop temperature, cold bending, damp heat, ozone, rain, snow, wind-driven movement, dust, salt or agricultural chemicals. Relevant cable standards evaluate defined combinations such as weathering, damp heat, thermal endurance, low-temperature behavior, electrical insulation and flame performance. The project selects materials and evidence for the actual installation; no single ‘outdoor’ label answers every exposure.
copy.zh: 光伏组件可能长期承受紫外线、高导体温度与屋面温度、低温弯曲、湿热、臭氧、雨雪、风致运动、灰尘、盐分或农业化学品。相关线材标准会评估耐候、湿热、热寿命、低温、电气绝缘与阻燃等规定组合。项目应按真实安装选择材料与证据，单一“户外型”标签无法回答所有环境问题。

copy.en: UV, flame, smoke, halogen, oil and water properties come from different tests and scopes.
copy.zh: 耐 UV、阻燃、烟雾、卤素、耐油与耐水来自不同试验与适用范围。

copy.en: A cable jacket can survive sunlight while a high-resistance termination still overheats locally.
copy.zh: 护套可以耐受日照，但高电阻端接仍可能在局部过热。

title.en: Rooftop, commercial, utility, off-grid and hybrid systems need different assemblies
title.zh: 户用、工商业、地面电站、离网与混合系统需要不同组件

copy.en: Residential rooftops favor controlled lengths and compact cable management; commercial roofs add long routes, multiple penetrations and maintenance zones; utility arrays add large string counts, trackers, distributed combiner points and repeatable installation; off-grid systems may interface with charge controllers, generators and storage; floating, coastal or agricultural projects intensify moisture, corrosion or chemical exposure. The cable assembly is configured to the actual architecture rather than sold as one universal solar lead.
copy.zh: 户用屋顶强调受控长度和紧凑线缆管理；工商业屋顶增加长距离走线、多处穿透与维护区域；地面电站增加大量组串、跟踪器、分布式汇流点与重复安装；离网系统可能与充电控制器、发电机和储能接口；漂浮式、沿海或农业项目则强化湿气、腐蚀或化学暴露。电缆组件应按真实架构配置，而不是作为一种万能太阳能线销售。

copy.en: Replacement access, labeling and spare lengths differ between a roof, tracker row and enclosure.
copy.zh: 屋顶、跟踪器阵列与机柜的替换可达性、标识和备件长度各不相同。

copy.en: PV-side string leads and battery high-current or high-voltage cables can belong to different rules and hazards.
copy.zh: 光伏侧组串线与电池大电流或高压电缆可能适用不同规则与风险。

title.en: Released drawings convert field measurements into repeatable assemblies
title.zh: 放行图纸把现场尺寸转化为可重复组件

copy.en: Development starts from system and interface data, then moves through component reconciliation, drawing, bill of materials, cut and strip definition, crimp setup, branch or splice preparation, connector assembly, marking, inspection and first-article review. A reference sample can support dimensions, but it may not reveal cable certification, contact identity, tool requirement, circuit protection or installation authorization. Approved sample feedback is incorporated into controlled production documents.
copy.zh: 开发从系统与接口资料开始，再经过元件核对、图纸、物料表、裁剥定义、压接设定、分支或接续准备、连接器装配、标识、检验与首件审核。参考样品有助于确认尺寸，但可能无法揭示线材认证、触点身份、工具要求、回路保护或安装授权；获批样品反馈需转化到受控量产文件。

copy.en: Connector face, gland shoulder and branch centerline references prevent length disputes.
copy.zh: 连接器端面、压紧件肩部和分支中心线基准可避免长度争议。

copy.en: Cable, contact, housing, seal, tool and process substitutions require documented review.
copy.zh: 线材、触点、壳体、密封、工具与工艺替代均需文件化审核。

title.en: Polarity, connection quality and insulation evidence answer different questions
title.zh: 极性、连接质量与绝缘证据回答不同问题

copy.en: Routine acceptance can include material and marking verification, dimensions, polarity, continuity, pin or contact mapping, connector lock and visual workmanship. Resistance or voltage-drop sampling, pull testing, insulation resistance and dielectric tests are added only with compatible hardware, defined limits and an approved method. Environmental, ingress, flammability and certification tests are separate qualification activities; a continuity pass does not demonstrate them.
copy.zh: 常规验收可包括材料与标识核对、尺寸、极性、导通、触点映射、连接器锁止和外观工艺。电阻或压降抽检、拉力、绝缘电阻与耐压试验仅在硬件兼容、限值明确且方法获批时增加。环境、防护、阻燃与认证试验属于独立鉴定活动，导通合格不能证明这些性能。

copy.en: Instrument, fixture, applied voltage, dwell, limit, sample and result make data interpretable.
copy.zh: 仪器、夹具、施加电压、保持时间、限值、样本与结果使数据可解释。

copy.en: Correct polarity is not enough if a contact is unseated or a seal is displaced.
copy.zh: 即使极性正确，触点未到位或密封件错位仍不可接受。

title.en: Labels, caps, coiling and records preserve the approved configuration
title.zh: 标签、防护帽、盘绕与记录共同保持批准配置

copy.en: Finished assemblies can carry circuit ID, polarity, length, part number, revision, lot or date code and customer-specific labels. Protective caps, minimum bend diameter, coil restraint, moisture and dust protection, connector separation and carton identification are selected so shipping does not damage the accepted product. Receiving material identity, crimp setup, in-process checks and final inspection remain linked to the production lot according to the agreed traceability plan.
copy.zh: 成品组件可按要求标注回路编号、极性、长度、料号、版本、批次或日期码及客户专用标签。防护帽、最小盘绕直径、线圈固定、防潮防尘、连接器隔离与外箱标识需确保运输不损伤已验收产品；来料身份、压接设定、过程检查与最终检验按约定追溯方案关联到生产批次。

copy.en: Contacts and seals remain capped, clean and free from packaging load through delivery.
copy.zh: 触点与密封在交付前保持封帽、洁净并不承受包装载荷。

copy.en: Production, spare and replacement assemblies stay distinguishable when the system changes.
copy.zh: 系统变更时，量产件、备件与替换件仍保持可区分。

q.en: Is every black double-insulated cable suitable for PV use?
q.zh: 所有黑色双层绝缘电缆都适合光伏使用吗？

a.en: No. Cable suitability depends on its complete designation, voltage, conductor construction, materials, certification or listing scope, temperature, sunlight and wet-location properties, flame behavior and the intended installation rules. Appearance alone is not evidence.
a.zh: 不是。线材适用性取决于完整牌号、电压、导体结构、材料、认证或列名范围、温度、耐日光与潮湿特性、阻燃表现及预期安装规则，外观本身不是证据。

q.en: Can two ‘MC4-compatible’ connectors from different brands be mated?
q.zh: 两个不同品牌的“兼容 MC4”连接器可以直接混插吗？

a.en: Cross-mating is accepted only when the exact connector combination is authorized and supported by applicable certification, listing or engineering evidence. Similar appearance and nominal dimensions are insufficient.
a.zh: 只有准确连接器组合获得授权，并有适用认证、列名或工程证据支持时才可接受混插；外观相似与名义尺寸相近并不充分。

q.en: What determines solar extension-cable length and conductor size?
q.zh: 太阳能延长线的长度和截面积如何确定？

a.en: Use the complete positive and negative route, operating and fault current, ambient and grouping derating, connector limits, protection, allowable voltage drop, mechanical route and applicable installation rules. A catalog current number alone is not enough.
a.zh: 需要结合正负极完整路径、工作及故障电流、环境与成束降额、连接器限值、保护、允许压降、机械走线和适用安装规则，不能只看目录中的单一电流数字。

q.en: Can you make Y-branches or multiple flying leads?
q.zh: 可以制作 Y 型分支或多路飞线吗？

a.en: Yes, after the circuit topology, current and fault limits, protection concept, branch geometry, connector or splice system, labels, sealing objective and acceptance method are released. Branching is not treated as a purely mechanical split.
a.zh: 可以，但需先放行回路拓扑、电流与故障限值、保护方案、分支几何、连接器或接续体系、标签、密封目标与验收方法。分支不能只按机械分线处理。

q.en: Does an IP-rated connector make the complete assembly waterproof?
q.zh: 使用有 IP 等级的连接器是否代表整条组件防水？

a.en: Not automatically. The rating applies to a defined mated configuration and test method. Cable diameter, seal condition, tightening, branch joints, caps, equipment entries and installation loads can change the result.
a.zh: 不会自动成立。等级只适用于规定的对插配置与试验方法；线径、密封状态、锁紧、分支接点、防护帽、设备入口和安装载荷都可能改变结果。

q.en: What should be sent for a custom solar cable review?
q.zh: 定制太阳能电缆审核需要提供什么？

a.en: Send the system voltage and temperature basis, operating and fault current, exact module and equipment interfaces, connector manufacturer and PINs, cable designation and size, route and finished-length references, branch topology, environment, labels, quantity and required tests or market approvals.
a.zh: 请提供系统电压及温度依据、工作与故障电流、准确组件和设备接口、连接器制造商与型号、线材牌号和截面积、走线及成品长度基准、分支拓扑、环境、标签、数量及所需测试或市场批准。

intro.en: Automotive diagnostic and OBD harnesses connect a vehicle diagnostic link connector to scan tools, vehicle communication interfaces, data loggers, telematics devices, test fixtures and service adapters. The category includes short extensions, right-angle leads, Y splitters, legacy-vehicle adapters, DB-style interfaces, RJ45 or USB-side assemblies and custom equipment tails; connector shape alone does not define pinout, protocol, power path or intended duty.
intro.zh: 汽车诊断与 OBD 线束用于连接车辆诊断接口与诊断仪、车辆通信接口、数据记录器、车联网设备、测试工装及维修转接器。该小类覆盖短延长线、直角引线、Y 型分支、老车型转接线、DB 接口、RJ45 或 USB 设备端组件及定制设备尾线；连接器外形本身不能定义针脚、协议、供电路径或预期工况。

knowledge.en: SAE J1962 and ISO 15031-3 define requirements for the standardized diagnostic connection between the vehicle and external test equipment, including connector design, contact allocation and related electrical circuits. The standardized shell can carry different physical layers and manufacturer-discretionary circuits. A cable therefore has to preserve the released pin map, shielding, pair geometry, grounds, power handling and device-side interface rather than merely joining matching housings.
knowledge.zh: SAE J1962 与 ISO 15031-3 规定车辆与外部测试设备之间标准化诊断连接的要求，包括连接器设计、触点分配及相关电路。相同标准外壳中可能承载不同物理层和制造商自定义回路，因此线束必须保持已放行的针脚映射、屏蔽、线对结构、接地、供电能力与设备端接口，而不能只把外形匹配的壳体连在一起。

notes.en: Provide vehicle make, model, year and market; target diagnostic or data task; vehicle-side connector and access space; exact device or tool interface; released pin map and protocol; power source and current; cable length and exit direction; shielding and termination requirements; whether another device must remain connected; environmental exposure; quantity; labels; and required inspection or functional checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆品牌、车型、年份和市场；目标诊断或数据任务；车辆端接口及安装空间；准确设备或工具接口；已放行针脚表与协议；供电来源及电流；线长与出线方向；屏蔽和端接要求；是否需要保留另一设备同时连接；环境暴露；数量；标签以及所需检验或功能检查。

delivery.en: We can develop from a controlled drawing, verified sample, connector part numbers or an approved interface schedule. Before sampling, the vehicle-side and device-side identities, power routing, signal conductors, grounds, shields, branch behavior and mechanical envelope are frozen. Continuity proves wiring correspondence only; protocol communication, programming suitability, gateway access and vehicle compatibility require the agreed equipment and test method.
delivery.zh: 可依据受控图纸、已验证样品、连接器型号或批准的接口表进行开发。打样前冻结车辆端与设备端身份、供电路径、信号导体、接地、屏蔽、分支行为及机械边界。导通只能证明线路对应；协议通信、编程适用性、网关访问和整车兼容性仍需约定设备与测试方法验证。

introduction.en: Build the Harness Around the Diagnostic Task, Not the Connector Shape
introduction.zh: 围绕诊断任务设计线束，而不是只看接口外形

faq.zh: 汽车诊断与 OBD 线束常见问题

subtitle.en: From the 16-position vehicle interface to the exact test or data device
subtitle.zh: 从车辆 16 位诊断接口到准确测试或数据设备

lead.en: One 16-position shell may carry regulated diagnostic contacts, manufacturer-discretionary circuits, power, grounds and several possible physical layers. A dependable assembly begins with the vehicle, task and device, then controls every conductor between them.
lead.zh: 同一个 16 位外壳中可能同时存在法规诊断触点、制造商自定义回路、供电、接地和多种物理层。可靠组件应从车辆、任务与设备出发，再控制它们之间的每一根导体。

title.en: OBD is a broad assembly family, not one universal extension lead
title.zh: OBD 是一整类组件，而不只是一根通用延长线

copy.en: The same category can include straight and right-angle extensions, low-profile flat leads, panel-mount ports, pass-through harnesses, Y splitters, switch-controlled branches, breakout leads, scan-tool adapters, data-logger tails, telematics power-and-data harnesses and legacy-vehicle conversion cables. Each format changes access, strain, branch loading, service sequence and the risk of disturbing another device. Finished drawings should show connector view, orientation, cable exit, length datum, branch point, labels and device-side termination.
copy.zh: 同一小类可包括直式与直角延长线、低矮扁平引线、面板安装接口、穿通线束、Y 型分支、开关控制分支、测试引出线、诊断仪转接线、数据记录器尾线、车联网供电数据线束及老车型转换线。不同形态会改变安装空间、应力、分支负载、维修顺序以及干扰另一设备的风险。成品图纸应标明连接器视图、方向、出线、长度基准、分支点、标签与设备端端接。

copy.en: Reading emissions data, workshop diagnosis, logging and reprogramming can require different conductors and validation.
copy.zh: 排放数据读取、维修诊断、记录与重新编程可能需要不同导体和验证。

copy.en: J1962-style OBD leads and J1939 or J1708 truck interfaces are related but not interchangeable categories.
copy.zh: J1962 形式 OBD 引线与 J1939 或 J1708 重卡接口相关，但并非可互换类别。

title.en: J1962 and ISO 15031-3 define a physical diagnostic connection with controlled contacts
title.zh: J1962 与 ISO 15031-3 定义受控触点的物理诊断连接

copy.en: The standardized connection comprises a vehicle connector and an external test-equipment connector. Requirements cover connector design, access or location, contact allocation and related electrical circuits. The familiar trapezoidal housing is intended to support standardized access, but housing gender, Type A or Type B details, terminal construction, retention and mating geometry still need exact component identification. The connector is not treated as a generic 16-way plug selected by appearance.
copy.zh: 标准化连接由车辆连接器与外部测试设备连接器组成，要求涵盖连接器设计、可达性或位置、触点分配及相关电路。常见梯形外壳用于支持标准化访问，但外壳性别、Type A 或 Type B 细节、端子结构、保持与对插几何仍需准确识别元件，不能把它当作仅凭外观选用的普通 16 位插头。

copy.en: Pin numbering is verified from the defined mating view, not inferred from the wire-exit side.
copy.zh: 针号应从规定的对插视图核对，不能从出线侧凭感觉判断。

copy.en: Standard diagnostic access does not by itself authorize a permanent device, splitter or unsupported cable load.
copy.zh: 标准诊断访问本身并不自动授权永久设备、分支器或无支撑线缆载荷。

title.en: Standardized contacts and manufacturer-discretionary contacts must not be confused
title.zh: 标准化触点与制造商自定义触点不能混淆

copy.en: Power, signal grounds and standardized diagnostic buses occupy defined functions in applicable implementations, while other positions may be assigned by the vehicle manufacturer. A fully populated extension can preserve every contact, but an adapter or device lead may intentionally use only a controlled subset. Unused cavities, bridged grounds, swapped CAN polarity, accidental battery feed or copied legacy pinouts can damage tools or prevent communication. Every circuit is released by pin number, function, conductor and destination.
copy.zh: 在适用实现中，供电、信号地和标准诊断总线承担规定功能，而其他位置可能由车辆制造商自行分配。全针延长线可以保持全部触点，但转接线或设备引线可能有意只使用受控子集。错误使用空位、随意并联接地、交换 CAN 极性、误接蓄电池供电或照搬旧车型针脚，都可能损坏工具或导致无法通信。每条回路应按针号、功能、导体与目的端放行。

title.en: Do not use color as the pin map
title.zh: 不要用颜色代替针脚表

copy.en: Wire color supports assembly and service, but the drawing and electrical test own the circuit definition.
copy.zh: 线色有助于装配与维修，但回路定义应由图纸和电测控制。

copy.en: A four-wire CAN lead and a sixteen-core pass-through are different products even with identical shells.
copy.zh: 即使外壳相同，四线 CAN 引线与十六芯穿通线也属于不同产品。

title.en: The harness must preserve the electrical behavior required by the active protocol
title.zh: 线束必须保持实际协议所需的电气行为

copy.en: OBD access may use CAN-based diagnostics or earlier physical layers such as K-line or other regulated and manufacturer-specific arrangements. The harness does not create protocol compatibility: it only transports the released circuits. CAN conductors may require a controlled twisted pair, suitable impedance behavior and limited untwist; single-wire circuits need correct reference grounds; higher-speed diagnostic Ethernet or pass-through applications can impose a different connector and cable architecture. Length, branching, shielding and adapters are reviewed against the actual interface.
copy.zh: OBD 访问可能使用基于 CAN 的诊断，也可能使用 K 线等较早物理层或其他法规与厂商专用方案。线束不会凭空创造协议兼容性，它只传输已放行回路。CAN 导体可能需要受控双绞、适合的阻抗行为与有限解绞；单线回路需要正确参考地；更高速的诊断以太网或 Pass-Thru 应用又可能需要不同连接器与线缆架构。长度、分支、屏蔽与转接需按真实接口审核。

copy.en: A tool can mate mechanically and still lack the required transceiver, wiring or software session.
copy.zh: 工具即使能够机械对插，也可能缺少所需收发器、线路或软件会话。

copy.en: Long splitter branches and extra devices can alter loading and reflections on a communication bus.
copy.zh: 过长分支与额外设备可能改变通信总线负载和反射。

title.en: Diagnostic-port power is a circuit to engineer, not a free auxiliary outlet
title.zh: 诊断口供电是需要工程审核的回路，不是随意使用的辅助插座

copy.en: Tools, loggers and telematics devices may draw power from the diagnostic connector, but available current, fuse coordination, sleep behavior, battery drain, inrush, reverse-polarity protection and ground paths depend on the vehicle and device. A splitter can add simultaneous loads that the original use did not anticipate. The harness records conductor area, contact capacity, fuse or protection arrangement, switched or unswitched behavior and whether power is passed through, isolated or provided from an auxiliary source.
copy.zh: 诊断仪、记录器与车联网设备可能从诊断接口取电，但可用电流、保险协调、休眠行为、蓄电池耗电、浪涌、反极性保护和接地路径均取决于车辆与设备。分支器可能增加原始用途未预期的同时负载。线束应记录导体截面积、触点能力、保险或保护方案、常电或受控电特性，以及电源是穿通、隔离还是来自辅助来源。

copy.en: Wireless modems and test interfaces can have short current peaks above their average consumption.
copy.zh: 无线通信模块和测试接口的短时峰值电流可能明显高于平均功耗。

copy.en: Signal and chassis references are not automatically interchangeable or safe to bridge.
copy.zh: 信号地与车身地不会自动等同，也不能随意桥接。

title.en: Low-profile exits and controlled length protect the driver space and connector
title.zh: 低矮出线与受控长度保护驾驶空间和接口

copy.en: A diagnostic port can sit above the pedals, behind trim, inside a console or close to a knee-impact zone. Straight backshells may be suitable for workshop use but obstruct permanent installations; left-, right-, up- and down-exit overmolds are not interchangeable because vehicle port orientation varies. Cable length, bend radius, clips, abrasion protection, service loop and strain relief are arranged so the assembly does not interfere with controls, trim, airbag zones or technician access.
copy.zh: 诊断口可能位于踏板上方、饰板后方、中控台内或膝部碰撞区域附近。直式尾壳适合维修场景，却可能妨碍永久安装；左、右、上、下出线包胶也不能通用，因为车辆接口方向不同。线长、弯曲半径、卡扣、耐磨防护、维修余量与应力消除应避免干涉操纵件、饰板、安全气囊区域或技师操作。

copy.en: A connector-face photo plus surrounding space prevents a correct plug from receiving the wrong cable exit.
copy.zh: 接口正面照片配合周边空间，可避免正确插头却采用错误出线方向。

copy.en: A VCI, logger or adapter should be supported rather than left loading the vehicle connector.
copy.zh: VCI、记录器或转接器应获得支撑，不能长期把重量施加在车辆接口上。

title.en: A Y splitter must define which circuits are shared, isolated or switched
title.zh: Y 型分支必须定义哪些回路共享、隔离或受开关控制

copy.en: A pass-through assembly may keep a service port accessible while a logger or telematics device remains installed. Simply connecting every pin in parallel can create two powered devices, duplicate termination or loading, unintended wake-up traffic, ground interaction and physical crowding. The released architecture identifies the primary and secondary branches, circuit pass-through, power switching or protection, branch length, device priority and acceptable simultaneous operation. When isolation electronics are required, the product becomes more than a passive cable.
copy.zh: 穿通组件可以在记录器或车联网设备常驻时保留维修接口，但简单把所有针脚并联可能造成两个受电设备、重复终端或负载、非预期唤醒通信、接地相互作用和空间拥挤。放行架构应明确主次分支、回路穿通、电源开关或保护、分支长度、设备优先级与允许的同时工作状态。若需要隔离电子电路，产品就不再只是被动线缆。

copy.en: A passive copper splitter cannot provide protocol arbitration or galvanic isolation by itself.
copy.zh: 被动铜线分支器本身不能提供协议仲裁或电气隔离。

copy.en: Labels and branch geometry should make the removable device and workshop port unmistakable.
copy.zh: 标签与分支几何应让可拆设备端和维修端清晰可辨。

title.en: Legacy and manufacturer-specific adapters translate a released pinout, not a brand name
title.zh: 老车型与厂商专用转接线转换的是已放行针脚，而不是品牌名称

copy.en: Older vehicles and specialist systems can use round, rectangular or multi-pin service connectors that predate or supplement the standardized diagnostic port. Two vehicles from the same brand may use different interfaces by model, year, engine, market or control system. The adapter is defined from the exact vehicle-side connector, mating key, pin map, protocol and scan-tool expectation. Cross-references are treated as evidence to verify, not permission to copy an online pinout without confirmation.
copy.zh: 老车型和专业系统可能采用早于或补充标准诊断口的圆形、矩形或多针维修接口。同一品牌的两辆车也可能因车型、年份、发动机、市场或控制系统不同而采用不同接口。转接线应根据准确车辆端连接器、防错键位、针脚表、协议及诊断仪预期定义；交叉资料只是待验证证据，不能据此直接照抄网络针脚。

copy.en: Model year alone may not identify a mid-cycle connector or ECU change.
copy.zh: 仅凭年份可能无法识别中期改款的接口或 ECU 变化。

copy.en: Vehicle-side correctness does not prove the scan-tool-side DB, USB or proprietary interface pinout.
copy.zh: 车辆端正确并不能证明诊断仪侧 DB、USB 或专用接口针脚正确。

title.en: DB, RJ45, USB and proprietary housings do not guarantee a standard diagnostic pinout
title.zh: DB、RJ45、USB 与专用外壳并不保证标准诊断针脚

copy.en: Diagnostic tools often use familiar connector families as convenient hardware while assigning contacts specifically to their own interface. A DB9 may carry CAN, serial signals, power or a proprietary combination; an RJ45-shaped jack need not be Ethernet; a USB-ended product may contain an active interface rather than direct copper wiring. We require the device model, connector identity and approved electrical schedule, then distinguish passive adapters from assemblies containing VCI, level-shifting, protection or conversion electronics.
copy.zh: 诊断设备常把熟悉的连接器家族作为硬件接口，却按自身方案分配触点。DB9 可能承载 CAN、串行信号、供电或专有组合；RJ45 外形插座未必是以太网；USB 端产品也可能包含主动接口，而非直接铜线连接。我们需要设备型号、连接器身份与批准电气表，并区分被动转接线和包含 VCI、电平转换、保护或转换电子器件的组件。

title.en: Name the tool, not only the plug
title.zh: 提供设备名称而不只是插头

copy.en: Tool model, hardware revision and target software ecosystem can affect the required cable.
copy.zh: 设备型号、硬件版本与目标软件生态都可能影响所需线缆。

copy.en: Programming and diagnostic claims cannot be assigned to a passive harness unless the required interface exists elsewhere.
copy.zh: 若所需接口不在其他设备中，就不能把编程或诊断能力归因于被动线束。

title.en: Conductor groups, twist, shield and jacket follow the signal and installation duty
title.zh: 导体分组、双绞、屏蔽与护套应服从信号和安装工况

copy.en: A compact workshop lead, a permanently routed telematics harness and a long breakout cable do not need identical construction. Conductor area follows signal or power duty; CAN or other balanced pairs may need controlled twist; drain and shield termination follow the interface design; filler, binder and jacket influence roundness and flexibility; abrasion, oil, temperature, flame behavior and low-temperature bending depend on the vehicle zone. Cable markings and material claims are preserved in the bill of materials rather than inferred from color or feel.
copy.zh: 紧凑维修引线、永久走线的车联网线束与长距离测试引出线不需要相同结构。导体截面积由信号或供电任务决定；CAN 等平衡线对可能需要受控双绞；排流线与屏蔽端接服从接口设计；填充、包带与护套影响圆整和柔性；耐磨、耐油、温度、阻燃与低温弯曲则取决于车辆区域。线材标识和材料声明应在物料表中保持，而不是靠颜色或手感推断。

copy.en: Excess untwist and long exposed conductors can weaken the intended noise performance.
copy.zh: 过度解绞与过长裸露导体会削弱预期抗干扰表现。

copy.en: A dry dashboard extension and an under-hood service lead face different heat, fluid and abrasion exposure.
copy.zh: 干燥仪表板延长线与发动机舱维修引线面对不同热、液体与磨损环境。

title.en: Overmold, backshell and strain relief must protect the cable without blocking vehicle access
title.zh: 包胶、尾壳与应力消除既要保护线缆，也不能妨碍车辆接口

copy.en: Injection overmolding can integrate the connector exit, pull relief, bend transition, tactile orientation and branding, while serviceable backshells support low-volume or configurable assemblies. Polymer choice, pre-mold support, adhesion, terminal retention, cable jacket compatibility and molding pressure are reviewed together. A large attractive mold can still be wrong if it collides with trim, prevents an adjacent port from being used or concentrates bending at the cable edge.
copy.zh: 注塑包胶可整合连接器出线、拉力缓冲、弯曲过渡、触觉方向与品牌标识；可拆尾壳则适合小批量或可配置组件。聚合物选择、预包胶支撑、粘附、端子保持、线缆护套相容性与成型压力需共同审核。即使外观漂亮，若包胶碰撞饰板、妨碍相邻接口或把弯曲集中在线缆边缘，仍属于错误设计。

copy.en: A printed or soft-tool sample can confirm hand clearance and exit direction before hard tooling.
copy.zh: 正式模具前可用打印件或软模样品确认手部空间与出线方向。

title.zh: 不能用包胶掩盖不良端接

copy.en: Crimp, solder or splice quality is accepted before it becomes inaccessible inside molding.
copy.zh: 压接、焊接或接续质量应在被包胶永久遮蔽前完成验收。

title.en: Controlled views, tooling and first articles make complex pin maps repeatable
title.zh: 受控视图、工具与首件把复杂针脚转化为可重复制造

copy.en: Production documents show the mating-face view, cavity number, circuit name, wire specification, strip length, terminal, seal, crimp tooling, splice, shield termination, backshell or mold and finished dimensions. Work proceeds through material identity checks, cut and strip, terminal setup, insertion, secondary lock, pair and shield preparation, branch assembly, molding where required, labeling and electrical test. First-article review confirms orientation and functional intent before the configuration is released for repeat production.
copy.zh: 生产文件应显示对插面视图、孔位、回路名称、线材规格、剥线长度、端子、密封、压接工具、接续、屏蔽端接、尾壳或模具及成品尺寸。制造经过物料身份核对、裁剥、端子设定、插入、二次锁、线对与屏蔽处理、分支装配、必要包胶、标签和电测。首件审核确认方向与功能意图后，配置才进入重复生产。

copy.en: Keyed fixtures reduce mirror-image errors between front and wire-entry views.
copy.zh: 带防错的夹具可减少正面视图与进线视图之间的镜像错误。

copy.en: Connector, terminal, cable and mold changes are reviewed rather than silently substituted.
copy.zh: 连接器、端子、线材与模具变化需审核，不能静默替代。

title.en: Continuity, network communication and reprogramming suitability are different acceptance levels
title.zh: 导通、网络通信与重新编程适用性属于不同验收层级

copy.en: Routine inspection can verify material, connector lock, dimensions, labels, pin-to-pin continuity, shorts and visual workmanship. Resistance, shield checks, insulation tests, flex or pull checks are added with defined limits and methods. Communication validation requires the specified vehicle, simulator, VCI or tool and an agreed session; programming adds power stability, software and recovery risks beyond a passive cable check. We report only the level actually tested and do not turn a continuity result into a universal compatibility claim.
copy.zh: 常规检验可核对材料、连接器锁止、尺寸、标签、针对针导通、短路与外观工艺；电阻、屏蔽、绝缘、弯折或拉力检查需按明确限值与方法增加。通信验证需要指定车辆、模拟器、VCI 或工具及约定会话；编程还涉及供电稳定、软件与恢复风险，超出被动线缆检查范围。我们只报告实际测试层级，不把导通结果包装成通用兼容声明。

copy.en: Vehicle, tool, software, power source, harness revision and test function keep the evidence interpretable.
copy.zh: 车辆、工具、软件、电源、线束版本与测试功能让证据保持可解释。

copy.en: Material lot, crimp setup, operator checks and final test remain linked to the delivered batch.
copy.zh: 材料批次、压接设定、操作检查与最终测试应关联到交付批次。

q.en: Does every 16-pin OBD connector have the same wiring?
q.zh: 所有 16 针 OBD 接口的线路都一样吗？

a.en: No. The standardized connector defines controlled functions and leaves some contacts for manufacturer discretion. Vehicle generation, market, protocol and target task still determine the released pin map.
a.zh: 不一样。标准化接口定义受控功能，同时保留部分制造商自定义触点；车辆代际、市场、协议和目标任务仍决定最终针脚表。

q.en: Can you make a full 16-core male-to-female extension?
q.zh: 可以制作全针 16 芯公对母延长线吗？

a.en: Yes, after confirming connector type, orientation, all pin-to-pin circuits, conductor sizes, length, exit direction and intended use. A fully populated extension can also pass manufacturer-specific circuits, so the application still matters.
a.zh: 可以，但需确认连接器类型、方向、全部针对针回路、导体截面积、长度、出线与用途。全针延长线也会传递制造商自定义回路，因此仍需明确应用。

q.en: Will an OBD-to-DB9 or OBD-to-RJ45 cable work with any tool?
q.zh: OBD 转 DB9 或 OBD 转 RJ45 线能兼容任何设备吗？

a.en: No. DB9 and RJ45 describe connector families, not a universal diagnostic contact assignment. The exact tool model and approved device-side pinout are required.
a.zh: 不能。DB9 与 RJ45 只是连接器家族，并不代表通用诊断针脚；必须提供准确设备型号和批准的设备端针脚。

q.en: Can two devices share the diagnostic port through a Y splitter?
q.zh: 两个设备可以通过 Y 型分支共用诊断口吗？

a.en: Only after power load, bus loading, wake-up behavior, grounds, branch length, device priority and simultaneous-operation rules are reviewed. Passive parallel wiring is not automatically safe or compatible.
a.zh: 只有审核供电负载、总线负载、唤醒行为、接地、分支长度、设备优先级与同时工作规则后才能确定；被动并联并不会自动安全或兼容。

q.en: Can a passive OBD harness perform ECU programming?
q.zh: 被动 OBD 线束能直接完成 ECU 编程吗？

a.en: A passive harness only connects released circuits. Programming additionally depends on the correct VCI or pass-through hardware, protocol support, software, vehicle access, stable power and an approved procedure.
a.zh: 被动线束只连接已放行回路。编程还取决于正确 VCI 或 Pass-Thru 硬件、协议支持、软件、车辆访问、稳定供电与批准流程。

q.en: What should be sent for a custom OBD harness review?
q.zh: 定制 OBD 线束审核需要提供什么？

a.en: Send vehicle make, model, year and market; the target task; photos of the installed port; exact tool or device; connector part numbers or samples; approved pin maps and protocol; power load; cable length and exit; branch behavior; environment; quantity; labels; and required tests.
a.zh: 请提供车辆品牌、车型、年份和市场；目标任务；已安装接口照片；准确工具或设备；连接器型号或样品；批准针脚表与协议；供电负载；线长与出线；分支行为；环境；数量；标签及所需测试。

intro.en: ECU and DCU service harnesses provide controlled access between electronic control units, domain or distribution controllers, vehicle networks, power supplies, sensors, actuators, bench fixtures and diagnostic equipment. The category covers repair pigtails, breakout harnesses, Y interfaces, programming leads, controller adapters, test looms and project-specific replacement assemblies.
intro.zh: ECU 与 DCU 维修线束用于在电子控制单元、域控制器或配电控制器、车载网络、电源、传感器、执行器、台架工装与诊断设备之间建立受控连接。该小类覆盖维修尾线、测试引出线束、Y 型接口、编程引线、控制器转接线、台架测试线束及项目专用替换组件。

knowledge.en: An ECU or DCU connector can combine battery and ignition feeds, grounds, regulated sensor supplies, analogue and digital inputs, low-side or high-side outputs, communication buses, shields and reserved circuits. Connector identity is only the first layer. The released harness has to preserve cavity numbering, terminal system, wire size, pair geometry, splice topology, protection, sealing, branch location and the electrical limits of every connected load.
knowledge.zh: 一个 ECU 或 DCU 连接器可能同时包含蓄电池与点火供电、接地、稳压传感器电源、模拟与数字输入、高边或低边输出、通信总线、屏蔽及预留回路。连接器身份只是第一层；放行线束还必须保持孔位编号、端子体系、线径、线对结构、接续拓扑、保护、密封、分支位置以及每个连接负载的电气限值。

notes.en: Provide controller manufacturer and exact part number; vehicle or equipment platform and model year; connector housings, terminals, seals and backshells; mating-face views; released pin schedule; supply voltage and load current; network type; sensors and actuators; branch and splice drawing; installation zone; length datums; protection; quantity; labels; and the required bench, vehicle or environmental validation.
notes.zh: 请提供控制器制造商与准确型号；车辆或设备平台及年份；连接器壳体、端子、密封与尾壳；对插面视图；已放行针脚表；供电电压和负载电流；网络类型；传感器与执行器；分支和接续图；安装区域；长度基准；保护方案；数量；标签以及所需台架、实车或环境验证。

delivery.en: We translate approved interface data into a controlled drawing, bill of materials, circuit table and test program. Samples are checked for connector fit, keying, wire and seal compatibility, pin mapping, dimensions and the agreed electrical functions before repeat production. Vehicle function, calibration, programming and safety behavior remain system-level responsibilities unless the exact equipment and validation scope are included.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的接口资料转化为受控图纸、物料表、回路表与测试程序。样品在重复生产前核对连接器匹配、防错、线材与密封相容、针脚映射、尺寸及约定电气功能。整车功能、标定、编程与安全行为仍属于系统层责任，除非项目明确包含准确设备与验证范围。

introduction.en: Treat the Controller, Harness and Loads as One Released Electrical Architecture
introduction.zh: 把控制器、线束与负载作为一套放行电气架构

faq.zh: ECU / DCU 维修线束常见问题

subtitle.en: From connector cavity to bench fixture, sensor, actuator and vehicle network
subtitle.zh: 从连接器孔位到台架工装、传感器、执行器与车载网络

lead.en: ECU and DCU service harnesses are built for the exact control architecture. A matching housing is useful, but only the approved pin schedule, electrical loads, network behavior and installation envelope define a working assembly.
lead.zh: ECU 与 DCU 维修线束必须围绕准确控制架构设计。匹配外壳只是起点，真正定义可用组件的是批准的针脚表、电气负载、网络行为与安装空间。

title.en: One controller category includes vehicle repair, bench access and development harnesses
title.zh: 同一控制器小类覆盖车辆维修、台架访问与开发线束

copy.en: Repair pigtails replace damaged connector tails; extension harnesses move an interface to an accessible location; breakouts expose selected circuits for measurement; Y harnesses keep the original controller connected while adding controlled access; programming leads connect approved tools; bench looms reproduce power, ground, network and selected loads away from the vehicle; replacement assemblies recreate an obsolete or damaged branch. These products can share a housing while requiring very different circuits, labels, protection and acceptance methods.
copy.zh: 维修尾线用于替换损坏的连接器尾端；延长线把接口移到可达位置；测试引出线暴露选定回路用于测量；Y 型线束在保持原控制器连接的同时增加受控访问；编程引线连接批准工具；台架线束在离车环境中复现电源、接地、网络及选定负载；替换组件则重建停产或损坏分支。它们可能使用相同外壳，却需要完全不同的回路、标签、保护与验收方法。

copy.en: Controller in-circuit, controller removed and bench simulation each require a different topology.
copy.zh: 控制器在回路、拆除控制器与台架模拟分别需要不同拓扑。

copy.en: Temporary probes and open breakouts are not automatically suitable for road installation.
copy.zh: 临时探针与开放测试引出并不自动适合随车永久安装。

title.en: ECU and DCU names describe roles, but the released interface defines the harness
title.zh: ECU 与 DCU 名称描述角色，放行接口才定义线束

copy.en: An ECU may manage an engine, transmission, body function, actuator or other subsystem. A DCU may refer to a domain controller, data control unit, dosing control unit or another manufacturer-specific device. Modern architectures can centralize computing while distributing power and I/O. We therefore identify the exact controller, hardware revision, software or calibration context when relevant, mating connectors, connected loads, gateways and network segments instead of assuming function from the acronym alone.
