copy.zh: ECU 可能管理发动机、变速器、车身功能、执行器或其他子系统；DCU 可能指域控制器、数据控制单元、计量控制单元或厂商自定义设备。现代架构既可能集中计算，也可能分布供电与 I/O。因此需要识别准确控制器、硬件版本、相关软件或标定背景、对插连接器、连接负载、网关与网络分段，而不能只根据缩写推断功能。

copy.en: Label, part number, suffix, connector color and keying support correct configuration control.
copy.zh: 标签、料号、后缀、连接器颜色与防错键位共同支持正确配置管理。

copy.en: A cavity list becomes useful only when its load, return path and branch destination are known.
copy.zh: 孔位表只有关联负载、回流路径与分支目的端后才真正有用。

title.en: Housing, terminal, seal, lock and backshell must form one compatible system
title.zh: 壳体、端子、密封、锁止与尾壳必须构成兼容体系

copy.en: Automotive controller connectors can use levers, slides, cams, secondary locks, terminal position assurance, cavity plugs and multiple key codes. Similar housings may differ in polarization, material, terminal plating, wire-size range, sealed or unsealed construction and mating controller header. Original manufacturer part numbers or verified samples help avoid substitutions based on color and outline. Terminal, seal and wire outside diameter are checked together so insertion force, retention and environmental sealing remain within the released design.
copy.zh: 汽车控制器连接器可能采用杠杆、滑轨、凸轮、二次锁、端子位置保证、堵头与多种防错编码。外形相似的壳体也可能在极化、材料、端子镀层、适用线径、密封结构及控制器插座上不同。原厂型号或已验证样品可避免按颜色与轮廓替代；端子、密封和线外径需共同核对，以使插入力、保持力与环境密封保持在放行设计内。

title.zh: 使用完整连接器物料表

copy.en: Housing alone does not define terminals, seals, plugs, locks or accessories.
copy.zh: 单独壳体无法定义端子、密封、堵头、锁止与附件。

copy.en: Probe access and repeated bench mating must not damage production contacts or seals.
copy.zh: 探测访问与反复台架对插不能损伤量产触点或密封。

title.en: Power, grounds, I/O and communication require different conductor decisions
title.zh: 供电、接地、I/O 与通信需要不同导体决策

copy.en: A controller connector can mix continuous battery feed, ignition or wake inputs, sensor references, low-current signals, shield returns, high-side or low-side outputs, PWM circuits and communication buses. Each circuit receives a cavity, name, source, destination, wire specification, color, splice or branch, protection and test point. Grounds are separated by intended function where required; sensor supplies are not treated as auxiliary power; output circuits are checked against load and inrush; reserved pins remain reserved unless the released design assigns them.
copy.zh: 控制器连接器可能混合常电、点火或唤醒输入、传感器参考电源、小电流信号、屏蔽回流、高边或低边输出、PWM 回路与通信总线。每条回路都应分配孔位、名称、来源、目的端、线材规格、颜色、接续或分支、保护和测试点；按要求区分不同用途接地，不能把传感器电源当辅助供电，输出回路需核对负载与浪涌，预留针脚在放行设计分配前保持预留。

copy.en: A simple copper branch and a protected interface module are documented as different assemblies.
copy.zh: 简单铜线分支与带保护接口模块应作为不同组件记录。

copy.en: Mating-face and wire-entry drawings prevent mirrored controller pinouts.
copy.zh: 对插面与进线面图可避免控制器针脚镜像错误。

title.en: CAN, LIN and higher-speed links depend on topology as well as continuity
title.zh: CAN、LIN 与高速链路不仅依赖导通，也依赖拓扑

copy.en: Balanced buses can require controlled pair twist, conductor symmetry, impedance behavior, short untwist and deliberate shield or drain termination. LIN and other single-wire links require the correct reference and loading. Automotive Ethernet, LVDS or proprietary high-speed links may need dedicated cable and connector systems that cannot be recreated with general-purpose wire. Breakouts and Y harnesses add stub length and connectors; termination, gateway position and test equipment loading are reviewed before the branch is approved.
copy.zh: 平衡总线可能需要受控双绞、导体对称、阻抗行为、短解绞及有意设计的屏蔽或排流端接；LIN 等单线链路需要正确参考与负载；汽车以太网、LVDS 或专有高速链路可能需要专用线缆与连接器体系，不能用普通导线重建。测试引出与 Y 型线束会增加支线长度和连接器，批准分支前需审核终端、网关位置与测试设备负载。

title.zh: 导通不等于信号完整性

copy.en: A correctly mapped pair can still perform poorly after excessive untwist or an uncontrolled stub.
copy.zh: 映射正确的线对仍可能因过度解绞或不受控支线而性能不良。

copy.en: One-end, two-end and connector-shell termination choices follow the released EMC concept.
copy.zh: 单端、双端或连接器壳体端接应服从放行 EMC 方案。

title.en: Bench and vehicle harnesses need deliberate supply, protection and load simulation
title.zh: 台架与实车线束需要明确供电、保护与负载模拟

copy.en: A bench loom can require current-limited battery supply, ignition sequencing, ground distribution, fuse or breaker protection, reverse-polarity protection, load boxes and accessible measurement points. Solenoids, motors, heaters and lamps can produce inrush or inductive transients that a resistor substitute does not reproduce. The harness is sized around continuous and peak current, voltage drop, duty cycle, connector limits and fault strategy. Output loads are never added merely because a cavity has measurable voltage.
copy.zh: 台架线束可能需要限流蓄电池电源、点火时序、接地分配、保险或断路保护、反极性保护、负载箱与可达测点。电磁阀、电机、加热器和灯具可能产生电流浪涌或感性瞬态，简单电阻替代并不能复现。线束应按持续与峰值电流、压降、占空比、连接器限值与故障策略选型，不能仅因某孔位测得电压就随意增加输出负载。

copy.en: Battery, ignition, wake and enable circuits may not be safe to energize simultaneously or in any order.
copy.zh: 蓄电池、点火、唤醒与使能回路未必可以任意顺序或同时上电。

copy.en: Replaceable fuses and clearly rated test points reduce damage during development faults.
copy.zh: 可替换保险与清晰额定测点可降低开发故障造成的损伤。

title.en: Measurement access should expose the intended circuit without changing system behavior
title.zh: 测量访问应暴露目标回路，而不改变系统行为

copy.en: Breakout harnesses may use labeled flying leads, protected banana sockets, terminal blocks, duplicate controller connectors or instrument-specific outputs. Lead length, contact resistance, shielding and probe capacitance can influence sensitive sensors or fast networks. Branch points are located by a controlled datum; exposed points receive touch and short-circuit protection; high-current and low-level signal areas are separated; unused branches are capped. A service interface is designed for the instrument and measurement method, not just for physical accessibility.
copy.zh: 测试引出线束可使用带标签飞线、带保护香蕉插孔、端子排、重复控制器接口或仪器专用输出。引线长度、接触电阻、屏蔽与探头电容都可能影响敏感传感器或高速网络。分支点按受控基准定位；裸露测点获得防触碰与防短路保护；大电流与低电平信号区域分离；未使用分支加盖。维修接口应围绕仪器与测量方法设计，而不只是方便够到。

copy.en: Circuit name, cavity and connector reference make measurements traceable to the drawing.
copy.zh: 回路名称、孔位与连接器代号让测量可追溯到图纸。

copy.en: Repeatable branch position protects routing and keeps instrument leads out of moving zones.
copy.zh: 可重复分支位置可保护走线，并让仪器引线远离运动区域。

title.en: Wire, terminals, seals and protection are chosen for the exact mounting zone
title.zh: 线材、端子、密封与防护应按准确安装区域选择

copy.en: ISO 19642 provides an automotive-cable framework, while customer specifications and regional standards can define the actual cable family. Conductor construction, temperature class, thin-wall or thick-wall insulation, fluid and abrasion resistance, twisted pairs, screened cable and jacketed multicore options follow the electrical and environmental duty. Terminal plating, contact size, seal range, cavity plugs, corrugated tube, textile tape, braid and heat-shrink are coordinated with wire outside diameter and connector design. Material names alone do not establish a qualified assembly.
copy.zh: ISO 19642 提供汽车线缆框架，而客户规范与区域标准可能进一步定义实际线材体系。导体结构、温度等级、薄壁或厚壁绝缘、耐液体与耐磨、双绞线、屏蔽线及多芯护套选项应服从电气与环境任务。端子镀层、触点尺寸、密封范围、堵头、波纹管、布基胶带、编织与热缩需结合线外径及连接器设计协调；只有材料名称不能构成合格组件。

copy.en: An undersized or oversized insulation diameter can defeat retention and sealing.
copy.zh: 绝缘外径过小或过大都可能破坏保持与密封。

title.en: Use evidence for the actual material

copy.en: Temperature, flame, fluid and abrasion claims remain tied to the specified product and test scope.
copy.zh: 温度、阻燃、耐液体与耐磨声明应与指定产品及测试范围绑定。

title.en: Mounting location determines heat, vibration, moisture, fluids and mechanical protection
title.zh: 安装位置决定热、振动、湿气、液体与机械防护

copy.en: ISO 16750 describes potential environmental stresses and testing for vehicle electrical and electronic equipment by mounting location. A cabin service extension, engine-bay controller branch, chassis-mounted DCU and test-cell loom therefore require different protection. Routing reviews radiant and conducted heat, sharp edges, stone or tool impact, connector support, bend radius, water paths, oil and cleaning chemicals, vibration nodes, moving parts and service removal. Harness coverings are selected to solve identified exposure rather than added decoratively.
copy.zh: ISO 16750 按车辆安装位置描述电气电子设备可能承受的环境应力与测试，因此舱内维修延长线、发动机舱控制器分支、底盘安装 DCU 与试验台线束需要不同防护。走线审核辐射与传导热、锋利边缘、石击或工具冲击、连接器支撑、弯曲半径、进水路径、油液与清洗剂、振动节点、运动部件及维修拆卸；线束覆盖层应解决已识别暴露，而不是装饰性堆叠。

copy.en: Connector backshell and terminal retention should not carry unsupported harness mass.
copy.zh: 连接器尾壳与端子保持结构不应承担无支撑线束重量。

copy.en: Enough length supports removal, but excess loops can rub, trap fluid or enter moving zones.
copy.zh: 足够长度便于拆卸，但过多余量可能摩擦、积液或进入运动区域。

title.en: Samples and controller data become a controlled service solution through engineering review
title.zh: 样品与控制器资料经过工程审核才能成为受控维修方案

copy.en: A damaged harness sample can reveal length, branch geometry, connector orientation and some circuit mapping, but it may hide internal splices, shielding, material identity or earlier repairs. Controller schematics, connector views, vehicle diagrams, tool documentation and measured evidence are reconciled before a replacement or development harness is released. Unknown circuits are marked for confirmation. Approved first-article feedback is converted into the drawing and test table so later batches do not depend on technician memory.
copy.zh: 损坏线束样品可提供长度、分支几何、连接器方向与部分回路映射，却可能隐藏内部接续、屏蔽、材料身份或既往维修。控制器原理图、连接器视图、整车线路图、工具资料与测量证据应在替换或开发线束放行前相互核对，未知回路明确标记待确认。批准首件的反馈需转化到图纸与测试表，使后续批次不依赖技师记忆。

copy.en: Burnt terminals, stretched branches and field repairs are evidence to investigate, not dimensions to reproduce.
copy.zh: 烧蚀端子、拉伸分支与现场修补是待调查证据，而不是应复制尺寸。

copy.en: Controller and vehicle changes remain distinguishable in service stock and future orders.
copy.zh: 控制器与车辆变更在维修库存和后续订单中保持可区分。

title.en: Circuit tables, crimp data and assembly fixtures convert complexity into repeatability
title.zh: 回路表、压接数据与装配夹具把复杂性转化为可重复制造

copy.en: The build package combines connector BOM, cavity schedule, wire and cable list, cut lengths, splice map, shield treatment, labels, coverings, branch dimensions and test requirements. Material identity is checked before cut and strip; terminals use the specified tooling and setup; seals and cavity plugs are inserted in sequence; secondary locks are confirmed; branches and coverings use fixtures or datums; accessible electrical checks occur before molding or closed protection hides the work. First articles are reviewed against both the drawing and the intended installation.
copy.zh: 制造包整合连接器物料表、孔位表、线材清单、裁线长度、接续图、屏蔽处理、标签、覆盖层、分支尺寸与测试要求。裁剥前核对材料身份；端子使用指定工具与设定；密封和堵头按顺序装入；确认二次锁；分支与覆盖层使用夹具或基准；包胶或封闭防护遮蔽作业前完成可达电检。首件既要对照图纸，也要对照预期安装审核。

copy.en: Crimps, splices and shields are accepted before overmold, tube or tape makes them inaccessible.
copy.zh: 压接、接续与屏蔽应在包胶、套管或胶带使其不可达前验收。

copy.en: Housing, terminal, seal and cable alternatives need documented compatibility review.
copy.zh: 壳体、端子、密封与线材替代需要文件化相容性审核。

title.en: Electrical mapping, load behavior and system function are verified at distinct levels
title.zh: 电气映射、负载行为与系统功能应在不同层级验证

copy.en: Routine production can verify dimensions, materials, labels, connector locks, pin mapping, continuity, shorts and visual workmanship. Resistance, voltage drop, pull, insulation, shielding and flex checks are added with released limits. A powered bench test confirms only the included loads and sequences; network communication requires the specified controller, simulator or vehicle; calibration, flashing and safety functions require their own controlled method and stable supply. Reports state the actual equipment, revision, limits, sample and result, while material lots and process records remain linked to the delivered batch.
copy.zh: 常规生产可核对尺寸、材料、标签、连接器锁止、针脚映射、导通、短路与外观工艺；电阻、压降、拉力、绝缘、屏蔽与弯折检查按放行限值增加。上电台架测试只确认所包含负载与时序；网络通信需要指定控制器、模拟器或车辆；标定、刷写与安全功能则需要各自受控方法和稳定供电。报告应说明实际设备、版本、限值、样本与结果，材料批次和过程记录继续关联到交付批次。

copy.en: Continuity, powered function, communication and vehicle validation are not interchangeable claims.
copy.zh: 导通、上电功能、通信与实车验证不是可互换声明。

copy.en: A test result remains meaningful only for the documented controller, harness and load configuration.
copy.zh: 测试结果只有关联所记录控制器、线束与负载配置后才有意义。

q.en: Is an ECU or DCU harness defined by the connector housing?
q.zh: ECU 或 DCU 线束可以只按连接器壳体定义吗？

a.en: No. The exact controller, cavity schedule, terminal and seal system, wire specifications, branches, loads, network topology, protection and mounting zone define the assembly.
a.zh: 不能。准确控制器、孔位表、端子与密封体系、线材规格、分支、负载、网络拓扑、保护与安装区域共同定义组件。

q.en: Can you build from an existing damaged sample?
q.zh: 可以依据损坏的现有样品制作吗？

a.en: A sample can support geometry and connector identification, but hidden splices, materials, shielding and earlier repairs require independent confirmation. Electrical data and the intended function are still needed.
a.zh: 样品有助于确认几何与连接器，但隐藏接续、材料、屏蔽和既往维修仍需独立确认，同时仍需电气资料与预期功能。

q.en: Can a Y harness keep the ECU connected while measurements are taken?
q.zh: Y 型线束可以在保持 ECU 连接时进行测量吗？

a.en: Yes, when the branch topology, stub length, instrument loading, shielding, exposed-point protection and connected-state test method are approved for the target circuits.
a.zh: 可以，但需针对目标回路批准分支拓扑、支线长度、仪器负载、屏蔽、裸露测点保护与连接状态测试方法。

q.en: Does continuity testing prove that a controller harness will work in the vehicle?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明控制器线束可在车辆上正常工作吗？

a.en: No. Continuity proves circuit correspondence. Loads, voltage drop, network integrity, power sequencing, software, calibration and system behavior require additional defined validation.
a.zh: 不能。导通只证明回路对应；负载、压降、网络完整性、供电时序、软件、标定与系统行为需要额外明确验证。

q.en: Can you supply both bench and vehicle-side service harnesses?
q.zh: 可以同时提供台架与车辆侧维修线束吗？

a.en: Yes. They are released as distinct configurations because supply protection, load simulation, exposed test points, coverings, routing and acceptance methods usually differ.
a.zh: 可以，但通常作为不同配置放行，因为供电保护、负载模拟、裸露测点、覆盖层、走线与验收方法往往不同。

q.en: What information starts an ECU or DCU harness review?
q.zh: ECU 或 DCU 线束审核需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send controller and vehicle identities, connector part numbers or samples, mating-face views, approved pin map, loads, supply and network details, branch drawing, installation environment, dimensions, protection, labels, quantity and the required test level.
a.zh: 请提供控制器与车辆身份、连接器型号或样品、对插面视图、批准针脚表、负载、供电与网络资料、分支图、安装环境、尺寸、保护、标签、数量及所需测试层级。

intro.en: J1939 heavy-duty harnesses connect service tools, telematics devices, data loggers, displays, gateways and vehicle controllers to the communication and power interfaces used across trucks, buses, trailers, construction machines, agricultural equipment and vehicle-derived stationary systems.
intro.zh: J1939 重卡线束用于把维修工具、车联网设备、数据记录器、显示终端、网关和车辆控制器连接到卡车、客车、挂车、工程机械、农业设备及车辆衍生固定设备的通信与供电接口。

knowledge.en: J1939 is a family of SAE documents for heavy-duty vehicle networking, not the name of one universal cable. A released assembly must identify the applicable connector, keying, populated cavities, network channel, bit rate, power path, shielding or twisted-pair construction, topology, device-side interface and operating environment.
knowledge.zh: J1939 是面向重型车辆网络的一组 SAE 文件体系，而不是某一种通用线缆的名称。可放行组件必须明确适用连接器、防错键位、已装孔位、网络通道、速率、供电路径、屏蔽或双绞结构、拓扑、设备端接口及使用环境。

notes.en: Provide the vehicle or equipment maker, model and year; engine and controller identifiers; connector color and mating-face photographs; released pin map; required network channel and speed; tool or device interface; whether the lead is for diagnostics, logging, telematics or permanent installation; cable length and branch datums; sealing, abrasion, temperature and chemical exposure; quantity; labels; and the required electrical and communication checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆或设备制造商、型号与年份；发动机及控制器信息；连接器颜色和对插面照片；已批准针脚表；所需网络通道与速率；工具或设备端接口；诊断、记录、车联网或永久安装用途；线长与分支基准；密封、磨损、温度及化学暴露；数量、标签以及所需电气和通信检查。

delivery.en: We convert approved interface and network information into controlled drawings, connector and terminal BOMs, cable definitions, branch dimensions, molding or backshell requirements, identification and test programs. Production checks can verify construction and pin mapping; live J1939 communication requires the specified vehicle, controller, simulator or approved network fixture and an agreed functional scope.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的接口和网络资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与端子物料表、线缆定义、分支尺寸、包胶或尾壳要求、标识与测试程序。生产检查可以核实结构和针脚映射；实际 J1939 通信仍需指定车辆、控制器、模拟器或批准的网络工装，并明确功能验证范围。

introduction.en: Build the Heavy-Duty Link Around the Actual Vehicle Network
introduction.zh: 围绕实际重型车辆网络定义连接线束

faq.zh: J1939 重卡线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Diagnostic access, data logging, telematics and controller integration for on-road and off-road equipment
subtitle.zh: 面向道路与非道路设备的诊断访问、数据记录、车联网与控制器集成

lead.en: A circular nine-cavity connector is only a physical clue. Reliable J1939 access depends on keying, pin population, network channel, bus speed, topology, power source and the exact device connected at the other end.
lead.zh: 圆形九孔接口只是一个物理线索。可靠的 J1939 访问取决于防错、装针、网络通道、总线速率、拓扑、供电来源以及另一端连接的准确设备。

title.en: One J1939 category includes access leads, adapters, splitters, loggers and embedded branches
title.zh: 同一 J1939 小类覆盖访问线、转接线、分支线、记录设备线与嵌入式支路

copy.en: The product family can include 9-pin extensions, straight or right-angle service leads, Type 1 or Type 2 adapters, J1939-to-OBD-style interfaces, DB9 or DB15 tool leads, USB or serial gateway cables, telematics power-and-data harnesses, panel-mounted ports, Y splitters, pass-through looms, fused branches, end-stripped tails and controller-specific assemblies. These are not interchangeable simply because one end looks similar. Each format changes the connected state, accessible network, power distribution, mechanical load and service sequence.
copy.zh: 该产品族可包括 9 针延长线、直式或直角维修线、Type 1 或 Type 2 转接线、J1939 至 OBD 形式接口、DB9 或 DB15 工具线、USB 或串口网关线、车联网供电数据线束、面板安装口、Y 型分支、穿通线束、带保险支路、剥头尾线及控制器专用组件。即便一端外形相似也不能互换；每种形式都会改变连接状态、可访问网络、供电分配、机械载荷与维修顺序。

copy.en: Tool brand, logger, gateway and telematics device may use different pin maps behind the same shell family.
copy.zh: 不同诊断仪、记录器、网关和车联网设备可能在相似壳体后使用不同针脚。

copy.en: A workshop adapter and an installed fleet harness need different retention, sealing and protection.
copy.zh: 车间转接线与随车长期安装线束需要不同的固定、密封与防护。

title.en: The cable must preserve the intended CAN path, pair geometry and reference conductors
title.zh: 线缆必须保持预期 CAN 路径、线对结构与参考导体

copy.en: J1939 communication is carried over a CAN-based physical network. The harness must retain the approved high and low conductors as a controlled pair, with shield or drain treatment where specified, while keeping power and ground on their defined paths. Pair untwist near terminals, long unplanned stubs, wrong cable substitution, shield discontinuity and routing beside strong noise sources can change network behavior even when a continuity tester reports correct endpoints. Cable construction and branch geometry are therefore part of the released electrical design.
copy.zh: J1939 通信基于 CAN 物理网络。线束需要把批准的高、低信号导体保持为受控线对，并按要求处理屏蔽或排流线，同时让电源与接地沿规定路径连接。端子附近过度解绞、未经规划的长支线、错误替代线材、屏蔽中断以及紧邻强干扰源的走线，都可能在导通端点正确时仍改变网络行为，因此线缆结构和分支几何本身就是放行电气设计的一部分。

copy.en: Twist, impedance-related construction and termination treatment follow the approved network design.
copy.zh: 绞距、阻抗相关结构与端接处理应遵循批准的网络设计。

copy.en: Required network speed is confirmed from the vehicle and device documentation, not connector color alone.
copy.zh: 所需网络速率应依据车辆与设备资料确认，不能只看连接器颜色。

title.en: A splitter changes the network, so branch length and connected loading must be reviewed
title.zh: 分支会改变网络，必须审核支线长度与连接负载

copy.en: A pass-through lead preserves a vehicle-side and service-side connection while adding a device branch. A Y cable may expose one network to two tools, but simultaneous connection can add capacitance, termination, ground paths or protocol traffic that the original system did not expect. Some vehicles expose more than one J1939 network at the service connector, and a cable wired only to the common channel may not reach every controller. The drawing should identify which cavities and channels are carried, how each branch is used and whether more than one device may remain connected.
copy.zh: 穿通线束在保留车辆侧与维修侧连接的同时增加设备支路。Y 型线可能让两个工具接入同一网络，但同时连接会引入原系统未预期的电容、终端、接地路径或协议流量。有些车辆在维修接口上提供多个 J1939 网络，只连接常用通道的线缆可能无法访问所有控制器。图纸应标明承载的孔位与通道、各支路用途以及是否允许多个设备同时连接。

copy.en: Branch destination, length datum and connected-state rule belong on the controlled drawing.
copy.zh: 支路目的端、长度基准和连接状态规则都应写入受控图纸。

copy.en: An added device must not unintentionally create or remove network termination.
copy.zh: 新增设备不应无意中增加或移除网络终端。

title.en: Truck and bus installations combine service access with demanding routing constraints
title.zh: 卡车与客车安装同时面对维修访问和苛刻走线限制

copy.en: On-highway applications can connect engine, transmission, braking, body, instrument, aftertreatment, telematics and trailer-related systems. The diagnostic port may sit beneath the dash, beside a fuse panel, in a service bay or behind trim, and the available orientation can make a straight plug obstruct pedals or covers. Low-profile exits, right-angle overmolds, panel clips, abrasion sleeves and defined service loops help protect the port while keeping it accessible. The vehicle model, year, cab configuration and installation photograph are needed before freezing geometry.
copy.zh: 道路车辆应用可能连接发动机、变速器、制动、车身、仪表、后处理、车联网及挂车相关系统。诊断口可能位于仪表台下、保险盒旁、维修舱内或饰板后，现有方向可能使直式插头干涉踏板或盖板。低矮出线、直角包胶、面板卡扣、耐磨套与规定维修余量有助于保护接口并保持可达；冻结几何前需要车辆型号、年份、驾驶室配置与安装照片。

copy.en: Cable exit and support points should avoid sustained bending or lever load at the connector.
copy.zh: 出线与支撑点应避免连接器长期承受弯曲或杠杆载荷。

copy.en: Routing must not obstruct pedals, panels, controls or scheduled maintenance points.
copy.zh: 走线不得阻碍踏板、饰板、控制件或计划维修点。

title.en: Construction, agricultural and stationary equipment place the same network in different environments
title.zh: 工程、农业与固定设备让同类网络面对不同环境

copy.en: SAE describes J1939 use across on-road and off-road vehicles as well as appropriate stationary applications using vehicle-derived components. Excavators, loaders, cranes, agricultural machines and generator sets can expose service connectors with manufacturer-specific keying, alternative power arrangements or multiple networks. These applications also add mud, dust, washdown, hydraulic oil, diesel, long vibration cycles and field-service handling. The harness category therefore extends beyond highway trucks, but compatibility must still be confirmed for the exact equipment platform.
copy.zh: SAE 将 J1939 的适用范围描述为道路车辆、非道路车辆以及采用车辆衍生部件的适当固定设备。挖掘机、装载机、起重机、农业机械与发电机组可能使用厂商特定防错、不同供电安排或多网络维修接口，同时还会面对泥土、粉尘、冲洗、液压油、柴油、长周期振动与野外维修操作。因此该小类不只服务公路卡车，但仍必须针对准确设备平台确认兼容性。

copy.en: Make, model, serial range and controller option can alter interface and network access.
copy.zh: 品牌、型号、序列号范围与控制器选装会改变接口和网络访问。

copy.en: Caps, tethering, grip, color coding and labels support repeated service outside a clean workshop.
copy.zh: 防尘盖、系绳、握持、颜色区分与标签支持非洁净车间环境下的重复维修。

title.en: Water, mud, oil, vibration and temperature are translated into zone-specific protection
title.zh: 把水、泥、油、振动与温度转化为分区防护要求

copy.en: A connector inside a cab and a branch routed under a chassis should not inherit the same assumptions. We divide the assembly into exposure zones and define sealing, cavity plugs, backshell or overmold, jacket material, abrasion cover, clips, bend relief and drainage accordingly. Sealed connectors only protect a system when the housing, terminals, wire seals, cavity plugs, secondary locks and mating interface are compatible and correctly assembled. A cap protects an unused service end; it does not compensate for an incorrect seal system or a cable exit that traps water.
copy.zh: 驾驶室内接口与底盘下支路不应沿用相同假设。我们按暴露区域拆分组件，并据此定义密封、堵头、尾壳或包胶、护套材料、耐磨覆盖、固定夹、弯曲缓解与排水。密封连接器只有在壳体、端子、线封、堵头、二次锁及对插件相容且装配正确时才形成系统保护；防尘盖只保护闲置维修端，不能弥补错误密封体系或积水出线。

copy.en: Cab, engine bay, chassis, articulation point and external tool end receive different treatments.
copy.zh: 驾驶室、发动机舱、底盘、铰接处与外部工具端采用不同处理。

copy.en: Oil, fuel, cleaning agent and road chemical exposure guide jacket and covering review.
copy.zh: 机油、燃油、清洗剂与道路化学品暴露决定护套和覆盖层审核。

title.en: Conductors, jackets, overmolds and coverings are selected as one mechanical system
title.zh: 导体、护套、包胶与覆盖层作为一套机械系统选择

copy.en: Network pairs, power conductors and auxiliary circuits may require different wire or cable constructions within one assembly. Conductor size follows current, voltage drop, flexing and termination limits; insulation and outer jacket follow temperature, oil, abrasion and chemical exposure; braid, conduit, fabric tape or heat-shrink provides local protection without forcing the harness beyond its bend radius. Overmolding can add strain relief, sealing and repeatable grip, but resin compatibility, pre-mold support, cable adhesion and the service temperature range must be reviewed before tooling.
copy.zh: 同一组件内的网络线对、电源导体与辅助回路可能需要不同线材或电缆结构。导体尺寸依据电流、压降、弯折与端接限制确定；绝缘与外护套依据温度、油污、磨损及化学暴露选择；编织网、波纹管、布基胶带或热缩材料提供局部防护，同时不能迫使线束低于允许弯曲半径。包胶可增加应力缓解、密封与稳定握持，但开模前必须审核树脂相容、预包胶支撑、线缆粘结及使用温度范围。

copy.en: Wire size, strand construction, seal range and crimp geometry are reviewed together.
copy.zh: 线径、绞线结构、线封范围与压接几何应一并审核。

copy.en: Covering transitions and service loops preserve movement and reduce concentrated stress.
copy.zh: 覆盖层过渡与维修余量用于保持活动并减少应力集中。

title.en: Diagnostic access and device power must remain controlled as separate circuit functions
title.zh: 诊断访问与设备供电必须作为不同回路功能受控

copy.en: A service connector can provide network access and a vehicle supply, but the connected tool, gateway, display or tracker may require its own fuse, switched feed, wake line, ground strategy or voltage conversion. A pass-through harness must preserve the vehicle circuits while preventing an added branch from back-feeding, overloading a source or creating an unintended ground path. Inline protection, wire size and connector rating are selected from the actual device demand and duty cycle. Power availability at a familiar cavity is never assumed across every vehicle generation.
copy.zh: 维修接口可能同时提供网络访问与车辆电源，但所连接诊断仪、网关、显示终端或定位设备还可能需要独立保险、开关电源、唤醒线、接地策略或电压转换。穿通线束必须保留车辆原回路，同时防止新增支路反向供电、过载电源或形成非预期接地路径。串联保护、线径与连接器额定值应依据实际设备负载和工作周期选择，不能假定每一代车辆在熟悉孔位上都提供同样电源。

copy.en: Voltage, current, switched state, fuse location and return path are named explicitly.
copy.zh: 电压、电流、开关状态、保险位置与回流路径应明确记录。

copy.en: External tool power and vehicle power are isolated or coordinated by the approved design.
copy.zh: 外部工具电源与车辆电源应按批准设计隔离或协调。

title.en: An existing lead helps recover geometry, but hidden electrical intent still needs evidence
title.zh: 现有线缆有助于还原几何，隐藏电气意图仍需证据

copy.en: A sample can reveal connector family, keying, cable exit, approximate length, branch positions and external protection. It cannot by itself prove network speed, every cavity assignment, conductor material, splice placement, shield termination, fuse value or compatibility with another vehicle. During reverse review we record mating-face orientation, trace circuits, identify installed contacts, inspect accessible materials and compare findings with customer documentation. Uncertain functions are flagged before sampling rather than copied as assumptions.
copy.zh: 样品可以显示连接器家族、防错、出线、近似长度、分支位置与外部防护，却不能单独证明网络速率、全部孔位功能、导体材料、接续位置、屏蔽端接、保险数值或另一车型的兼容性。逆向审核会记录对插面方向、追踪回路、识别已装接触件、检查可达材料并与客户资料对照；不确定功能在打样前标记，而不是作为假设照抄。

copy.en: Measured construction and customer-approved electrical function are recorded as different evidence.
copy.zh: 测得结构与客户批准的电气功能作为不同证据记录。

copy.en: Mating-face photographs and cavity diagrams prevent mirrored pin interpretations.
copy.zh: 对插面照片与孔位图可避免镜像针脚误读。

title.en: Connector build, branch geometry and overmold details are converted into repeatable work instructions
title.zh: 把连接器装配、分支几何与包胶细节转化为可重复作业文件

copy.en: The manufacturing package lists housings, contacts, seals, plugs, backshells, cable and covering; defines cavity population, cut and strip lengths, crimp tooling, splice locations, shield treatment, branch dimensions, labels, fuse elements, molding orientation and inspection points. Material identity is confirmed before processing, contacts are crimped with the released setup, seals and secondary locks are checked in sequence, and electrical tests are completed before closed coverings or molding hide the work. Fixtures control plug orientation and branch datums without turning the assembly into an over-constrained rigid part.
copy.zh: 制造包列明壳体、接触件、密封、堵头、尾壳、线缆与覆盖层；定义装针、裁剥长度、压接工具、接续位置、屏蔽处理、分支尺寸、标签、保险元件、包胶方向与检查点。加工前确认物料身份，接触件按放行设定压接，密封与二次锁依次核对，在封闭覆盖或包胶遮蔽作业前完成电检；夹具控制插头方向和分支基准，但不会把组件约束成过度僵硬的部件。

copy.en: Crimps, splices, shield ends and fuse joints are accepted while still accessible.
copy.zh: 压接、接续、屏蔽端与保险连接应在可达时验收。

copy.en: Cable exit, keying reference, logo and grip features follow an approved orientation drawing.
copy.zh: 出线、防错基准、标识与握持特征应遵循批准方向图。

title.en: Construction checks and live network checks answer different questions
title.zh: 结构检查与实际网络检查回答不同问题

copy.en: Routine production can verify dimensions, material identity, connector keying, locks, cavity population, pin-to-pin continuity, shorts, labels, fuse path and visual workmanship. Resistance, voltage drop, pull, insulation, shielding, flex or environmental checks are added with released limits. These checks do not by themselves prove J1939 communication. A communication check requires the specified vehicle, controller, simulator or approved fixture, the correct network channel and speed, defined device settings and a recorded pass criterion. Reports state exactly which level was performed and link results to drawing revision and batch.
copy.zh: 常规生产可以核对尺寸、物料身份、连接器防错、锁止、装针、点对点导通、短路、标签、保险路径与外观工艺；电阻、压降、拉力、绝缘、屏蔽、弯折或环境检查按放行限值增加。这些检查本身不能证明 J1939 通信。通信检查需要指定车辆、控制器、模拟器或批准工装，正确网络通道与速率、明确设备设定和可记录判定标准。报告应准确说明完成的验证层级，并把结果关联到图纸版本与批次。

copy.en: Continuity, powered operation, bus traffic and full vehicle function are not interchangeable claims.
copy.zh: 导通、上电运行、总线通信与整车功能不是可互换的声明。

copy.en: Connector type, pin map, network channel, device and vehicle revision remain linked to evidence.
copy.zh: 连接器类型、针脚、网络通道、设备与车辆版本应持续关联验证证据。

q.en: Does every nine-pin heavy-duty connector provide the same J1939 access?
q.zh: 所有九针重型车辆接口都提供相同 J1939 访问吗？

a.en: No. Keying, connector generation, populated cavities, power arrangement and available network channels can differ. The exact equipment and released pin definition must be checked.
a.zh: 不是。防错、连接器代次、装针、供电安排和可用网络通道都可能不同，必须核对准确设备与放行针脚定义。

q.en: What is the difference between black Type 1 and green Type 2 interfaces?
q.zh: 黑色 Type 1 与绿色 Type 2 接口有什么区别？

a.en: They use different keying associated with different J1939 physical-layer generations. A color observation supports identification but does not replace confirmation of the vehicle network, speed and actual pin population.
a.zh: 两者使用与不同 J1939 物理层代次相关的防错结构。颜色观察有助于识别，但不能替代对车辆网络、速率和实际装针的确认。

q.en: Can one splitter support a diagnostic tool and telematics unit at the same time?
q.zh: 一根分支线可以同时连接诊断仪和车联网设备吗？

a.en: Sometimes, but only after reviewing branch length, device loading, termination, traffic, power draw, ground paths and the vehicle's permitted connected state.
a.zh: 有时可以，但必须审核支线长度、设备负载、终端、通信流量、取电、接地路径及车辆允许的连接状态。

q.en: Can you build a J1939 harness from a sample?
q.zh: 可以依据样品制作 J1939 线束吗？

a.en: A sample can support mechanical reconstruction and circuit tracing. Network speed, hidden splices, electrical function and cross-vehicle compatibility still require documentation or controlled validation.
a.zh: 样品可支持机械还原和回路追踪；网络速率、隐藏接续、电气功能与跨车型兼容仍需文件或受控验证。

q.en: Does a continuity test prove J1939 communication?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明 J1939 通信吗？

a.en: No. Continuity verifies the defined conductive paths. Communication also depends on pair construction, topology, termination, network speed, active equipment and device configuration.
a.zh: 不能。导通验证规定导电路径，通信还取决于线对结构、拓扑、终端、网络速率、活动设备与设备配置。

q.en: What information is needed for quotation and sampling?
q.zh: 报价与打样需要哪些资料？

a.en: Send vehicle or equipment identity, year or serial range, connector and mating-face details, pin map, network channel and speed, device-side interface, intended use, power demand, geometry, environmental zones, labels, quantity and required checks.
a.zh: 请提供车辆或设备身份、年份或序列号范围、连接器与对插面资料、针脚表、网络通道与速率、设备端接口、用途、功耗、几何、环境分区、标签、数量及所需检查。

intro.en: Truck harnesses distribute power, ground, lighting, control and network circuits through the cab, powertrain, chassis and rear equipment of light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicles. The category covers complete vehicle looms as well as cab, chassis, engine, transmission, lighting, power-distribution, body-builder and trailer-interface sub-harnesses.
intro.zh: 卡车线束把电源、接地、照明、控制与网络回路分配到轻型、中型及重型商用车的驾驶室、动力总成、底盘和车尾设备。该小类既覆盖整车主线束，也覆盖驾驶室、底盘、发动机、变速器、照明、配电、上装及挂车接口等分线束。

knowledge.en: A truck harness is a vehicle architecture rather than a generic bundle of wires. Cab and chassis zones have different exposure, service access and mechanical movement. Every released branch therefore links circuit function, load, protection, connector system, route, support spacing, bend allowance, splice position, environmental zone and validation method.
knowledge.zh: 卡车线束是一套车辆电气架构，而不是通用导线的捆扎。驾驶室与底盘区域的暴露、维修可达性和机械运动各不相同，因此每条放行支路都要关联回路功能、负载、保护、连接器体系、路径、固定间距、弯曲余量、接续位置、环境分区与验证方法。

notes.en: Provide vehicle maker, platform, model year and cab or wheelbase configuration; system voltage; equipment and controller part numbers; circuit and pin tables; load current and protection; connector BOM; zone and routing photographs; branch datums; clips, grommets and coverings; articulation or service loops; body-builder and trailer interfaces; labels; quantity; and the required electrical, mechanical or environmental checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆制造商、平台、年份及驾驶室或轴距配置；系统电压；设备与控制器型号；回路与针脚表；负载电流及保护；连接器物料表；分区和走线照片；分支基准；卡扣、护圈与覆盖层；铰接或维修余量；上装与挂车接口；标签、数量以及所需电气、机械或环境检查。

delivery.en: We convert approved vehicle information into controlled drawings, circuit schedules, connector and terminal BOMs, splice maps, route dimensions, covering instructions, labels and test programs. Sample fit is reviewed on the specified vehicle or fixture before repeat production. Continuity and workmanship checks confirm the manufactured harness; complete vehicle behavior remains a system-level validation unless the exact vehicle, loads and acceptance plan are included.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的车辆资料转化为受控图纸、回路表、连接器与端子物料表、接续图、走线尺寸、覆盖工艺、标签及测试程序。重复生产前在指定车辆或工装上审核样品装配；导通与工艺检查确认线束制造结果，完整整车行为仍属于系统级验证，除非项目明确包含准确车辆、负载与验收计划。

introduction.en: Engineer the Harness by Vehicle Zone, Circuit Duty and Service Access
introduction.zh: 按车辆分区、回路任务与维修可达性定义卡车线束

faq.zh: 卡车线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Cab, chassis, powertrain, power distribution, lighting and rear equipment as one controlled system
subtitle.zh: 把驾驶室、底盘、动力总成、配电、照明与车尾设备作为一套受控系统

lead.en: One truck platform can contain many harness families and configuration branches. The correct assembly is defined by vehicle architecture, installed options, load and route—not by connector appearance alone.
lead.zh: 同一卡车平台可以包含多种线束家族与配置分支。正确组件由车辆架构、选装配置、负载与走线路径共同定义，不能只凭连接器外观判断。

title.en: One truck category is divided into complete looms and zone-specific sub-harnesses
title.zh: 同一卡车小类可细分为整车线束与各区域分线束

copy.en: A complete vehicle loom can be separated into front-end, cab, instrument panel, roof, door, sleeper, engine, transmission, aftertreatment, chassis, axle, lighting, battery, fuse-and-relay, body-builder and rear interface assemblies. Short repair pigtails, extension leads, option jumpers and equipment adapters belong to the same category but have different release data. We define boundaries at serviceable interfaces so replacement, vehicle assembly and configuration control remain practical.
copy.zh: 整车线束可拆分为前端、驾驶室、仪表台、车顶、车门、卧铺、发动机、变速器、后处理、底盘、车桥、照明、蓄电池、保险继电器、上装与车尾接口组件。短维修尾线、延长线、选装跳线与设备转接线也属于同一小类，但放行资料不同。我们在可维修接口处定义边界，使更换、整车装配与配置管理保持可行。

copy.en: Bulkhead, controller, junction and rear interfaces establish serviceable modules.
copy.zh: 穿舱、控制器、接线与车尾接口形成可维修模块。

copy.en: Wheelbase, cab, engine, transmission, axle and body options can change branches and lengths.
copy.zh: 轴距、驾驶室、发动机、变速器、车桥与上装选项都会改变分支和长度。

title.en: Cab harnesses combine driver controls, displays, comfort systems and service access
title.zh: 驾驶室线束整合驾驶控制、显示、舒适系统与维修访问

copy.en: Cab assemblies can link instrument clusters, switches, steering-column controls, HVAC, seats, doors, roof equipment, infotainment, telematics, cameras and diagnostic access. Space is limited and trim movement can pinch poorly positioned branches. Harness geometry therefore follows panel sequence, clip positions, connector access, airbag and pedal clearance, noise-sensitive circuits and defined service loops. Bulkhead transitions separate the relatively protected cabin from exterior duty.
copy.zh: 驾驶室组件可连接仪表、开关、转向柱控制、空调、座椅、车门、车顶设备、信息娱乐、车联网、摄像头与诊断接口。空间有限，饰板运动可能夹伤位置不当的分支，因此线束几何应服从面板装配顺序、卡扣位置、接口可达、气囊与踏板避让、噪声敏感回路及规定维修余量；穿舱过渡则把相对受保护的舱内与外部工况分开。

copy.en: Branches and connectors must remain reachable at the correct station and trim stage.
copy.zh: 分支与接口应在正确工位和饰板阶段保持可达。

copy.en: Routing avoids pedals, steering mechanisms, sharp trim and occupant contact.
copy.zh: 走线避开踏板、转向机构、尖锐饰件与乘员接触区域。

title.en: Battery feeds, grounds, fuses and relays are sized as coordinated current paths
title.zh: 蓄电池供电、接地、保险与继电器按协调电流路径设计

copy.en: Truck electrical systems commonly use nominal 12 VDC or 24 VDC primary circuits, while particular platforms may add converters, auxiliary supplies or electrified subsystems. Main feeds, ignition feeds, switched outputs and grounds are separated by function. Wire size, terminal system, fuse or breaker, relay contacts, splice construction and ground attachment are reviewed against continuous current, inrush, duty cycle, voltage drop, fault energy and service temperature. Protection location and downstream conductor size must remain coordinated.
copy.zh: 卡车电气系统常见标称 12 VDC 或 24 VDC 主回路，特定平台还可能增加转换器、辅助电源或电动化子系统。主供电、点火供电、开关输出与接地按功能区分；线径、端子体系、保险或断路器、继电器触点、接续结构与接地点要结合持续电流、浪涌、占空比、压降、故障能量及工作温度审核，保护位置还必须与下游导体尺寸协调。

copy.en: Supply and return paths both contribute to voltage drop and heating.
copy.zh: 供电与回流路径都会影响压降和发热。

copy.en: Fuse, relay and junction locations balance access, exposure and cable length.
copy.zh: 保险、继电器与接线位置需平衡可达性、暴露与线长。

title.en: Engine, transmission and aftertreatment branches face heat, fluids and vibration
title.zh: 发动机、变速器与后处理分支同时面对高温、液体与振动

copy.en: Powertrain harnesses connect controllers, injectors, pressure and temperature sensors, actuators, solenoids, speed sensors, heaters and aftertreatment devices. Routing near exhaust components, turbochargers, moving linkages and service points creates local thermal and mechanical zones. Connector seals, high-temperature wire, sleeve transitions, bracket spacing, bend direction and strain relief are selected together. Signal, communication and actuator circuits are separated or shielded where the released architecture requires it.
copy.zh: 动力总成线束连接控制器、喷油器、压力与温度传感器、执行器、电磁阀、转速传感器、加热器及后处理设备。靠近排气部件、涡轮增压器、运动连杆与维修点的走线会形成局部热区和机械区，因此连接器密封、耐热线材、套管过渡、支架间距、弯曲方向与应力缓解需共同选择；信号、通信和执行器回路则按放行架构进行分隔或屏蔽。

copy.en: Under-hood temperature is not one uniform value across the route.
copy.zh: 发动机舱沿线温度并不是一个统一数值。

copy.en: Interfaces should support component removal without pulling on terminals or branches.
copy.zh: 接口应支持部件拆装，而不拉扯端子或分支。

title.en: Lighting and body branches must carry both steady loads and diagnostic control
title.zh: 照明与车身分支既承载稳定负载，也承载诊断控制

copy.en: Front, marker, work, side, tail, brake and reverse lamps may be supplied directly, switched through relays or managed by electronic body controllers that monitor open and short circuits. The harness can also serve horns, wipers, washer pumps, mirrors, locks, steps and auxiliary body equipment. Lamp connector orientation, polarity, shared grounds, moisture drainage and replacement access are fixed on the drawing. LED loads may require platform-specific compatibility rather than a simple voltage match.
copy.zh: 前灯、示廓灯、工作灯、侧灯、尾灯、制动灯与倒车灯可能直接供电、由继电器切换，或由能监测开路与短路的车身控制器管理；同一线束还可服务喇叭、雨刷、洗涤泵、后视镜、门锁、踏步及辅助上装。灯具接口方向、极性、共用接地、排水与更换可达性都应在图纸中固定；LED 负载还可能需要车型专用兼容，而不是只匹配电压。

copy.en: Circuit names and connector cavities preserve tail, stop, turn and auxiliary functions.
copy.zh: 回路名称与孔位应保持尾灯、制动、转向和辅助功能清晰。

copy.en: Load monitoring can react to substitutions even when a lamp illuminates.
copy.zh: 即使灯具能够点亮，负载监测仍可能对替代方案产生响应。

title.en: Rear interfaces extend the vehicle system into trailers and body-builder equipment
title.zh: 车尾接口把车辆系统延伸至挂车与上装设备

copy.en: Rear harnesses may connect lamps, ABS or EBS equipment, liftgates, refrigeration units, hydraulic power packs, sensors, cameras and body-builder controls. Tractor-to-trailer interfaces, coiled leads and chassis junctions experience repeated coupling, road spray, impact and movement. Pin assignment, voltage, current, communication circuits, connector standard, cable extension, strain relief, parking method and replacement cycle must be defined for the exact fleet configuration.
copy.zh: 车尾线束可连接灯具、ABS 或 EBS 设备、尾板、制冷机组、液压动力单元、传感器、摄像头与上装控制。牵引车至挂车接口、螺旋线与底盘接线点会反复对接，并承受道路飞溅、冲击和运动，因此必须针对准确车队配置定义针脚、电压、电流、通信回路、连接器标准、伸展长度、应力缓解、停放方式与更换周期。

copy.en: Tractor, trailer and auxiliary equipment versions remain configuration controlled.
copy.zh: 牵引车、挂车与辅助设备版本要保持配置受控。

copy.en: Grip, cap, tether and cable support reduce damage during daily coupling.
copy.zh: 握持、防尘盖、系绳与线缆支撑可减少日常对接损伤。

title.en: Road spray, salt, mud, stone impact and flex are converted into zone-specific protection
title.zh: 把道路飞溅、盐雾、泥污、碎石冲击与弯折转化为分区防护

copy.en: An under-cab branch, frame-rail run, wheel-end lead and exposed rear connector do not share one duty. We map splash direction, drainage, abrasion, clamp movement, suspension travel, articulation, pressure washing, oils, fuels and de-icing chemicals. Sealed connector systems require compatible housings, terminals, individual wire seals, cavity plugs, locks and mating interfaces. Conduit, braid, tape and heat shields protect selected areas without creating water traps or stiffness transitions that concentrate fatigue.
copy.zh: 驾驶室下分支、车架纵梁走线、轮端引线与裸露车尾接口并非同一工况。我们需要映射飞溅方向、排水、磨损、卡扣运动、悬架行程、铰接、高压冲洗、油液、燃料与融雪化学品。密封连接器系统要求壳体、端子、独立线封、堵头、锁止和对插件相容；波纹管、编织网、胶带与隔热层只在需要区域防护，同时避免形成积水口或产生集中疲劳的刚度突变。

copy.en: Suspension, cab tilt and axle travel require controlled slack and support.
copy.zh: 悬架、驾驶室翻转与车桥运动需要受控余量和支撑。

copy.en: Connector exit, covering overlap and low points are oriented deliberately.
copy.zh: 连接器出线、覆盖层搭接与低点方向都应有意设计。

title.en: Wire, terminals, seals, splices and coverings are matched to circuit and zone
title.zh: 线材、端子、密封、接续与覆盖层按回路和区域匹配

copy.en: Heavy-duty truck wiring spans low-level sensors, network pairs, general controls, motors, heaters and battery-related feeds. Conductor cross-section and strand construction follow current, voltage drop, flexing and terminal limits. Insulation, jacket, seal range and covering follow temperature and chemical exposure. Open-barrel or closed-barrel terminals, ultrasonic or crimped splices, welded branches, ring terminals and sealed joints each require the correct material stack, process window and inspection method. One large wire is not a universal substitute for a designed circuit.
copy.zh: 重型卡车布线覆盖低电平传感器、网络线对、一般控制、电机、加热器与蓄电池相关供电。导体截面和绞线结构依据电流、压降、弯折及端子限制选择；绝缘、护套、线封范围与覆盖层依据温度和化学暴露选择；开式或闭式压接端子、超声或压接接续、焊接分支、环形端子与密封接头各有相应材料组合、工艺窗口和检验方法。单纯加粗导线并不能替代回路设计。

copy.en: Conductor, plating, seal and crimp geometry are reviewed as one interface.
copy.zh: 导体、镀层、线封与压接几何作为一个接口共同审核。

copy.en: Splice capacity, branch direction, insulation and location remain drawing-defined.
copy.zh: 接续容量、分支方向、绝缘与位置均由图纸定义。

title.en: Existing harnesses can guide reconstruction, but hidden electrical intent still needs confirmation
title.zh: 现有线束可支持还原，但隐藏电气意图仍需确认

copy.en: A physical sample can reveal connector families, branch geometry, covering transitions, clips, labels and many point-to-point circuits. It may not reveal conductor specification under insulation, terminal plating, sealed-splice construction, intermittent damage, controller logic, option differences or the reason for a shared ground. We compare sample findings with vehicle, connector and circuit information, document uncertainty and build a controlled first article rather than copying appearance alone.
copy.zh: 实物样品可以呈现连接器家族、分支几何、覆盖过渡、卡扣、标签与许多点对点回路，却未必能揭示绝缘下的导体规格、端子镀层、密封接续结构、间歇性损伤、控制器逻辑、选装差异或共用接地原因。我们会把样品发现与车辆、连接器和回路资料对照，记录不确定项并制作受控首件，而不是只复制外观。

copy.en: Damage, repairs, missing clips and field modifications are separated from intended design.
copy.zh: 损伤、维修、缺失卡扣与现场改装应与原设计区分。

copy.en: Substitutions and geometry corrections become explicit drawing revisions.
copy.zh: 替代物料与几何修正要成为明确图纸版本。

title.en: Branch geometry and circuit identity must remain repeatable across production
title.zh: 分支几何与回路身份必须在批量生产中保持可重复

copy.en: Manufacturing begins from released drawings, BOM, circuit table, cut list, splice plan, protection instructions and test definition. Wire preparation, seal loading, terminal crimping, splice formation, connector insertion, secondary locks, taping, conduit, clips and labels follow controlled work instructions. Form boards or digital fixtures establish datums and breakout direction. First-off and in-process checks focus on characteristics that affect installation, electrical function and durability rather than cosmetic consistency alone.
copy.zh: 制造从放行图纸、物料表、回路表、裁线表、接续方案、防护工艺与测试定义开始。剥线、穿线封、端子压接、接续形成、插壳、二次锁、缠带、波纹管、卡扣与标签均按受控作业文件执行；布线板或数字工装建立基准与分支方向；首件和过程检查聚焦影响装车、电气功能与耐久的特性，而不只是外观一致。

copy.en: Wire identity, seal, terminal and crimp condition are checked before cavities hide them.
copy.zh: 在线材进入孔位遮蔽前核对线号、线封、端子与压接状态。

copy.en: Connector face, branch point and clip position use stated measurement references.
copy.zh: 连接器端面、分支点与卡扣位置使用明确测量基准。

title.en: Production tests, installation checks and vehicle validation answer different questions
title.zh: 生产测试、装车检查与整车验证分别回答不同问题

copy.en: Routine inspection can verify dimensions, materials, connector keying, terminal locks, cavity population, continuity, shorts, labels and workmanship. Crimp cross-section, pull, resistance, voltage-drop, insulation, sealing, flex, vibration, thermal or chemical tests are added when the project supplies released limits and sampling rules. Installation confirms fit, clearance, clip engagement and serviceability. Powered vehicle checks confirm the agreed functions and diagnostic behavior. Reports identify exactly which level was completed and remain linked to drawing revision, vehicle configuration and batch.
copy.zh: 常规检验可以核对尺寸、物料、连接器防错、端子锁止、装针、导通、短路、标签与工艺；压接截面、拉力、电阻、压降、绝缘、密封、弯折、振动、热或化学测试在项目提供放行限值与抽样规则后增加。装车检查确认匹配、间隙、卡扣啮合与可维修性；上电整车检查确认约定功能及诊断行为。报告应准确说明完成的验证层级，并关联图纸版本、车辆配置与批次。

copy.en: Continuity, powered function and complete vehicle behavior are not equivalent claims.
copy.zh: 导通、上电功能与完整整车行为不是等价声明。

copy.en: Platform, option, harness revision and test record remain traceably linked.
copy.zh: 平台、选装、线束版本与测试记录保持可追溯关联。

q.en: Is truck harness one standard product?
q.zh: 卡车线束是一种标准产品吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad category that includes many complete and zone-specific assemblies. Vehicle platform, year, wheelbase, cab, powertrain, installed options and body equipment determine the released configuration.
a.zh: 不是。它是包含整车线束与多种区域分线束的大类，车辆平台、年份、轴距、驾驶室、动力总成、选装与上装共同决定放行配置。

q.en: Can a harness be copied from an existing sample?
q.zh: 可以按照现有样品复制线束吗？

a.en: A sample is useful for geometry, connector and circuit tracing, but hidden materials, damaged areas, field repairs, option content and electrical intent still need documentation or controlled validation.
a.zh: 样品有助于还原几何、连接器和回路，但隐藏材料、损伤区域、现场维修、选装内容与电气意图仍需文件或受控验证。

q.en: Can 12 V and 24 V truck harnesses use the same design?
q.zh: 12 V 与 24 V 卡车线束可以共用同一设计吗？

a.en: Not by assumption. Load current, device rating, fuse strategy, wire size, relay or controller behavior, connector limits and voltage-drop budget must be reviewed for the actual system.
a.zh: 不能直接假设。必须针对实际系统审核负载电流、设备额定值、保险策略、线径、继电器或控制器行为、连接器限制与压降预算。

q.en: What changes between cab and chassis harnesses?
q.zh: 驾驶室线束与底盘线束有什么区别？

a.en: Cab harnesses emphasize packaging, trim sequence, controls and service access. Chassis harnesses usually require stronger sealing, abrasion, impact, chemical and movement protection. The interface between them must accommodate cab motion and bulkhead requirements.
a.zh: 驾驶室线束更关注空间、饰板装配顺序、控制件与维修可达；底盘线束通常需要更强的密封、耐磨、抗冲击、耐化学与运动防护，两者接口还要适应驾驶室运动和穿舱要求。

q.en: Does continuity testing prove the harness works on the truck?
q.zh: 导通测试能证明线束在整车上正常工作吗？

a.en: No. Continuity verifies defined conductive paths. Vehicle function also depends on loads, grounding, protection, network behavior, controller configuration, installation and the exact vehicle option set.
a.zh: 不能。导通只验证规定导电路径；整车功能还取决于负载、接地、保护、网络行为、控制器配置、安装及准确选装组合。

q.en: What should be sent for quotation and sampling?
q.zh: 报价与打样需要提供什么？

a.en: Send vehicle and configuration identity, system voltage, drawings or sample, connector and pin data, load and fuse information, route and zone photographs, dimensions, clips and coverings, environmental duty, labels, quantity and required validation.
a.zh: 请提供车辆与配置身份、系统电压、图纸或样品、连接器与针脚资料、负载和保险信息、走线与分区照片、尺寸、卡扣与覆盖层、环境工况、标签、数量及所需验证。

intro.en: Construction vehicle harnesses distribute power, control, sensor and communication circuits across excavators, loaders, cranes, bulldozers, graders, compactors, aerial platforms and other self-propelled work machines. The category includes complete machine looms and cab, engine, chassis, boom, hydraulic-control, lighting and attachment sub-harnesses.
intro.zh: 工程车辆线束为挖掘机、装载机、起重机、推土机、平地机、压路机、高空作业平台及其他自行式作业机械分配电源、控制、传感与通信回路。该小类覆盖整机主线束以及驾驶室、发动机、底盘、臂架、液压控制、照明与属具分线束。

knowledge.en: Off-road machines combine mobile-vehicle wiring with industrial actuators, hydraulic systems and exposed articulation. Harness design must follow the actual machine zone, movement envelope, duty cycle and service method. Connector sealing alone cannot compensate for poor routing, unsupported mass, trapped water, excessive branch stiffness or the wrong terminal and wire-seal combination.
knowledge.zh: 非道路机械把移动车辆布线、工业执行器、液压系统与裸露铰接结构结合在一起。线束设计必须服从实际机器分区、运动包络、工作循环与维修方式；单靠连接器密封无法弥补错误走线、无支撑重量、积水、分支过硬或端子与线封组合不匹配。

notes.en: Provide machine maker, model and serial range; equipment type and installed attachments; voltage architecture; controller, valve, sensor and actuator data; drawings, samples and mating interfaces; circuit and network definitions; boom, articulation and service movement; heat, dust, mud, washdown, oil and chemical zones; clips, brackets and pass-throughs; branch datums; labels; quantity; and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供机器制造商、型号与序列号范围；设备类型及安装属具；电压架构；控制器、阀、传感器与执行器资料；图纸、样品及对插件；回路与网络定义；臂架、铰接与维修运动；高温、粉尘、泥浆、冲洗、油液与化学分区；卡扣、支架与穿孔；分支基准、标签、数量及验证要求。

delivery.en: Approved requirements are converted into controlled drawings, circuit lists, BOMs, splice maps, form-board datums, protection instructions, labels and test programs. First articles are checked on the target machine or representative fixture for reach, movement, clearance, connector access and agreed function before repeat production. Evidence is released by machine configuration and drawing revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会被转化为受控图纸、回路表、物料表、接续图、布线板基准、防护工艺、标签与测试程序。重复生产前在目标机器或代表性工装上检查首件的可达、运动、间隙、接口访问及约定功能；证据按机器配置与图纸版本放行。

introduction.en: Design Every Branch Around the Machine, Its Motion and the Worksite
introduction.zh: 围绕机器、运动与施工现场设计每一条分支

faq.zh: 工程车辆线束常见问题

subtitle.en: Cab, powertrain, hydraulics, articulation, attachments and exposed chassis circuits
subtitle.zh: 覆盖驾驶室、动力总成、液压、铰接、属具与裸露底盘回路

lead.en: A construction harness is not one fixed loom. Machine platform, serial range, attachment package, controller architecture and routing zone create a family of complete and modular assemblies.
lead.zh: 工程车辆线束不是一根固定线束；机器平台、序列号范围、属具组合、控制架构与走线区域会形成一整套完整或模块化组件。

title.en: One category covers earthmoving, lifting, access and road-building machines
title.zh: 同一小类覆盖土方、起重、高空作业与道路施工机械

copy.en: Excavators, wheel and skid-steer loaders, bulldozers, graders, cranes, rollers, pavers, telehandlers and aerial platforms use different architectures, yet all can be divided into serviceable cab, powertrain, chassis, boom, attachment and rear assemblies. The category also includes valve-bank branches, sensor leads, lighting looms, controller pigtails, battery cables, diagnostic access and replacement sections. Assembly boundaries follow the machine’s manufacturing and field-service strategy rather than an arbitrary cable length.
copy.zh: 挖掘机、轮式与滑移装载机、推土机、平地机、起重机、压路机、摊铺机、伸缩臂叉装车与高空平台架构不同，但都可拆分为可维修的驾驶室、动力、底盘、臂架、属具与车尾组件。该小类还包含阀组分支、传感器引线、照明线束、控制器尾线、蓄电池线、诊断访问及替换段；组件边界应服从机器制造与现场维修策略，而不是任意线长。

title.zh: 识别平台与序列号范围

copy.en: Mid-life controller, engine and attachment changes can alter the released harness.
copy.zh: 生命周期中的控制器、发动机和属具变更会改变放行线束。

copy.en: Disconnect points should support realistic removal and replacement in the field.
copy.zh: 断开点应支持现场实际拆装与更换。

title.en: Joysticks, displays, switches and safety circuits require compact, serviceable routing
title.zh: 手柄、显示、开关与安全回路需要紧凑且可维修的走线

copy.en: Cab harnesses connect joysticks, pedals, displays, key switches, HVAC, seats, cameras, radios and safety interlocks. Controls can combine analogue, PWM, CAN, LIN, discrete input and supply circuits in confined consoles. Harness branches must follow panel assembly order, preserve connector access, avoid sharp trim and moving linkages, and provide enough service loop for controlled disassembly. Emergency-stop and interlock circuits remain traceable and are not casually merged with convenience loads.
copy.zh: 驾驶室线束连接操纵手柄、踏板、显示器、钥匙开关、空调、座椅、摄像头、无线设备与安全联锁。狭窄控制台内可能同时存在模拟、PWM、CAN、LIN、离散输入与供电回路；分支必须服从面板装配顺序、保持接口可达、避开尖锐饰件与运动连杆，并为受控拆装预留维修长度。急停与联锁回路需保持可追溯，不能随意并入便利负载。

copy.en: Operator inputs, safety circuits, power loads and data links retain clear identity.
copy.zh: 操作输入、安全回路、功率负载与数据链路保持清晰身份。

copy.en: Connector orientation and loop length support removal without terminal strain.
copy.zh: 连接器方向与余量应支持拆卸而不拉伤端子。

title.en: Engine and aftertreatment branches are divided by local heat, fluids and vibration
title.zh: 发动机与后处理分支按局部热、液体与振动分区

copy.en: Powertrain assemblies can connect ECUs, injectors, fuel and oil sensors, crank and cam sensors, turbo actuators, transmission devices, fans, heaters and aftertreatment modules. Exhaust proximity and trapped under-cover heat require local temperature mapping; diesel, hydraulic oil, coolant and cleaning agents guide material review. Brackets, clips, backshells, sleeves and bend direction control vibration at terminals and keep branches clear of belts, fans and service tools.
copy.zh: 动力总成组件可连接 ECU、喷油器、燃油与机油传感器、曲轴与凸轮传感器、涡轮执行器、变速器设备、风扇、加热器与后处理模块。靠近排气以及罩内积热需要局部温度映射；柴油、液压油、冷却液与清洗剂影响材料审核。支架、卡扣、尾壳、套管与弯曲方向共同控制端子处振动，并使分支避开皮带、风扇与维修工具。

copy.en: A single engine-compartment rating may hide critical hot spots.
copy.zh: 单一发动机舱温度等级可能掩盖关键热点。

copy.en: Branches stay clear when filters, covers and powertrain parts are removed.
copy.zh: 拆卸滤芯、盖板与动力部件时，分支仍应避让。

title.en: Valve coils, pressure sensors and proportional controls need ordered branch architecture
title.zh: 阀线圈、压力传感器与比例控制需要有序分支架构

copy.en: Hydraulic equipment can contain dense banks of solenoid valves, proportional coils, pressure and temperature sensors, pump controls and manifold switches. Similar connectors placed close together create a high risk of cross-connection. Branch labels, color identification, keying, connector orientation and controlled breakout positions support correct installation. Current, duty cycle, suppression components and controller output type must be confirmed; a coil connector that fits mechanically is not proof of electrical compatibility.
copy.zh: 液压设备可能包含密集的电磁阀、比例线圈、压力与温度传感器、泵控制及歧管开关。相似连接器近距离排列会带来错插风险，因此需要通过分支标签、颜色识别、防错、接口方向与受控分支位置支持正确安装。还必须确认电流、占空比、抑制元件与控制器输出类型；线圈插头能够机械插合并不证明电气兼容。

copy.en: Function labels and branch geometry supplement connector keying.
copy.zh: 功能标签与分支几何共同补充连接器防错。

copy.en: Voltage alone does not define current, duty or suppression requirements.
copy.zh: 电压本身不能定义电流、占空比与抑制要求。

title.en: Moving joints are engineered from the complete travel envelope, not a static pose
title.zh: 运动关节按完整行程包络设计，而不是按静止姿态估算

copy.en: Booms, sticks, buckets, rotating upper structures, steering joints, outriggers, lift arms and tilting cabs move harnesses through changing radii and support points. The design identifies fixed and moving ends, neutral position, full travel, twist, minimum bend radius, unsupported mass, rub points and hydraulic-hose interaction. Service loops are retained and guided; excess length is not left loose. Repeated-flex cable or protective carriers are selected only where the defined motion and cycle count justify them.
copy.zh: 动臂、斗杆、铲斗、回转上车、转向铰接、支腿、举升臂与翻转驾驶室会让线束经历不断变化的半径和支撑点。设计需要明确固定端与运动端、中位、全行程、扭转、最小弯曲半径、无支撑重量、摩擦点及与液压管的相互作用；维修余量要被保留并引导，而不是随意悬垂。只有规定运动与循环次数确实需要时，才选择高柔线缆或拖链防护。

copy.en: Clearance is checked at full extension, retraction, steering and service movement.
copy.zh: 在完全伸展、收回、转向与维修运动下检查间隙。

copy.en: Loop length and orientation balance travel without snagging or folding.
copy.zh: 余量长度与方向需兼顾行程，并避免勾挂或折叠。

title.en: Dust, mud, stone impact, washdown and weather become explicit design zones
title.zh: 把粉尘、泥浆、碎石冲击、冲洗与天气转化为明确设计分区

copy.en: Frame rails, wheel zones, underbody runs and exposed attachment interfaces can face pressure spray, packed dirt, sharp aggregate, UV, salt and standing water. The harness is zoned for sealing, drainage, abrasion, impact, chemical resistance and temperature. Connector systems only achieve their intended protection when housing, terminals, seals, cavity plugs, locks and mating parts are compatible and correctly assembled. Coverings end at controlled transitions so they do not pump water or grind against the cable.
copy.zh: 车架纵梁、轮区、底部走线与裸露属具接口可能面对高压飞溅、泥土堆积、尖锐骨料、紫外线、盐与积水。线束按密封、排水、耐磨、抗冲击、耐化学与温度进行分区；只有壳体、端子、密封、堵头、锁止与对插件相容且正确装配时，连接器体系才能达到预期防护。覆盖层应在受控位置过渡，避免抽吸水分或磨损线缆。

copy.en: Low points, connector exits and covering overlaps must not retain water.
copy.zh: 低点、连接器出线与覆盖搭接不得形成积水。

copy.en: Sealing, abrasion, impact and UV resistance require different features.
copy.zh: 密封、耐磨、抗冲击与耐紫外需要不同设计特征。

title.en: Starting, charging and auxiliary loads require coordinated conductor and protection decisions
title.zh: 起动、充电与辅助负载需要协调导体和保护决策

copy.en: Construction machines may use 12 V, 24 V or mixed low-voltage architectures, with starter, alternator, battery, isolation switch, fuse or breaker, auxiliary socket, heater, pump and work-light circuits. Cable size follows continuous and transient current, route length, voltage drop, ambient temperature and terminal capability. Ring-terminal joints require controlled crimping, contact surfaces, torque and strain relief. Protection devices are positioned so downstream conductors and branches remain appropriately protected.
copy.zh: 工程机械可能采用 12 V、24 V 或混合低压架构，包含起动机、发电机、蓄电池、隔离开关、保险或断路器、辅助插座、加热器、泵与工作灯回路。线缆尺寸依据持续与瞬态电流、路径长度、压降、环境温度与端子能力确定；环形端子连接需要受控压接、接触面、紧固扭矩与应力缓解；保护装置的位置还要保证下游导体与分支得到适当保护。

copy.en: Positive and return paths both contribute to drop and heating.
copy.zh: 正极与回流路径都会产生压降和发热。

copy.en: Lug, stud, surface condition and support are part of the released interface.
copy.zh: 线鼻、螺柱、接触面状态与支撑都属于放行接口。

title.en: Machine networks, GNSS, cameras and sensors depend on controlled signal paths
title.zh: 机器网络、GNSS、摄像头与传感器依赖受控信号路径

copy.en: Modern work machines can combine CAN or J1939 networks, GNSS receivers, telematics, cameras, radar, inclination sensors, load monitoring and remote-control interfaces. Balanced pairs, coaxial or high-speed data cables, shields and grounds follow the approved architecture. Pair untwist, uncontrolled stubs, shield discontinuity and routing beside motors or solenoids can affect behavior even when continuity is correct. Device power and data paths are documented separately, including wake and ignition logic where applicable.
copy.zh: 现代作业机械可能同时包含 CAN 或 J1939 网络、GNSS 接收器、车联网、摄像头、雷达、倾角传感器、载荷监测与遥控接口。平衡线对、同轴或高速数据线、屏蔽与接地应服从批准架构；过度解绞、未受控支线、屏蔽中断以及紧邻电机或电磁阀的走线，都可能在导通正确时影响性能。设备电源与数据路径应分别记录，并在适用时说明唤醒和点火逻辑。

copy.en: Cable family, pair geometry and shield termination stay drawing-controlled.
copy.zh: 线缆家族、线对几何与屏蔽端接保持图纸受控。

copy.en: Branches, nodes, termination and gateways are reviewed beyond pin-to-pin mapping.
copy.zh: 除了针脚映射，还要审核分支、节点、终端与网关。

title.en: Conductors, connector systems and coverings are selected as one mechanical stack
title.zh: 导体、连接器体系与覆盖层作为一套机械组合选择

copy.en: Low-level sensor wires, network pairs, control circuits and high-current feeds may use different constructions in one machine. Conductor size and stranding follow electrical load and movement; insulation and jacket follow temperature and fluid exposure; terminals, plating, wire seals and cavity plugs follow the connector family; conduit, braid, tape, heat shield and grommets follow local abrasion, impact and pass-through duty. Protection should transition gradually rather than creating a hard edge that concentrates flex.
copy.zh: 同一机器内的低电平传感线、网络线对、控制回路与大电流供电可能使用不同结构。导体截面与绞线依据电气负载和运动选择；绝缘与护套依据温度和液体暴露选择；端子、镀层、线封与堵头服从连接器家族；波纹管、编织网、胶带、隔热层与护圈则服从局部耐磨、抗冲击及穿孔任务。防护应逐步过渡，避免形成集中弯折的硬边。

copy.en: A correct housing with the wrong seal range is not a sealed system.
copy.zh: 壳体正确但线封范围错误，仍不构成密封系统。

copy.en: Covering ends and branch joints need controlled support and bend relief.
copy.zh: 覆盖层端部与分支接点需要受控支撑和弯曲缓解。

title.en: Drawings, samples and machine measurements are reconciled before first-article release
title.zh: 图纸、样品与实机测量在首件放行前完成统一

copy.en: A sample can establish connectors, clips, branch geometry and many circuits, but wear, previous repairs and option differences can misrepresent the intended design. We compare samples with mating-interface data, photographs, controller and device information, circuit schedules and machine measurements. Branch datums use named reference faces; ambiguous connector views are resolved from mating faces; movement and service positions are recorded. Uncertainty is converted into review points instead of being copied into production.
copy.zh: 样品可以确定连接器、卡扣、分支几何与许多回路，但磨损、既往维修和选装差异可能偏离原设计。我们会把样品与对插件资料、照片、控制器与设备信息、回路表及实机测量进行对照；分支基准使用命名参考面；模糊接口视图按对插面确认；运动与维修位置被记录。不确定项应转化为审核点，而不是复制进量产。

copy.en: Bench length alone cannot prove routing through clamps, joints and service positions.
copy.zh: 单独台面长度不能证明线束能通过卡扣、关节与维修位置。

copy.en: Every unresolved function or substitution remains visible before release.
copy.zh: 每项未解决功能或替代方案在放行前保持可见。

title.en: Repeat production is controlled by configuration, process evidence and machine-level checks
title.zh: 重复生产由配置、过程证据与机器级检查共同控制

copy.en: Released drawings, BOMs, cut lists, splice plans, form-board datums, work instructions and test definitions control production. Preparation, seal loading, crimping, splicing, connector insertion, secondary locks, covering, clips and labels receive staged checks before they become hidden. Routine tests confirm dimensions, continuity, shorts, cavity population and workmanship. Pull, resistance, voltage drop, insulation, sealing, flex, vibration, thermal or chemical validation is added against approved limits; installed and powered checks confirm the agreed machine functions separately.
copy.zh: 放行图纸、物料表、裁线表、接续方案、布线板基准、作业指导与测试定义共同控制生产。剥线、穿线封、压接、接续、插壳、二次锁、覆盖、卡扣与标签在被遮蔽前分阶段检查。常规测试确认尺寸、导通、短路、装针与工艺；拉力、电阻、压降、绝缘、密封、弯折、振动、热或化学验证按批准限值增加；装机与上电检查则单独确认约定机器功能。

copy.en: Machine option, harness revision, fixture and evidence remain traceably linked.
copy.zh: 机器选项、线束版本、工装与证据保持可追溯关联。

copy.en: Continuity, environmental validation and complete machine behavior are distinct claims.
copy.zh: 导通、环境验证与完整机器行为属于不同声明。

q.en: Is a construction vehicle harness a single standard loom?
q.zh: 工程车辆线束是一根标准线束吗？

a.en: No. It is a broad family covering complete machines and many cab, engine, chassis, boom, valve, lighting, attachment and service assemblies. Platform, serial range and options determine the released version.
a.zh: 不是。它是覆盖整机以及驾驶室、发动机、底盘、臂架、阀组、照明、属具与维修组件的广泛家族，平台、序列号范围与选装决定放行版本。

q.en: Can the same harness be used on an excavator and loader?
q.zh: 挖掘机与装载机可以共用同一线束吗？

a.en: Only if their approved interfaces, circuits, loads, movement, environment and geometry are actually identical. Similar controllers or connectors do not establish interchangeability.
a.zh: 只有当批准接口、回路、负载、运动、环境与几何确实相同时才可能共用；相似控制器或连接器不能证明互换。

q.en: What must be checked at a boom or articulation point?
q.zh: 臂架或铰接点必须检查什么？

a.en: Fixed and moving ends, full travel, twist, bend radius, support spacing, unsupported mass, rub points, hydraulic-hose interaction and service positions should all be reviewed.
a.zh: 需要审核固定端与运动端、完整行程、扭转、弯曲半径、支撑间距、无支撑重量、摩擦点、与液压管相互作用及维修位置。

q.en: Does a sealed connector guarantee waterproof performance?
q.zh: 使用密封连接器就能保证防水吗？

a.en: No. Housing, terminals, wire seals, cavity plugs, locks, mating parts, cable exits, assembly quality, drainage and the required test condition must work as one system.
a.zh: 不能。壳体、端子、线封、堵头、锁止、对插件、出线、装配质量、排水与规定测试条件必须作为一个系统共同工作。

q.en: Can you develop from a used machine sample?
q.zh: 可以依据旧机器样品开发吗？

a.en: Yes, as one source of evidence. Damage, repairs, missing protection, hidden materials and configuration differences still need review against machine and electrical information before release.
a.zh: 可以把它作为一类证据，但损伤、维修、缺失防护、隐藏材料与配置差异仍需结合机器和电气资料审核后才能放行。

q.en: What should be provided for quotation?
q.zh: 报价需要提供哪些资料？

a.en: Send machine identity and serial range, attachments, voltage, drawings or sample, connector and pin data, loads and network details, route photographs, movement envelope, environmental zones, dimensions, protection, labels, quantity and required checks.
a.zh: 请提供机器身份与序列号范围、属具、电压、图纸或样品、连接器与针脚资料、负载和网络信息、走线照片、运动包络、环境分区、尺寸、防护、标签、数量及所需检查。
